summary: Only a single one of these horrific creatures exists at any one time, striking terror into the inhabitants of the Cold Wastes. A cold woman resembles a gigantic white pudding in the vague shape of a human female.

name: Collie Birddog
summary: Collie birddogs are large, brown and white dogs with slender heads, pointed muzzles, and long, silky fur. They also have feathered wings on their backs and can speak.

name: Colossus
summary: These dim-witted giants are 60 feet tall and weigh 70 tons. Although not related to the giants of the known worlds, they are basically humanoid.

name: Colossus, Stone
summary: Long before the coming of the lizard folk, a race of giants walked the Realms.

name: Coltpixy
summary: The coltpixy is an enchanted pony or horse, distantly related to the unicorn. Adventurers who spy this rare creature usually find it in the service of important fairies (brownies, leprechauns, pixies, sprites, and other “wee folk”).

name: Combustion and Crystal Virus
summary: The magical combustion virus causes the cells of its victim's body to continually increase their levels of activity, growing wildly out of control. If left unchecked, the victim will spontaneously burst into flame and quickly die an agonizing death.

name: Comet Steed
summary: In appearance, the comet steed is much like a large, healthy warhorse, always with a pure white coat. The similarity to planet-bound horses stops there, however.

name: Common Animator
summary: More powerful than the minor animator, this creature can enter larger objects such as coaches or stoves and bring them to life. The power of the common animator is such that it can bestow an unusual power upon its host object.

name: Common Dragonet
summary: Those who reject the notion that Tiamat originally spawned evil dragonkind usually regard the common dragonet as the ancestral species of all dragon - good, evil, Oriental, and so on.

name: Con-tinh
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate plain, forest, jungle, hill
summary: The malicious con-tinh is a lesser spirit believed to be the spirit of a maiden who died before her time. She appears as a beautiful maiden (human or humanoid) with flowing hair and sparkling eyes.

name: Constellate
summary: The peaceful constellates are made of small motes of light gathered in constellations, groupings of stars that suggest various objects and life forms.

name: Contemplator
summary: Contemplators live on barren asteroids, pondering the questions of the universe. Some say that when one discovers all the answers to all the questions, the universe will end.

name: Cooshee
summary: The cooshee, or elven hound, is a huge, long-lived dog. It is most commonly found in the company of sylvan elves, who use it for both hunting and guard duties.

name: Copper Automaton
summary: Copper automatons are magical statues of copper and bronze with hidden weights, levers, and clockwork gears, all of which are held together by enchantments that cause them to move and attack under particular circumstances.

name: Copper Dragon
climateTerrain: Arid and temperate hills and mountains
summary: Copper dragons are incorrigible pranksters, joke tellers, and riddlers. They are prideful and are not good losers, although they are reasonable good winner.

name: Coral
summary: Coral is the calcium-based exoskeleton of soft-bodied sea creatures, called polyps, that anchor themselves to the sea floor and filter their food from the sea water with a cluster of tiny tentacles.

name: Coral (Nehwon)
summary: Coral is the tubular skeleton shells of calcium secreted by the beings which live within it. Coral can be of nearly any color from dull green or brown to brilliant reds, yellows, and oranges.

name: Cornugon (Greater Baatezu)
summary: Cornugons are elite defense forces. They look frightening: 9 feet tall, only vaguely humanoid, and covered with grotesque scales.

name: Corpse Candle
summary: The corpse candle is the undead spirit of a murdered man or woman that coerces the living into bringing its killer to justice.

name: Corpse Tearer (Linnorm Dragon)
summary: Corpse Tearer is the most hideous of the Norse dragons, and the most feared. This mottled-brown dragon lacks rear legs, but has long front ones that end in broken yet deadly claws.

name: Couatl
summary: The couatl are feathered serpents of myth and lore. It is believed that they are distant relatives of dragons, although this remains unproven.

name: Coure (Lesser Eladrin)
summary: The smallest eladrins are the coures, tiny, spritelike creatures who can be found throughout Arborea. They're messengers, scouts, pranksters, and mischief-makers who pester and annoy any travellers or more serious eladrins they run across.

name: Crabman
summary: Crabmen are man-sized intelligent crabs. They walk upright on two pairs of legs.

name: Craighe (Elven Hawk)
summary: The elven hawk appears similar to the common hawk, although it is slighter and has a smaller wingspan. The elven name, crayghe, is a nonsense word designed to imitate the hawk's cry.

name: Cranium Rat
summary: The following passage is taken from the dreams of Bilfar the Diviner, who believed that secrets fled their sleeping masters every night:

name: Crawling Claw
summary: The much feared crawling claw is frequently employed as a guardian by those mages and priests who have learned the secret of its creation.

name: Crawling Ivy
summary: Crawling ivy is a semi-intelligent plant that was developed through magical experimentation. It is usually found on the walls of old houses, encircling large trees or as ground cover.

name: Crimson Bones
summary: These gruesome undead monsters are created when a human being (or similar demihuman) is flayed alive by an evil Arak. Usually, they are created by the ranks of the powrie and teg.

name: Crimson Death (Mist)
summary: The crimson death is a malevolent, vaporous creature that feeds on the bodily fluids of its victims.

name: Crocodile
climateTerrain: Subtropical and tropical/Saltwater swamps and rivers
summary: The crocodile is a large, dangerous predatory reptile native to tropical and subtropical climes. It spends most of its time submerged in swamps, rivers, or other large bodies of water.

name: Crocodile, Albino
summary: Miniature albino crocodiles are descended from the pets of the master wizard who presided over the school decades ago. After their master was slain, the crocodiles quickly escaped into the sewer.

name: Crocodilian
summary: Crocodilians (see also: Lizard Man) are much like agrutha except they are larger and even more ferocious. Full-grown crocodilians can reach up to 15 feet in length from nose to tail tip.

name: Crodlu
summary: Crodlu are large reptiles that roam the deserts and scrub land in herds. Crodlu resemble large ostriches, but their forearms end in wicked claws and their tough, scaly hides are yellow to red, with other colors along their sides and belly.

name: Crone of Chaos
summary: A crone of chaos is a very intelligent, evil-natured creature who uses deception to cause pain and suffering. A relative of hags, she is always female.

name: Crow's-nest Dragon (Dragonet)
summary: These coastal dragonets are known for their habit of following ships to feed on the fish disturbed by the vessel's passing, much like sea gulls.

name: Crypt Cat
summary: Crypt cats are domestic cats that have been mummified. They serve as tomb guards or the minions of an undead master.

name: Crypt Servant
summary: Crypt servants appear as corpses, usually desiccated, and usually human, though elves, dwarves, and other races are not unknown. They are usually dressed in the livery of their master, the person buried in the tomb they serve.

name: Crypt Thing
summary: Crypt things are strange undead creatures that sometimes guard tombs, graves, and corpses. There are two types of crypt things—ancestral and summoned.

name: Crystal Dragon
summary: Crystal dragons are the friendliest of the gem dragons, always curious about the world. Though they seldom seek out company, they willingly converse with visitors who do not try to steal from them.

name: Crystalline Dragon (Mystara)
summary: Though they share many traits with the crystal dragons of other worlds, Mystara's crystalline dragons stand apart. They boast more Hit Dice and are larger.

name: Crystalmist
summary: Crystalmists are interesting and unusual hive entities. Individual crystalmists look much like snowflakes, drifting about in the air and absorbing sunlight to power their crystalline structures.

name: Cunnequine (Unicorn)
summary: A cunnequine is similar to a sylvan unicorn except that it is more silvery in color than white.

name: Curotai
summary: When Jiathuli, Handmaiden of Takhisis, first ensnared the Kagonesti in her web, she decided to change them into her own image.

name: Cursed Dead and Hungry Bodies
summary: The curse of the Black Waters reduces its victims to undead slaves of the oasis. These undead are either cursed dead or hungry bodies, each of which is discussed in more detail below.

name: Cursed Human (Jacqueline Montarri)
summary: The quest for eternal youth has driven many to deeds of great heroism and terrible despair. For some, it is a noble calling that leads to the discovery of great medical advances.

name: Cursed One
summary: The onset of the Red Curse always causes the loss of ability score points, and in some cases, cinnabryl cannot be found in time to stop this loss after the first point. When any of a person's ability scores is lowered to 0, that person dies.

name: Curst
summary: Curst are undead humans, trapped by an evil curse that will not let them die.

name: Cushion Fungus
summary: The cushion fungus is usually found in dry, dark, underground areas having little or no air movement. This fungus is typically oval in shape, about knee-high when mature, and up to 8' in diameter at its largest.

name: Cwn Annwn
summary: Cwn annwn (coon-a-NOON), sometimes called the hounds of Azrai, are enormous supernatural attack dogs that hunt elves.

name: Cyclopes
summary: Both greater and lesser Cyclopes resemble thin hill giants with a single eye located in the middle of their forehead. Despite their similarities, however, they are very different creatures.

name: Cyclops (Giant)
summary: A diminutive relative of true giants, cyclopskin are single-eyed giants that live alone or in small bands.

name: Dabus
summary: Tall, slender, and looking like the riddles they speak, the dabus are feared by some to be the true masters of Sigil, the hidden genius of her being. For others they are nothing but slaves that maintain Sigil's mighty engines.

name: Daegandal
summary: The daegandal (DAY-gan-doll) is thought to be the brightest and wisest of the garradalaighs. It has large muscular back legs on which it hops around quickly, covering considerable distances.

name: Daemonlord
summary: The Daemonlord is a being of pure chaos summoned from the depths of the Abyss and unleashed upon Krynn to increase the suffering of the helpless world.

name: Daergar (Dwarf)
summary: Daergar are a clan of dark dwarves who split from the Theiwar hundreds of years ago. They are among the most violent of all the dwarven races.

name: Dagorran
summary: A dagorran is a froglike beast with golden-hued skin, green eyes, and a green crystalline growth between its shoulders.

name: Dao (Zakhara)
summary: Dao are malicious genies from the Elemental Plane of Earth. (Dao is both singular and plural.) There they dwell in great numbers, continually delving and shaping the rock around them.

name: Dark Creeper
summary: Dark creepers care nothing for their appearance; although difficult to detect by sight, they can sometime be detected by the odor of their unwashed bodies and clothing. It is rumor that they never remove clothing.

name: Dark Naga
summary: Dark naga are fey creatures who have human-like faces (with fanged mouths) on leathery, snake-like bodies. They usually work with other evil beings for mutual gain or survival.

name: Dark Stalker
summary: Dark stalkers are the rarely-seen leaders of the dark creepers. They direct the movements and actions of their diminutive cousins, who obey them unerringly and without hesitation.

name: Dark Tree
summary: Dark trees are native to the Shining South. The earliest reports of dark trees preying on humans begin 200 years ago.

name: Darkenbeast
summary: The darkenbeast, also known as the death horror, is a normal animal that has been magically transformed into a savage beast under the control of the mage responsible for its transformation.

name: Darkhood
summary: The darkhood (also called a rorphyr) is a spectral undead creature that thrives on fear.

name: Darklight
summary: When a mortal spirit leaves its body upon death, it usually becomes a petitioner on the Outer Plane that most closely matches its alignment or devotion.

name: Darkling
summary: The darkling is a member of the Vistani (see the Ravenloft™ Boxed Set) who has been cast out from his people.

name: Darklore
summary: A darklore is a puddlelike beast that feeds on tainted knowledge, craving the taste of wicked secrets and foul truths. To sate its hunger, it stalks out the evil to drain them of their accumulated dark knowledge.

name: Darkness Elemental
summary: Summoned by elder priests of dark gods, darkness elemental are creatures of pure negative life energy, the distilled spirit of undeath, decay, and the night.

name: Darktentacles
summary: A darktentacles is a many-tentacled, solitary amphibious predator. Darktentacles are intelligent and use treasure to lure prey within their reach.

name: Darkweaver
summary: The darkweaver's a strange and frightening creature, partly real and partly shadow. It dwells in the caves and grottos of some of the chaotic planes, particularly Pandemonium.

name: Darkwing
climateTerrain: Any cavern, mountain, hills, plains (night only)
summary: The bane of all who raise livestock, darkwings are flying humanoids that flock together and attack at night, often decimating entire herds of cattle or sheep. Many scholars believe they are related to deep glaurants.

name: Darter
summary: Darters are small lizards with tubular snouts. The snouts are attached to tapered heads, from which two dark eyes protrude.

name: Dasher (Living Machine)
summary: Dashers are generally noted only by the effects of their speedy passage: a wind, a trail of sparks over stones, and a hail of small debris swept up in the dasher's wake. A dasher moves at its speed even when it's damaged.

name: Dazzle (Al-Jahar)
summary: Al-jahar, also known as dazzles, usually appear as beautiful humanoids; their angelic beauty disguises a terrible secret, for the al-jahar are evil and manipulative.

name: Deadly Smog
summary: Deadly smog is described as noncorporeal clouds of slightly musky-smelling fog covering an area equivalent to one hundred square feet, or a ten by ten foot area.

name: Death Dog
summary: Death dogs are large two-headed hounds which are distinguished by their penetrating double bark. Death dogs hunt in large packs.

name: Death Kiss (Beholder-kin)
summary: The Death Kiss, or bleeder, is a fearsome predator found in caverns or ruins. Its spherical body resembles that of the dreaded beholder, but the eyestalks of this creature are bloodsucking tentacles, its eyes are hook-toothed orifices.

name: Death Knight
summary: A death knight is the horrifying corruption of a paladin or lawful good warrior cursed by the gods to its terrible form as punishment for betraying the code of honor it held in life.

name: Death Linen, Sheet
summary: When lying in bed at night, wondering what those strange creeks and pops are in the darkness, who hasn't felt just a little more secure by drawing up the covers? Even the security of bedclothes is taken from us by death linens.

name: Death Minnow
summary: The death minnow is a bright orange fish only 2” in length. It is a magical extrapolation of the normal fishes of the ocean depths, created by some powerful, but unknown undersea sorcerers.

name: Death Shade
summary: The death shade is an energy parasite that feeds on the life energy of dying creatures (any creature reduced to zero hp). To generate this “food,” the death shade infests a host and periodically drives its host into a berserker rage.

name: Death Sheep
summary: These sheep attack any living thing that they can find, fearing nothing and fighting to the death. Because of their ferociousness, the sheep make all attacks at +2 to hit and damage.

name: Death's Head Tree
summary: A death's head tree looks much like a weeping willow, except its branches are thicker.

name: Deathmare
summary: As undead creatures out for revenge against all living horsemen, deathmares present a fatal trap to the unwary.

name: Debbi
summary: The debbi is an unusual breed of desert scavenger capable of forcing creatures much larger than itself into flight from watering holes and from their prey because of its ability to instill magical fear.

name: Decapus
summary: The deacpus is a bizarre monster named for its ten limbs. There are two varieties: land and marine.

name: Deep Dragon
summary: Deep dragons are little known on the surface world. They are the hunters of the Underdark.

name: Deep Glaurant
summary: These rare, evil predators inhabit caverns deep beneath the world's surface. Deep glaurants are named for their strange gulping call, which they make deep in their throats when excited.

name: Deepspawn
summary: Deepspawn are infamous horrors who give birth to many other varieties of monsters; a single Deepspawn can make a vast area dangerous, even for alert, well-armed adventurers.

name: DeGleash (Plasmoid)
summary: DeGleash are large, wet blobs that favor a form resembling a bowling pin (a fat base with a narrowing upper body). They are white to cream colored and constantly sway and bob about.

name: DelNoric (Plasmoid)
summary: DelNorics prefer a short, stocky bi- or multipedal form. Their arms and legs are usually identical.

name: Delphinid
summary: These friendly beasts swim harmlessly through the phlogiston. They have on occasion been known to help stranded travelers.

name: Delphon
summary: Delphons, or songsharks, live in the River Oceanus, swimming through the planes of Elysium, the Beastlands, and Arborea.

name: Demarax
summary: There are some mighty strange creatures on the Great Road, and the demarax is one of the strangest. It looks like a jewelled lizard or gem-covered crocodile, with tiny crystals of a hundred different colors embedded in its dark hide.

name: Demonic Sawfly
summary: These creatures were let into the world accidentally by foolish practitioners of black magic. They resemble reddish-brown daddy longlegs with wings, and they can stand upright on their spindly limbs (giving them a height of 5 or 6 feet).

name: Dendar the Night Serpent (Elder Eternal Evil)
summary: Dendar the Night Serpent is one of the elder, eternal evils of the Outer Planes created in the dawn of Abeir-Toril's prehistory. She came into existence shortly after the first being slept in Realmspace and had a nightmare.

name: Denizen
frequency:
Common in Hades; snout. Both hair and quills grow on its head, just behind a pair of
unknown elsewhere
summary: These creatures of Hades are servants of Myrkul, brought to the Realms by the magic he placed on his Tablet of Fate.

name: Denzelian
summary: A denzelian is a large, flat being, normally about 10' in diameter and 6“ thick. It appears to be composed of smooth stone, but its thick skin is somewhat flexible, allowing it to squeeze through tight places and to travel up and down inclines.

name: Dergoloth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: Dergholoths are native to the Gray Waste but inhabit Carceri and Gehenna as well. These lesser yugoloths serve as rank-and-file mercenaries in the Blood War.

name: Derro (Dwarf)
summary: Derro are a degenerate race of dwarven stature. They have dwelled in the Underdark for ages, but they were discovered by the mind flayers only five centuries ago, and by the drow but shortly before that.

name: Desert Antloid
summary: Antloids are giant ants that inhabit huge warrens in the Athasian desert. Their species has evolved through adaptive specialization which gives certain antloids special powers.

name: Desert Centaur
summary: Desert centaurs are the ultimate fusion of mount and nomadic tribesman – tough, slim, fast and stealthy nighttime raiders who slip into enemies' camps and then depart like shadows before the dawn.

name: Desert Giant
summary: Desert giants were once numerous in the scrub plains and deserts of the Land of Fate, but they have fallen victim to a divine curse which transforms them slowly but inexorably into stone.

name: Devete
summary: The devetes are blue-skinned, humanoid creatures that wander the Astral Plane. Theyºre easily marked by their large, haunting eyes and long, swishing tails.

name: Devourer (Lankhmar)
summary: The Devourers are a race of rapacious alien merchants whose only purpose is to sell trash and reap huge profits.

name: Devourer (Planescape)
summary: Haunting the deep reaches of the Ethereal and Astral Planes, the creatures known as devourers have a reputation for being among the most fearsome and loathsome of foes.

name: Dhampir
summary: Dhampir (singular and plural) are the offspring of vampires and human women. At night, they often betray their vampire heritage by their red eyes which glow after sundown and their fangs.

name: Dhaot
summary: Dhaots are incorporeal undead that are sometimes created when people die far away from their homes. The spirits of the deceased feel an overwhelming compulsion to return to their homes they had in life.

name: Dharculus (Far Realm)
summary: The dharculi are swimmers of the Border Ethereal, inserting their mawed tentacles into the Prime Material Plane to feed. Their tentacles appear as a swarm of blind eel-like creatures gliding through the air in a deadly school.

name: Dharum Suhn
summary: Beyond the elementals, which fall under the purview of Sunnis or her eternal foe Ogremoch, and beyond the powers of earth and stone, wait the dharum suhn. To some, they are known as the Lords of Stone or the Rockfathers and Rockmothers.

name: Dhour
summary: Dhours're bound to the Astral and Ethereal Planes by the structure of their bodies; the only way they can leave is by using openings others have made.

name: Diabolus
summary: Diaboli come from a mysterious realm Mystarans called the Demiplane of Nightmares. Creatures from this realm are the stuff of nightmares for humans and similar beings – though most diaboli are in fact cheerful and well-meaning.

name: Diakk
summary: One of the most commonly found creatures in the glooms of the Gray Waste is the diakk. These large, flightness, birdlike beasts are hated predators.

name: Dimensional Warper
summary: A dimensional warper has a snake-like body and stands on two long, thin legs. Its long, thin, flexible arms each end in one hooklike claw.

name: Director (Abomination)
summary: Directors are a social, warrior-beholder, and breed specialized mounts. They mindlink with their mounts to better control them.

name: Dirtwraith (Sargusian Fungus)
summary: The dirtfungus is a form of undead that spontaneously erupts out of the corrupt dirt beneath a decaying body. Rather, it is a form of semi-intelligent fungus that dwells in the root systems of larger plants.

name: Disenchanter
summary: The disenchanter resembles a spindly camel, with four legs and a single hump located on the middle of its back. The creature's small head rests at the end of a long, flexible neck.

name: Disir
summary: The disir are a race of deep-dwelling subterranean creatures of disgusting appearance. They stand about six to seven feet tall, although they are normally hunched over to a lesser height.

name: Displacer Beast
summary: The displacer beast is a magical creature that resembles a puma with two powerful black tentacles growing from its shoulders. Very rare, they stay far from human habitations.

name: Divine Minion
summary: Each divinity of the Mulhorandi pantheon has a number of magical servitors, known as minions. Each minion is a fanatical follower of the deity and serves his ends at all costs.

name: Dizantar
summary: Dizantar are tall, armored humanoids that stand most of their time hunting down and killing arcane.

name: Djinni (Zakhara)
summary: Djinn are proud, sensuous genies from the Elemental Plane of Air. (Djinn is plural; djinni is singular.) While an adventurer may encounter these creatures in great number on their home plane, djinn tend to be solitary when visiting the Land of Fate.

name: Dobie Brownie
summary: Dobies are small humanoids, similar in appearance to their cousins, the brownies. They live peaceful, reclusive lives.

name: Doc cu'o'c
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate plain, forest, hill, and mountain
summary: The doc cu'o'c is a greater spirit who serves as the protector of a given region, provided the locals remain sufficiently deferential.

name: Dog, Saluqi
summary: Saluqi are the greyhounds of the desert, known for their hunting skills, favored by the jann. They are sleek black animals with gray markings, thin whiplike bodies, and long narrow heads.

name: Dohwar
summary: The dohwar are short, pudgy, flightless avians bearing a passing resemblance to penguins. They are shameless merchants, always looking for an opportunity to turn a profit.

name: Dolphin
summary: Dolphins are intelligent seagoing mammals.

name: Dolphin (Athas)
summary: Other than these differences, however, Athasian dolphins are much like other species. Their bodies are long, compact, and muscular.

name: Doom Guard
summary: Originally nothing more than a suit of armor, the doom guard is now an animated creature similar in nature to a golem.

name: Doomsphere
summary: This ghost-like undead beholder is created by magical explosions.

name: Doppelganger
summary: The doppelganger is a master of mimicry that survives by taking the shapes of men, demihumans, and humanoids.

name: Doppelganger (Ravenloft)
summary: The Ravenloft doppelganger is a master of mimicry that survives by taking the shapes of humans, demihumans, and humanoids.

name: Doppelganger Plant
summary: The origins of this horrific plant are utterly unknown, as is much important information about it.

name: Doppelganger, Greater
summary: Common doppelgangers can easily mimic the forms of humans, demihumans, and humanoids, but their greater cousins, sometimes called “mirrorkin”, in ancient texts, have augmented those abilities to the point of perfection, allowing these shapechangers to adopr the exact fnrms and identities of several humans or humanoids, switchmg between them at will.

name: Dorvesh (Centaur-kin)
summary: Dorvesh have the upper body of a dwarf and the lower body of a donkey. Their donkey hindquarters are covered with coarse hair which varies from light brown to black.

name: Dowagu
summary: The dowagu are the creations of the Raja Ambuchar Devayam. They have the lower bodies and tails of giant snakes, except that their tails are covered with a thick, layered hide.

name: Dracimera
summary: The dracimera is the offspring of a chimera and an evil dragon.

name: Dracohydra
summary: Dracohydras are hideous multiheaded winged monsters that combine the worst features of dragons and hydras.

name: Dracolich
summary: The dracolich is an undead creature resulting from the unnatural transformation of an evil dragon.

name: Dracon
summary: The dracons are a sentient race of dragon-centaurs that have recently appeared on the fringe of the Known Spheres. Dracon exploration ships have been spotted in the phlogiston and at the edges of known space.

name: Draconian, Kapak
climateTerrain: Any, but usually tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Forest and mountain
summary: Kapaks are a race of venomous draconians known for their stealth. They are derived from copper dragon eggs.

name: Draconian, Proto-, Traag
summary: The traag draconians are among the first failed attempts to create draconians, a precursor of the more successful baaz. While not overly tall, they are emaciated and gangly.

name: Draconian, Sesk
summary: The sesk are remnants of the early experiments to create draconians. Somewhat shorter than the average draconian, they stand with a hunched posture as if favoring a cramped limb.

name: Dracosphinx
summary: The highly magical dracosphinx is native to the desert highlands, where it competes with the more numerous hieracosphinx for territory. This fierce, sly predator scours the wilderness for prey, be it small game or humans.

name: Dragger
summary: Draggers are usually encountered in natural caverns, though many are to be found in the underways of Ravens Bluff, where they have been the doom of more than a few smugglers down the years.

name: Dragon (Athas)
summary: Extremely powerful (20th-level) human and half-elven defiler/psionicists can progress to even greater power if they choose to transform themselves into dragon form. To begin the transformation, the would-be dragon casts a dragon metamorphosis spell.

name: Dragon (Cerilia)
summary: The dragons of Cerilia are an ancient race, predating even elves and dwarves. They once existed in great numbers, but now only a handful live in the Drachenaur Mountains and in lands far across the sea.

name: Dragon (Savage Coast), Crimson
summary: The crimson dragon always looks out for its own best interests, seeking power of any kind – be it treasure, territory, or ability. Following this, they are always looking to expand their repertoire of Legacies, which they possess in abundance.

name: Dragon (Savage Coast), Red Hawk
summary: The red hawk dragon is native to the Arm of the Immortals Peninsula, but occasionally it is seen flying over the western lands of the Savage Coast. For obvious reasons, it is referred to as the “feathered dragon”.

name: Dragon Beetle
summary: Dragon beetles are dark crimson in color with blacktrimmed shells. They have three horns, spiked shells, and vicious-looking stingers.

name: Dragon of Tyr
summary: Fortunately, there is only one dragon in the Tyr Region, and perhaps in the entire world of Athas (see Dragon (Athas)). It is tall and thin, with a gnarled bone structure and swollen, bulbous joints.

name: Dragon Turtle
climateTerrain: Subtropical and temperate fresh and salt water
summary: Dragon turtles are one of the most beautiful, awesome, and feared creatures of the water.

name: Dragon, Astral
summary: “Astral dragon” is a general term for a race of ancient golden dragons to whom all dragons of Krynn can trace a common ancestry. The immortal astral dragons are the personification of neutrality in dragons.

name: Dragon, Brine
summary: Brine dragons are bizarre mutations that may have been created by Erestem as an experiment.

name: Dragon, Dzalmaus
summary: The dzalmaus is a dreaded species of dragon, feared as much for its appetite as its great size. Unlike other dragons, it is not the least bit sociable, not even to others of its kind.

name: Dragon, Eormennoth
climateTerrain: The treasury vault beneath Ravens Bluff
summary: Few citizens know Ravens Bluff has a resident dragon, but the chief guard of the city treasury (and occupant of the vaults) is the bronze dragon Eormennoth (Old Male Bronze; standard dragon abilities for his type and age include create food and water, speak with animals, water breathing, and airy water as well as the powers listed above; carries ready the wizard spells charm person, ventriloquism, invisibility, magic mouth, sepia snake sigil and the priest spell command, all of which he can cast at 16th level of ability).

name: Dragon, Fang (Draco Dentus Terribilus)
summary: Fang dragons are greedy, rapacious, and cunning creatures. Their bodies are armored with bony plates that rise into projecting spurs at limb joints and end in long, forked tails tipped with a pair of scythelike bone blades.

name: Dragon, Ferrous, Gruaghlothor
summary: The Supreme Dragon, Gruaghlothor, is the ruler of all ferrous dragons and is an incarnation of all the sovereign iron dragons since the dawn of time. Despite this, Gruaghlothor is not a divine power.

name: Dragon, Kodragon
summary: The kodragon is an extremely rare species of dragon that exists only in the plane of the Astral Dragon. It is a furry dragon about the size of a small house cat.

name: Dragon, Lesser Undead
summary: What does one do with the corpse of a dragon that failed to achieve dracolich status or one that foolishly perished in battle before the conversion could even be attempted?

name: Dragon, Linnorm, Midgard
summary: The Midgard linnorm may be the sole offspring of the Midgard Serpent, child of Loki – sages believe (and hope) there is only one. This great wingless serpent may be as immortal as its sire.

name: Dragon, Maztican (Tlalocoatl, Rain Dragon)
summary: Also called rain dragons, rain serpents, or tlalocoatls, Maztican dragons are limbless and serpentine, with a head at each end. One head is snake-like; the other resembles a reptilian jaguar head.

name: Dragon, Moon
summary: Moon dragons are evil dragons that exclusively inhabit caves on moons. Like most dragons, they prize wealth and power.

name: Dragon, Neutral - Moonstone Dragon
summary: The elusive moonstone dragon, largest of the neutral dragons, rarely appears outside the realms of Faerie or of dreams. Its scales shimmer a pale silver with a hint of blue in the moonlight.

name: Dragon, Pink
summary: Pink dragons can be found almost anywhere, most frequently in some form of underground lair. Many hapless adventurers have been fatally fooled by the dragon's dopey appearance and delicate pink coloration.

name: Dragon, Radiant
summary: The radiant dragon, also called the star dragon or the celestial dragon (though not to be confused with the celestial oriental dragon of the same name), is a sinuous, serpentine dragon with graceful, translucent wings.

name: Dragon, Rust
summary: It's said by some that the rusting metal cubes of Acheron are transient, that they're another stage of something yet to come.

name: Dragon, Stellar
summary: Big, peaceful, and highly intelligent, these enormous philosophers of the phlogiston wander the flow seeking discourse with the keepers of the crystal spheres.

name: Dragon, Sun
summary: The benevolent sun dragons live and cavort on the surface of suns. Though majestic and intelligent, they love life and freedom, showing this love in a playful attitude.

name: Dragon, Yellow (Salt)
climateTerrain: Sea shore, salt marshes or inland salt lakes
summary: Yellow Dragons, or salt dragons, delight in the torment of all creatures, particularly those of good alignment. They prepare ambushes where their yellowish-white color helps them blend in with the sand or salt-encrusted rock.

name: Dragon-kin
summary: These creatures are rumored to be very distant cousins of dragons. Most dragon-kin live wild, and this type (which appears also in the MONSTROUS COMPENDIUM Annual Volume One) is known as tribal dragon-kin.

name: Dragonet, Geyser Dragon
summary: Geyser dragons are tiny, wingless dragonets that dwell (as their name suggests) in regions of geysers and hot springs. Their bodies are long and serpentine, and their legs are very short.

name: Dragonet, Mole Dragon
summary: Mole dragons are large, wingless dragonets that burrow in subterranean tunnels. They have thick bodies and short tails, and their front claws are huge, well-adapted for tunneling.

name: Dragonfish
climateTerrain: Subtropical to temperate, shallow fresh water pools, slow streams and rivers
summary: These shy, solitary scavengers are only interested in staying alive and eating. Nevertheless, the two excellent self-defense methods evolved in these creatures make them a potentially deadly enemy for clumsy, inattentive adventurers.

name: Dragonfly Turtle
summary: Also known as “hovershells,” these creatures are a mix between a giant turtle and a giant dragonfly. They retain the turtle's shell and limbs but sport the dragonfly's head and wings.

name: Dragonfly, Giant
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temparate/Jungles, forests, and swamps
summary: Giant dragonflies, like their smaller counterparts (Dragonfly), are swift and deadly aerial hunters. While their smaller cousins are generally beneficial, the giant variety is a dangerous predator that attacks any creature its size or smaller.

name: Dragonne
climateTerrain: Warm temperate to tropical/Hills and desert
summary: Possessing some of the most dangerous qualities of a lion and a brass dragon, the dragonne is a vicious and deadly hunter, and a threat to many who travel in warmer climates.

name: Dragonnel
summary: Dragonnels are distantly related to both dragons and pteranodons. Their four legs, huge wings, and long tails give them a dragon-like appearance, and from a distance it is easy to mistake a dragonnel for one of its more fearsome cousins.

name: Drake (Athas), Water
summary: The water drake is the most elusive of all drakes. This is due mostly to the hatred they hold for what humanity has done to Athas.

name: Draknor
summary: Draknor are very rarely encountered on the Prime Material plane. These creatures go through three distinct stages of growth: egg, larva, and adult.

name: Dray
summary: The dray are a new race of intelligent beings created by Dregoth, the undead dragon king. He wanted servants and followers made in his own image, so Dregoth developed a process for transforming humans into draconic humanoids.

name: Dread
summary: Dread are flying, animated skeletal arms that attack living things by raking with their sharpened fingerbones or by wielding weapons. These undead are created by wizards and priests to serve as guardians.

name: Dread Linnorm Dragon
summary: Dread linnorms, the only known two-headed Norse dragons, have an ability to wreak havoc on human settlements that is legendary. When they hatch, their small, glossy scales are black.

name: Dread Warrior
summary: Dread warriors are enhanced undead created by Szass Tam, Zulkir of Necromancy for the Red Wizards of Thay. Dread warriors are created immediately after a warrior's death so that they retain at least minimal intelligence.

name: Dread Wolf
summary: These creatures were originally created by a renegade mage, but word of how to create these horrid creatures seems to have spread across the Prime Material Plane. These undead beasts are the eyes and ears of any mage who creates them.

name: Dream Spawn, Lesser, Morph
summary: Lesser dream spawn come in many varieties, but morphs are the type most often employed by the Nightmare Court. Two of the more prevalent types are gray morphs and shadow morphs.

name: Dream Stalker
summary: The dream stalker's natural form is that of a glowing ball about the size of a human fist. It is sometimes mistaken for a will o'wisp, although it is much smaller and does not change color, remaining instead a faint yellowish white.

name: Dreamshadow
summary: Dreamshadows are illusionary creations that take the appearance of any real person or creature known to the dreamer or to anyone experiencing the dream. They are quite believable and in all ways appear to be the actual person or creature.

name: Dreamslayer
summary: The realm of dreams is a dark, mysterious place in the mind of every dreamer. Something in the nature of wildspace lets certain beings use dreams as a portal, allowing them the chance to depart the immaterial world and walk in the real world.

name: Dreamweaver
summary: Dreamweavers spin the stuff of dreams and nightmares, giving shape and substance to the scenes inside the dreamscapes.

name: Dreamwraith
summary: Dreamwraiths are violent creations of the subconscious. They assault the minds of their victims through powerful illusionary attacks.

name: Dregoth; the Undead Dragon King
summary: The Dread King Dregoth was killed almost 2,000 years ago by the combined powers of seven sorcerer-kings. Shortly thereafter, Dregoth rose as the undead dragon king.

name: Dretch (Least Tanar'ri)
summary: Petty and wicked, dretches are the most common tanar'ri, found in massive hordes everywhere in the Abyss. Along with the manes, the dretches are the rank-and-file of the Blood War.

name: Drifter (Living Machine)
summary: Drifters float like carnival balloons, though heated air doesn't seem to come into play (for that matter, neither do spells of flying or levitation, nor does telekinesis seem to be responsible for lift).

name: Drik
summary: A drik is a powerful and massive herd lizard. Its sheer bulk gives it an awesome might, making young driks targets for beast masters from both Urik and Raam to serve in their armies.

name: Drolem (Golem)
summary: A golem is actually a “construct”, a powerful, enchanted monster created and animated by a high-level wizard or priest. These creatures can be made from almost any material.

name: Drow (Elf)
summary: These dreaded, evil creatures were once part of the community of elves that still roam the world's forests.

name: Drow Lich
summary: Drow liches are perhaps the most terrible of these undead horrors. They are found in three varieties (wizard, priest, and drider), each with its own unique and ghastly powers.

name: Drow Vampire
summary: Unlike most races, the drow consider it an honor to be granted the Kiss of Lolth, as they refer to vampirism.

name: Dryad
summary: Dryads are beautiful, intelligent tree sprites. They are as elusive as they are alluring, however, and dryads are rarely seen unless taken by surprise—or they wish to be spotted.

name: Duckbunny
summary: Magical crossbreeding is a dangerous endeavor. Rather than start experimenting in this field with potentially lethal creatures like the owlbear, most wizards prefer to begin their efforts with tamer, less deadly beasts.

name: Duhlarkin
summary: Duhlarkin are unique creatures created through the use of a highly specialized form of polymorph other called Duhlark's Animerge (see TSR 1109, City of Splendors, Campaign Guide to the City, Chapter Seven).

name: Dune Reaper
summary: The dune reaper prowls the sandy wastes in wild packs, leaping from dunes to ambush and impale its prey on its scythelike limbs.

name: Dune Runner
summary: Dune runners are elves who died running to complete a quest or deliver an important message. They are undead, forever trapped and forced to repeat their hopeless mission night after night.

name: Dune Stalker
summary: Vile in both their nature and in their appearance, dune stalkers shun the Prime Material Plane, unless summoned by a high-level evil magician to fulfill an evil quest.

name: Dune Trapper
summary: A sparkling oasis in the middle of the desert, the dune trapper appears to be the salvation of many lost travellers. Unfortunately for most, apparent salvation often turns into death.

name: Duruch'i-lin
summary: The duruch'i-lin, also known as the oriental unicorn, is among the world's most beloved creatures. Though it is seldom seen by man, its appearance is always associated with longevity, health, and good fortune.

name: Dusanu
summary: The dusanu, or rot fiend, is a horrifying and intelligent humanoid that shuffles through the deepest wilderness of Mystara, attacking unfortunate humans and humanoids with its deadly spores.

name: Dust Mephit
summary: These ghoulish things find death morbidly fascinating. They pose as tragic yet fashionable victims of a gloomy fate, heroically holding out against utter insanity.

name: Dvati
summary: The dvati are a race of humanoids that dwell throughout the Outlands. All dvati are born identical twins; their priests explain that the dvati soul is so powerful a force that it takes two bodies to house it.

name: Dwarf
summary: Dwarves are a noble race of demihumans who dwell under the earth, forging great cities and waging massive wars against the forces of chaos and evil.

name: Dwarf (Athas)
summary: Dwarves are short, stocky demihumans capable of amazing feats of strength. They are known for obsessive attitudes about the tasks they perform and as such, are considered extremely reliable workers.

name: Dwarf Banshee
summary: Dwarves who die before completing a major focus are often condemned to live out their afterlives as banshees. In unlife they haunt their unfinished work or quest, unable to bear the fact that someone else may complete what they could not.

name: Dwarf Crusher
summary: The dwarf crusher is a specialized version of the stone golem specifically created to defeat dwarves, though any group of warriors would find it formidable.

name: Dwarf, Cursed Dead
summary: The demihumans of ancient Giustenal fled to the uppermost cavern beneath the city to escape the Cleansing Wars and the wrath of their sorcerer-king, Dregoth.

name: Dwarf, Duergar
summary: The duergar, or gray dwarves, are a malevolent breed that dwells in the extreme depths of the ground. Duergar may be fighters, priests, or thieves.

name: Dwarf, Utuchekulu
hitDice: 1-6 hp or by class and level
summary: The utuchekulu are an offshoot breed of dwarves that live in the jungles of the Dark Continent. They have ebony skin, black hair, and dark eyes.

name: Dweomerborn
summary: Matter and energy are seldom annihilated. The magical energy used to propel spelljamming ships produces its own “exhaust” trail, invisible to the eye but detectable by detect magic.

name: Eagle
summary: Eagles are majestic birds of prey, rarely used for hunting, but often sought after for their beauty and legendary courage.

name: Earth Drake (Athas)
summary: Often mistaken for an outcropping of rock, earth drakes are by far the physically strongest of the species.

name: Earth Elemental
summary: Earth elementals can be conjured in any area of earth or stone. This type of common elemental appears on the Prime Material plane as a very large humanoid made of whatever types of dirt, stones, precious metals, and gems it was conjured from.

name: Earth Mephit
summary: These heavy, rocky mephits have stolid, humorless personalities. Stubborn and immune to insult, they look like small, thin earth elementals, with stony skin, glittering eyes, and rigid wings of dull metal.

name: Earth Weird, Elemental
summary: These creatures are inhabitants of the Elemental Plane of Earth, but they have often been encountered more recently on the Prime Material Plane.

name: Earth-Kin (Elemental)
summary: The pech are creatures of the plane of elemental Earth, though some have extensive mines in the deepest regions of the Prime Material plane. They dwell in dark places and work stone.

name: Eastern Vampire (Mayónaka)
summary: Mayónaka wanders the domains of the Core, seeking out the greatest warriors in Ravenloft and challenging them to duels.

name: Eastern Vampire (Oriental)
summary: The eastern vampire is very similar to its common, western cousin. There are.

name: Eater of Knowledge
summary: One of the powers iesiding in the Land is Ilsensine, the illithid god-brain.

name: Ebon Tiger
summary: These fearsome magical creatures look like great cats wholly composed of black fire. Physically, an ebon tiger resembles a normal tiger, except that its body is uniformy black with no stripes.

name: Echyan
summary: These large, predatory sea worms live in the Western Sea and, at times, in the rivers of the Savage Coast lands.

name: Ee'aar
summary: Except for a pair of very large, feathered wings, ee'aar appear to be stocky elves. They posses the typical elven arched eyebrows, pointed ears, quick reflexes, and natural grace in movement.

name: Eel
summary: Eels are long, snake-like fish that are usually not aggressive. Nevertheless, nature has provided the various types of eels with interesting – and dangerous – methods of defense.

name: Eel, Giant Moray
summary: These aquatic predators are evil, cruel creatures – slow, but feared for their diseased bite and their fearlessness once they have seized prey.

name: Efreeti (Zakhara)
summary: Efreet are genies of the Elemental Plane of Fire, and they are likely to found in great numbers there.

name: Egarus
summary: A yawning expanse of unending nothingness stretches into infinity, turning a body's mind in on itself when he tries to grasp the enormity of it.

name: Einheriar
summary: Strictly speaking, the term einheriar (“faithful”) applies to the dead of Asgard, the first layer of Ysgard.

name: Ekimmu
summary: An ekimmu is an angry undead spirit that was once human. It is created when a human dies far from home and is not given proper burial rites; for this reason an ekimmu hates humans, demihumans and humanoids, and seeks vengeance against the living.

name: Elder Brain
summary: The elder brain is a huge, fibrous mass of cognizant brain tissue covered with writhing feelers. A single elder brain floats within the depths of a briny pool found at the center of its illithid community.

name: Electrum Dragon
summary: Electrum dragons are peaceful and philosophical in nature, but become deadly, alert, and deliberate fighters when aroused.

name: Elemental (Athas), Greater, Water
summary: Greater water elementals can be conjured in any area containing a large body of water or watery liquid.

name: Elemental (Athas), Lesser, Air/Earth
summary: Dust devils and sirocco winds blow frequently across the Athasian desert. Travellers often look upon these natural phenomenon with fear, thinking them to be lesser air elementals.

name: Elemental (Athas), Lesser, Fire/Water
summary: These creatures from the elemental plane of fire are the most spirited and mischievous of all the lesser elementals.

name: Elemental of Chaos, Air/Earth
summary: The elementals of chaos are intelligent creatures native to one of the four elemental planes. Each of these elementals pursues its own interests vigorously with little, if any, care for order on either its home plane or the Prime Material Plane.

name: Elemental of Chaos, Fire/Water
summary: The elementals of chaos are intelligent creatures native to one of the four elemental planes. Each of these elementals pursues its own interests vigorously with little, if any, care for order on either its home plane or the Prime Material Plane.

name: Elemental of Law, Air/Earth
summary: The elementals of law are intelligent creatures native to one of the four elemental planes.

name: Elemental of Law, Fire/Water
summary: The elementals of law are intelligent creatures native to one of the four elemental planes.

name: Elemental, Composite
summary: The tempest is a living storm which appears as a dark storm cloud of comparatively small size. Human or bestial features can often be seen in the roiling vapors of the tempest.

name: Elemental, Fire Kin, Tome Guardian
summary: The tome guardian (sometimes mistakenly heard and passed on as “tomb guardian”) is a creature of the Elemental Plane of Fire.

name: Elemental, Negative Energy
summary: Negative energy elementals are so named because they are composed of the “material” of their home: the Negative Energy Plane. They appear as vaguely humanoid sheets of ebony flame.

name: Elemental, Quasi, Positive, Mineral, Glomus
summary: The glomus is one of the many unusual creatures encountered on the quasielemental plane of Mineral, and only on the rarest of occasions is it encountered away from its native plane.

name: Elemental, Water Kin
summary: Many a male has thrown his life away for the fleeting embrace of the “honeyed ones”, the beautiful nereids from the elemental plane of Water.

name: Elephant Bird
summary: The elephant bird is a man-sized bird with green plumage and a yellowish, cruel-looking, curved beak. They have a strange, protruding gullet dangling from their throats.

name: Elf
summary: Though their lives span several human generations, elves appear at first glance to be frail when compared to man. However, elves have a number of special talents that more than make up for their slightly weaker constitutions.

name: Elf (Athas)
summary: The elves of Athas are perhaps the most prolific non-city-dwelling race of demihumans east of the Ringing Mountains. Though many of the tribes follow different customs, all elves have one thing in common – a propensity for raiding and warfare.

name: Elf, Grugach
summary: The grugach are wild elves, akin to sylvan or wood elves, but smaller, lighter, and very pale. When not in their tribal bands, they dress in leather armor decorated with the shapes of leaves or of the animals of the deep forest.

name: Elf, High, Silvanesti
summary: Of the all elven races known, the Silvanesti is the oldest.

name: Elf, Sea, Dargonesti
summary: Dargonesti are a race of shy and reclusive sea elves, also known as Deep Elves.

name: Elf, Sea, Dimernesti
summary: Dimernesti, also known as Shoal Elves, are a proud and secretive race of sea elves.

name: Elf, Valley
summary: Whether a separate race of elvenkind or simply an offshoot of gray elves, the elves of the Valley of the Mage have distinctive features and characteristics.

name: Elf, Wild, Kagonesti
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Forests and plains
summary: Kagonesti (Wild Elves) rejected the civilized trappings of their cousins, the Qualinesti and Silvanesti, to establish their own wilderness settlements.

name: Elghonn
summary: The elghonn is one of the most powerful predators of the Underdark. Not much is known about this legendary creature.

name: Elmarin
summary: The creatures called elmarin resemble living St. Elmo's fire.

name: Eltab, Abyssal Lord, Tanar'ri
summary: Eltab is an ancient and powerful abyssal lord who has ravaged this region of Faerûn on many occasions. Legends call him the Lord of the Hidden Layer and he holds many other titles in the Abyss.

name: Emerald Dragon
summary: Emerald dragons are very curious, particularly about local history and customs, but prefer to only observe. They are the most paranoid of the gem dragons, and do not like people get too close to their treasure.

name: Enduk
summary: Originally from the Savage Coast, these winged minotaurs were driven from their lands on the Orc's Head Peninsula and have only recently returned.

name: Enhanced Scaladar
summary: Scaladar are scorpion-like automatons created by the archmage Trobriand, and are the most successful and useful of his artificial creations. The scaladar are generally used to guard strongholds or treasure in the many levels of Undermountain.

name: Ennui (Greater Dream Spawn)
summary: Ennui are greater dream spawn who serve the members of the Nightmare Court, actively controlling events occurring in dreamscapes while their masters are otherwise occupied.

name: Entrope
summary: There are holes throughout the multiverse. Call them conduits, portals or any other name, they're still holes.

name: Ephemeral
summary: Ephemerals are noncorporeal undead believed to be the spirits of individuals who have died in the phlogiston.

name: Equinal (Guardinal)
summary: Equinals are one of the two most common types of guardinals. They resemble huge humans with some of the qualities of a draft horse.

name: Erdland
summary: Erdlands are a large variant of the erdlus and are commonly encountered in herds in the Athasian plains. Used as mounts or to pull caravans, erdland are a common sight along the trader routes through the deserts of Athas.

name: Erinyes (Lesser Baatezu)
summary: Erinyes, most unusual of the baatezu, do not appear gruesome or disgusting but attractive, a fitting characteristic considering their mission.

name: Ermordenung
summary: The ermordenung are a dark and evil people found almost exclusively in the domain of Borca. Here, they act as elite agents who serve Ivana Boritsi, the ruler of that dread domain.

name: Ermordenung (Nostalia Romaine)
summary: Nostalia Romaine is the head of Ivana Boritsi's dreaded ermordenung. She is as evil as she is ravishing, and utterly loyal to her evil mistress.

name: Errtu (Balor tanar'ri)
summary: Errtu, one of the most terrible of all tanar'ri, is repulsive and loathsome to behold.

name: Esperweed
summary: Esperweed is a plant that grows in the few remaining tropical areas of Athas, as well as on some of the mudflats surrounding the Sea of Silt. A fairly rare plant by nature, esperweed is sought after by many for its psionic boosting powers.

name: Esthetic
summary: An esthetic is a biological, symbiotic creation of the reigar; it is used for transportation. It is essentially a living craft, capable of self-sustenance for unlimited time.

name: Ether Horse
summary: Just like horses were disseminated to new continents and worlds by early explorers on the Prime, giant sea horses were brought to the Ethereal long ago to serve as mounts.

name: Ethyk
summary: An ethyk is a small mammalian creature similar in size and habits to a lemur, but with the ability to mentally influence the actions of other creatures.

name: Ettercap
summary: Ettercaps are ugly bipedal creatures that get along very well with all types of giant spiders.

name: Ettin
summary: Ettins, or two-headed giants, as they are often called, are vicious and unpredictable hunters that stalk by night and eat any meat they can catch.

name: Evil Treant (Blackroot)
summary: The domain of Tepest has long suffered under the evil of the three hags who rule it. Their wickedness has seeped into the land, permeating it and poisoning even the plants and beasts of the forests.

name: Examiner (Abomination)
summary: An examiner is a 4-foot diameter sphere with no central eye and only four small eyes, each at the end of an antenna, mounted atop the sphere. They have one small, lamprey-like mouth on their ventral surface.

name: Executioner's Raven
summary: Sigil's only two native birds are a gray-green pigeon and a type of graybodied raven with black wings and head. The latter's called the executioner's raven because of its fondness for the easy meals found at the block, gallows, and stake.

name: Eye of the Deep (Beholder-kin)
summary: This is a water breathing version of the beholder, and dwells only at great depths, floating slowly about, stalking prey.

name: Eyewing
summary: Eyewings are loathsome inhabitants of the Abyss. They are obedient, loyal, and dumb – perfect servitors for the dark gods and their more powerful minions.

name: Facet
summary: War is imminent on the Inner Planes, but most folks don't know it yet. A force of great power grows within the Quasielemental Plane of Salt.

name: Fachan
summary: The fachan is a roughly humanoid creature that haunts the rugged hills and mountains of Scotland.

name: Fachan (Savage Coast)
summary: This unusual creature looks grotesque even compared to other ogres. Its vaguely humanoid body possesses only one leg, one arm, and one eye.

name: Fachan (Toril)
summary: The fachan is physically one of the Realms. most unusual creatures.

name: Fael
summary: Faels are ravenous undead beings who never quenched their need for material consumption during life. They are animated in undeath to continue their feeding.

name: Faerie Dragon (Dragonet)
summary: A chaotic offshoot of the pseudodragon, the faerie dragon lives in peaceful, tangled forests and thrives on pranks, mischief, and practical jokes.

name: Faerie Fiddler (Faerie)
summary: The faerie fiddler is a strange icon of faerie society. Always found in a community of faeries, there is never more than one faerie fiddler per community.

name: Faerie Phiz
summary: The faerie phiz is a mystical entity similar in nature to a treant or galeb duhr. The faerie phiz is a magical being found exclusively in sylvan woods and faerie settings, or in the kingdoms of elves.

name: Faerie Unicorn
summary: Faerie unicorns have a green tint to their white fur and horns, and all have bright green eyes. They are smaller than other unicorns (3-4' tall).

name: Faerie, Petty
summary: It is believed that squeakers were created by a wizard spell gone bad. These humanoids have disproportionately large heads and spindly bodies.

name: Fafnir
summary: Fafnir was the son of the dwarf king Hreidmar. He killed his father for the king's treasure, then ran off and hid so he wouldn't have to share it with his brother Regin.

name: Fainil (Night Flyer)
summary: The Fainil and Telvar originated on the same world, a planet known as Tir. The deadly conflict between the gray elves and drow on Tir occurred shortly after the world was created.

name: Falmadaraatha (Fal)
summary: The Falmadaraatha (or “Fal” for short) are huge, slug-like creatures that dwell inside hollow, lifeless asteroids. They are among several races that share the title “scholars of wildspace”.

name: Familiar, Undead
summary: An undead familiar is a sinister being that is created whenever a wizard is directly responsible for the death of his own familiar.

name: Farcluun, the Dragon
Father Bernadette's Mummy
summary: Father Bernadette's mummy is an undead creature created by an evil deity in response to a prayer by a frustrated villager. Its purpose is to cause calamity to the Muslich winery of Barlox.

name: Faux Faerie
summary: The faux faerie has a mission and goal to its life: to misdirect and lie to as many creatures as possible. It is quite happy in its life's work, and delights in finding new and novel ways to lie and mislead others.

name: Fearweed (Plant)
summary: Fearweeds are terrible plants that use mind-numbing terror and confusion to defend themselves. Anyone exposed to their pollen risks confrontation with nightmares worse than any they have ever imagined.

name: Feathered Serpent
summary: Feathered serpents are evil creatures with a snakelike, winged body and a human head. These scaled, feathered predators prefer warmer climates and favor underground lairs.

name: Feeblestar
summary: Feeblestars are small, five-legged starfish found only in the deeper parts of the ocean. Gray-green in color, they are about four inches in diameter from leg tip to leg tip when fully grown.

name: Feesu
summary: Feesu are large, space-going moths that travel in swarms that are a great nuisance to space travellers. Many spelljamming sailors consider them bad luck, with good reason.

name: Feliquine
summary: These half-feline and half-equine creatures have the head and front claws of a lion and the hindquarters of a horse. Most are colored like lions, though spotted specimens (appaloosas) are not unknown.

name: Fenette
summary: Oftentimes the bereaved need explanations for the deaths of their loved ones, and if there is no logical explanation presents itself, a fantastic solution will be invented.

name: Feng Huang
summary: The feng huang, also known as the oriental phoenix, is perhaps the most magnificent of all feathered creatures. It is aloof, arrogant, and self-absorbed, fully cognizant of its own great beauty and awesome power.

name: Fenhound
summary: Misty moors and steaming peat bogs have always been places where men feared to tread at night. Obviously, such places can be treacherous and deadly.

name: Fenris Wolf
summary: This huge wolf is the offspring of Loki and a giantess, Angur-boda. Due to an agreement among the gods not to slay each other's offspring, the wolf cannot be killed.

name: Fensir
summary: Also called Ysgardian trolls, the fensir are creatures peculiar to Ysgard and are completely unrelated to the trolls on the Prime. Fensir are more cultured and intelligent than the prime-material creatures of the same name.

name: Fetch
summary: Fetch are harbingers of death. Existing on the fringes of the Abyss, these creatures can only reach into the Prime Material plane through reflective surfaces, such as mirrors or pools of water.

name: Fetish Spirits
climateTerrain: Any structure or area where crimes are punished and sentences handed down
summary: Fetish spirits are malicious little spirits, prone to sycophantic adoration of those who bind or own them, that are created by a combination of the wishes of those who use the law to advance their own selfish desires over justice, and those who feel they've been wronged by the law.

name: Feylaar

name: Feyr
summary: Feyrs (pronounced “fears”) are created from the remnants of ordinary nightmares, mixed with residual magical energies, and unknowingly brought to life by the strong emotions of a large group of people.

name: Feystag
summary: Feystags are often whispered of in woodcutters' tales, for their mastery over magic makes them fearsome opponents. These creatures can run on all fours or stand erect.

name: Fhoimorien (Giant)
summary: Like other Cerilian giants, the fhoimoriens are elemental creatures, closely tied to the earth. They are extremely fond of launching raids into nearby lands.

name: Fhorge
summary: The fhorge (FOUR-jay), a particularly large and vicious cousin of the boar, lives in the wilder areas of the outlands and some of the outer planes.

name: Fiend Knight
summary: The Fiend Knights of Doom are an elite squad of warriors created from normal men by spellcraft on the part of both Ivid V himself, and Xaene, and also using mind-controlling magics crafted from baatezu relics.

name: Fiend, Water Lord
summary: These creatures usually inhabit the watery parts of all planes, content in their power over all things of the sea.

name: Figurine, Crystal
summary: Crystal figurines are delicate statuettes created by the finest craftsmen and imbued with life by magical means. They are often employed as guards or assassins by those who manufacture them.

name: Figurine, Obsidian
summary: Obsidian figurines, though they are in many ways the weakest of the five types of figurines, are the most surprising.

name: Figurine, Porcelain
summary: Of all the magical figurines fashioned in Sri Raji, those crafted of porcelain are by far the strongest and most fearsome.

name: Firbolg
summary: Of all the giant-kin, the firbolg is the most powerful, due to natural intelligence and considerable magical power.

name: Fire Bat
summary: As if the concept of animentals wasn't interesting and strange enough, the intriguing little fire bats take things a step further. They've evolved.

name: Fire Drake (Athas)
summary: Fire drakes are the most evil and malicious of the drakes. They enjoy inflicting pain for the pleasure of watching their victims writhe in agony.

name: Fire Elemental
summary: Fire elementals can be conjured in any area containing a large open flame.

name: Fire Falcon
summary: The fire falcon is a small russet-colored raptor, found in areas well away from those settled by man. It seeks only to be left in peace by large creatures, including man.

name: Fire Giant
summary: They are tall, but squat, resembling huge dwarves. An adult male is 18 feet tall, has a 12-foot chest, and weighs about 7,500 pounds.

name: Fire Kin (Elemental)
summary: Salamanders are natives of the elemental plane of Fire, and thus they thrive in hot places. These cruel, evil creatures come to the Prime Material plane for reasons known only to them.

name: Fire Mephit
summary: The most mischievous of all mephits, these fiends play terrible pranks on other mephits, such as pushing magma mephits into water and watching them harden.

name: Fire Minion
summary: Fire minions are fearsome creatures, apparently from the elemental plane of Fire. Their bodies are composed of living flame, and although they can assume any form they wish, the most common is that of a large humanoid, complete with fangs and homs.

name: Fire Troll
summary: A fire troll is a tall, thick-limbed humanoid with smooth, blood-red skin. Within its sunken sockets, its eyes glow a fierce yellow, and its hair is a tangled mass of vibrant oranges and yellows.

name: Firebird
summary: Firebirds match the description of giant eagles – 10-20' wingspan, large claws, sharp hooked beak – but they are not as intelligent, and a beautiful orange-yellow flame envelops them. Their eyes glow a painfully bright blue-white.

name: Firedrake (Dragonet)
summary: Although frequently mistaken on first sighting for a young red dragon, the firedrake is neither as intelligent nor as powerful as its dragon cousin. It responds with flame to any stimulus.

name: Firelich
summary: Firelichs are high-level evil mages whose bodies were prepared for lichdom upon their death. Such mages, either through ignorance (such as in casting fire spells) or spell failure, exploded in the phlogiston.

name: Firenewt
summary: Firenewts, also known as salamen, are distant relatives of lizard men. They are cruel marauders that roam hot regions.

name: Fireshadow
summary: The fireshadow is a creature from the Abyss that can be summoned to the Prime Material plane by an 8th-level or higher evil cleric, but only if the cleric's deity approves and aids the summoning.

name: Firestar
summary: Firestars, also known as the moon dancers, are tiny glowing beings that roam forests and hills, and generally ignore travelers. They appear as silent, floating fist-sized motes of light, and are frequently mistaken for will o'wisps or torches.

name: Firetail
summary: The nature of this creature has made it a being of awe and legend in the Realms. The firetail appears as a frolicsome fey creature of living flame, that loops and darts dazzlingly in the air, bewitching those who gaze upon it.

name: Firethorn (Dangerous Plant)
summary: The firethorn, or sea rose, is a rare plant which only grows along tropical or subtropical sea coasts. The only place it is known to grow in abundance is on some of the islands of Zakhara.

name: Fireweed
summary: This strange, heat-absorbing plant grows in sections of the Underdark that even fungi find too harsh to survive. While it is not a threat to most adventuring parties, it can change the terrain, making volcanic regions survivable.

name: Firre (Greater Eladrin)
summary: It shouldn't be any surprise that there are eladrins who devote themselves to art, music, and magic.

name: Fish (Athas)
summary: Kreel are peaceful creatures, and they will only fight to defend themelves.

name: Fish, Chandos
summary: These omnivorous fish tend to be long and thin, with a thick spiny ridge down their vertebrae. Their scales are usually dark blonde or white in color.

name: Flailer
summary: Flailers are solitary creatures that live in the rocky terrain near the tablelands of Athas. To frequent travelers of these areas, flailers serve as a constant reminder of the harsh dangers of life on Athas.

name: Flame Linnorm Dragon
summary: Flame linnorms, the most beautiful of the Norse dragons and perhaps the most rare, live to bend others to their will and to accumulate wealth.

name: Flame Spirit
summary: Like their cousins, fire elementals, flame spirits are native to the Elemental Plane of Fire. Flame spirits appear on the Prime Material Plane only if they have been summoned by magical means.

name: Flame Swallow
summary: Flame swallows are magnificent, graceful birds similar in appearance to terrestrial swallows, except that their wingspan is often five feet or more. They have the same forked tail as swallows.

name: Flameskull
summary: Flameskulls are rare undead guardian creatures. These magically powered flying skulls are fashioned from human heads soon after their owners' deaths.

name: Flareater
summary: Flareaters, some of the most deadly underground denizens, appear to be related to green slime – they may be green slime altered into new forms and given intelligence by magical experiments.

name: Flawder
summary: Flawder are peaceful, snail-like nomads which live in aquatic environments. They look much like upright snails, but do not have spiral shells.

name: Fleas of Madness
summary: While the normal flea is a parasitic pest that has plagued mankind since the dawn of time, its Ravenloft cousin is a terrible curse. By comparison.

name: Flesh Golem (Ravenloft)
summary: Stitched together from the collected body parts of various corpses, flesh golems have a horrific appearance. Contrary to old movies, they are not flat headed, nor do they have bolts in the side of their necks.

name: Floater
summary: Floaters are small, aerial, jelly fish that drift above the Sea of Silt. They are often found at the edges of the silt sea, near the mudflats that form its perimeter.

name: Floating Helm
summary:
The Helm is just that: an old, heavy helm that can fly, of the sort worn by human knights twice as tall and four times
as wide and heavy. It drifts about, quite empty, roaming streets and sewers at night, and it is a formidable opponent.

name: Flow Barnacle
climateTerrain: Phlogiston, wildspace, drifting, or on ships and other solid bodies
summary: So named because they are primarily encountered in phlogiston, these hard-shelled, unintelligent creatures fasten themselves limpet-like to the surface of any object they encounter - be it ship, rogue planetoid, or drifting being, and slowly eat into it.

name: Flowfiend
summary: Sometimes travellers between crystal spheres fall (or are thrown) into the phlogiston flow. Most simply calcify.

name: Flumph
summary: Flumph resemble aerial jellyfish. These odd creatures are round and almost flat, perhaps the or four inches thick in the center, tapering to one or two inches near the edge.

name: Flying fingers
summary: Flying fingers are Crawling claws that can fly, for more information see the Crawling Claws entry.

name: Focoid
summary: Focoids are a severe navigational hazard near the brighter stars of the Known Sphere.

name: Fog Giant
climateTerrain: Temperate/Swamps, marshes, boggy forests, and coastal regions
summary: Cousins to the cloud giants, these large rock-hurlers are more intelligent and stealthy than portrayed in story or song.

name: Fogwarden
summary: The fogwarden is a solitary creature that inhabits the cold, icy fogs or arctic, subarctic, and extremly cold areas of temperate zones. It feeds on strong emotions, especially the fear it creates in the victims it terrorizes.

name: Fomorian (Giant)
summary: Fomorians are the most hideous, deformed, and wicked of all giant-kin.

name: Foo Creature
summary: Foo creatures are powerful extraplanar entities that can sometimes be convinced to serve or guard humans of good alignment.

name: Fordorran

name: Forest Linnorm Dragon
summary: A forest linnorm resembles a huge, grotesque snake more than a dragon. Its body is a mottled green and brown that masks its form in forest undergrowth.

name: Forest Ray
summary: The forest ray, also known as the “forest devil”, is a dark green creature that looks like a flying manta-ray. They live in forests, jungles, or other areas of heavy undergrowth, such as the forested areas of the Orc's Head Peninsula and Herath.

name: Fossergrim
summary: Fossergrim resemble normal men, save that they live in waterfalls and are never found more than a mile away from the one which they inhabit.

name: Foulwing
summary: Foulwings are grotesquely misshapen flying predators, thought to have originated on another plane.

name: Fraal
summary: The fraal are thin humanioids, averaging about five feet in height. They can be distinguished by their large eyes, their pale, almost luminous skin, their swept-back ears, and their round heads.

name: Fractine
summary: Fractines appear as two-dimensional, mirrored, trapezoidal planes. When at rest, fractines resemble vast mirrors and can be manipulated to function as excellent scrying mirrors.

name: Frelón
summary: The frelón were originally created by dragons to serve a specific function: to seek and destroy the hated araneas. They have since grown beyond this function, evolving into mysterious, yet very dangerous, creatures.

name: Frog
summary: Giant frogs resemble their more common relatives in everything but size. Their enormous size means that they consider larger creatures as a source of food, making small creatures and even demihumans possible prey.

name: Froghemoth
summary: This giant amphibian horror lurks in the darkest swamps and dankest subterranean pools.

name: Frost
summary: Often called snow fairies, snow sprites, or winter folk, these small, mischievous beings inhabit dense forests, migrating to cooler regions as the seasons dictate. Frosts are tiny elfin creatures with whirring, beelike wings.

name: Frost Giant
summary: Frost giants have muscular, roughly human builds. The typical adult male is 21' tall and weighs about 8,000 pounds.

name: Frost Linnorm Dragon
summary: Frost linnorms are perhaps the most territorial of all Norse dragons, never resting until all other intelligent creatures within their domains are destroyed.

name: Frost Salamander
summary: Frost salamanders, natives of the Paraelemental Plane of Ice, thrive in very cold places. They are sometimes found on other elemental planes and may find themselves summoned to the Prime Material Plane.

name: Fundamental, Air/Earth
summary: Among the least powerful creatures inhabiting the elemental planes are the fundamentals. Each of these creatures resembles a pair of bat-like wings without a head or body.

name: Fundamental, All Elements
summary: Fundamentals are the weakest of the true elemental creatures (as opposed to other creatures native to the Elemental Planes). Still, no one knows the real dark of their nature, purpose, or how they fit into the mysterious scheme of the Inner Planes.

name: Fundamental, Fire/Water
summary: Among the least powerful creatures inhabiting the elemental planes are the fundamentals. Each of these creatures resembles a pair of bat-like wings without a head or body.

name: Fundamental, Negative
summary: Negative fundamentals are weakly empowered manifestations of the Negative Energy Plane. They resemble pairs of flapping bat-like wings devoid of bodies, heads, or other features.

name: Fungifolk
summary: Born of an arcane mixture of the worst features of the Zhakar dwarves and the most poisonous, chaotically-growing fungi in the dark reaches of the warrens, these hideous creatures have evolved to the point where they are mobile, and ready to expand their domains.

name: Funno
summary: The funno is an unremarkable-looking animal; at first glance, it is difficult to believe that the people of Chorane could not survive without them.

name: Furies
summary: The Furies are three malicious creatures who strive to prevent the redemption of Ravenloft's evil denizens. These foul sisters wander the Demiplane of Dread seeking those who would turn away from the path of evil.

name: Furnace Golem
summary: The furnace golem is a specialized form of iron golem that weighs 6,000 lbs. It is otherwise like its cousin in appearance.

name: Fyrefly
summary: The fyrefly is a large, slow-moving black insect with red wings and reddish eyes. It is normally a benign insect which flits from plant to plant, eating leaves and rotting vegetation.

name: Gacholoth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: Gacholoths are the infiltrators and terrorists of the Blood War. They use their abilities to cause havoc and spread panic behind enemy lines.

name: Gadabout
summary: Spacefaring elves use this small winged plant as personal conveyance for short-distance travel outside a spelljammer's air envelope, such as boarding actions between ships, or as emergency life-support.

name: Gahonga
summary: The gahonga are a race of short, tangible spirits that inhabit bodies of water and rocks. Though neutral in alignment, the men are generally foul-tempered and reluctant to help strangers.

name: Gaj
climateTerrain: Sands, stony barrens, rocky badlands, and islands
summary: The gaj is a psionic horror. Physically, it appears as a large reptile resembling a beetle in appearance.

name: Gaki
summary: Gaki are lesser spirits derived from the wicked, who have returned to the Prime Material Plane in the form of horrible monsters as punishment for their sins. The name “gaki” refers to a variety of such spirits.

name: Galeb Duhr
