summary: The galeb duhr is a curious boulder-like creature with appendages that act as hands and feet. These intelligent beings are very large and slow-moving.

name: Gambado
summary: Known by the folk name of “springing skulls of doom”, these creatures construct a lair and ambush passersby. Gambados are completely amoral, caring only for their own survival, their next meal, and their personal treasure.

name: Gammaroid
summary: The gammaroid is a gargantuan variety of the giant snapping turtle. Like its terrestrial cousin, it has a voracious appetite and rules any territory it occupies.

name: Garbug
summary: Garbugs are apparently related to carrion crawlers. They have six tentacles around their mouths and insectoid wings on their backs.

name: Gargantua
summary: Gargantua are truly monstrous species, both in size and ferocity. Whether they are throwbacks to another age, aberrations of natural processes, or results of crazed magical experiments is unknown.

name: Gargantua (Mystara)
summary: The gargantua of Mystara are extremely large and powerful specimens of other monstrous species. Such creatures horrify characters chancing upon them due to both their size and their ferocity.

name: Gargantuan Praying Mantis
summary: This creature is a courageous but stupid predator, appearing identical to the praying mantis found on the planet Toril, only larger-much larger.

name: Gargouille
climateTerrain: Temperate or tropical saltwater or freshwater
summary:
The gargouille is a sea dragon resembling a prehistoric
mosasaur (such as the Tylosaurus of Cretaceous seas). It is one
of the most terrible of all aquatic monsters.

name: Gargoyle
summary: These monsters are ferocious predators of a magical nature, typically found amid ruins or dwelling in underground caverns. They have their own guttural language.

name: Gargoyle, Guardgoyle
summary: Guardgoyles are created by Zhentarim wizards to guard their treasures, families, residences, and secret locations that the wizards hold dear. Guardgoyles are constructed like golems, but are much easier to fabricate.

name: Garigal
summary: Looking like a dusky blue armored caterpillar, the garigal (ga-REE-jall) is the most puzzling of the garradalaighs because of its mode of travel. Though it moves quickly over nearly any type of terrain, it has no legs.

name: Garm
summary: Garm is a huge dog with a disproportionately large head. He guards the entrance to the cavern Gniper, where Helvig, the long and troublesome road to Nifleheim, begins.

name: Garmorm
summary: Few sounds are as terrible and wonderful as the song of the Garmorm sung by the creature itself. A garmorm is a roundish, limbless beast with a huge, tooth-filled maw.

name: Gaumahavi, Greater Purple Dragon
summary: Gaumahavi is a unique type of dragon. Though her long, snaky form is similar in appearance to that of an oriental dragon, she has little in common with them.

name: Gaund
summary: Gaund are gray-green reptilian creatures with three glowing red eyes and are often mistaken for large lizards by adventurers. They are intelligent, but spend most of their time on all fours.

name: Gauth (Beholder-kin)
summary: The Gauth is a relative of the beholder that feeds on magic. Its spherical body is 5 feet in diameter and brown in color, mottled with purple and gray.

name: Gautiere
summary: The gautiere are gaunt, gray-skinned humanoids with clawed hands and pointed teeth. They wrap themselves in rags and strips of whatever cloth or hide they can find to protect themselves from the stinging, flesh-rending winds of Minethys.

name: Gear Spirit
summary: Gear spirits come in many different forms, but their function remains the same: to tend the great gears of Mechanus and to ensure that they run smoothly. Unlike modrons, gear spirits are individuals who have tasks and specific gears assigned to them.

name: Geckonid
summary: Small, quick, brightly-colored, and curious, geckonids are the friendliest of the lizard peoples. Soft, interconnecting scales of green, blue, red, and brown cover their skin.

name: Gehreleth
summary: Among the forbidden books in the library of Everhaite is a text on gehreleth society, The Three Bodies of Evil by Carlvian Everhaite, an otherwise anonymous drow wizard.

name: Geist
summary: A geist is the undead spirit of a person. It resembles a ghost or haunt, but is relatively harmless.

name: Gelatinous Stalker
summary: The creature resembles a gelatinous cube except in shape.

name: Gello Monster
summary: The gello monster is a variant of the gelatinous cube.

name: Gelugon (Greater Baatezu)
summary: Gelugons are ferocious baatezu that live in frigid Caina. They look alien, with 12-foot insectlike bodies, claws on hands and feet, and sharp pincers at the mouth.

name: Gemstone Golem
summary: So far, only three major types of gemstone golems have been created in Faerûn – ruby, emerald, and diamond.

name: Genie, Tasked, Administrator
summary: Tasked administrator genies serve in bureaucracies, both for other genies and for humans, acting as advisors, negotiators, and all-around bureaucrats, and they often act for their masters in day-to-day decision making.

name: Genie, Tasked, Deceiver
summary: Deceiver genies are servants of noble djinn and sometimes the most powerful of jann. They themselves are djinn perverted to a life of deception, sworn to mask the face of the world.

name: Genie, Tasked, Harim Servant
summary: Harim servant genies serve many purposes. They guard the women of a harim, but also entertain them and perform minor tasks around the harim area.

name: Genie, Tasked, Messenger
summary: Messenger genies were once djinn, but now serve all genies equally, flitting from plane to plane bearing messages, gifts, treaties, letters, documents, and love letters between noble genies of the various realms.

name: Genie, Tasked, Miner
summary: Miner genies are a recent form of tasked genie, employed by the dao, though they were apparently created by evil wizards.

name: Genie, Tasked, Oathbinder
summary: Oathbinder genies are reshaped efreet devoted to maintaining solemn oaths sworn between their masters and any consenting sentient being. If the oaths are broken, the oathbinder genie punishes the oathbreaker according to the terms of the vow.

name: Geonid
summary: Geonids – small, intelligent cave-dwellers – live and hunt in clans within tunnel complexes or natural cave systems.

name: Ghaele (Greater Eladrin)
summary: The ghaeles are the knights errant of the eladrins. Wherever evil and tyranny raise their ugly heads, the ghaeles respond.

name: Ghast Ghoul (Jugo Hesketh)
summary: Long ago, Hesketh was a senior priest in the cult of the false god Zhakata led by Yagno Petrovna, the lord of G'henna.

name: Ghaunadan (Ooze/Slime/Jelly)
summary: These vile, intelligent beasts are the loyal servants of Ghaunadaur, the god of oozes, slimes, and jellies. Ghaunadan are intelligent oozes that have full control of their semiliquid bodies.

name: Ghost
summary: Ghosts are the spirits of humans who were either so greatly evil in life or whose deaths were so unusually emotional they have been cursed with the gift of undead status. Thus, they roam about at night or in places of darkness.

name: Ghost Dragon
climateTerrain: Subterranean/cave-dwelling in almost any climate and terrain
summary: A ghost dragon is a sinister-looking, semi-transparent figure. It resembles whatever dragon type it was in life.

name: Ghost Mount
summary: Ghost mountsare undead creatures which can help desperate or foolish travelers cover vast distances, but at a price.

name: Ghost Pack
summary: Ghost packs are the remnants of great packs of predators made extinct by the spread of civilization. They continue to hunt their mortal lands, regardless of the changes to the area.

name: Ghostlight
summary: A ghostlight's a clever and malicious thing. It's an intangible ball of energy or light closely related to the will-o'-wisp of the Prime Material Plane, but the ghostlight's powers and unending hunger make it even more dangerous than its cousin.

name: Ghostly Horde
summary: A ghostly horde consists of the psychological remnants of an army that met a sudden or catastrophtc defeat. The horde is created by the losers' overwhelming desire to complete their task, whatever that may have been.

name: Ghoul
summary: Ghouls are undead creatures, once human, who now feed on the flesh of corpses. Although the change from human to ghoul has deranged and destroyed their minds, ghouls have a terrible cunning which enables them to hunt their prey most effectively.

name: Ghoul (Lankhmar)
summary: Nehwon ghouls are considerably different from their AD&D® game namesakes and from the animalistic species of the Kleshite jungles. They are almost totally transparent, save for their pinkish skeletons.

name: Ghoul Frog
summary: A ghoul frog appears to be some sort of zombified creature, but it is not. Its skin is translucent, revealing the skeleton, muscles, and internal organs.

name: Ghoul Lord
summary: It is hard to imagine a more frightening creature than the dreaded ghoul lord.

name: Ghriest
summary: This large flying creature spends its entire life in the air, hunting the skies over the Savage Coast.

name: Ghul-Kin
summary: The ghul-kin are related to the great ghuls, and like them are undead jann. Unlike their cousins, ghul-kin are differentiated into two distinct types, Soultakers and Witherers.

name: Ghuls
summary: The great ghuls are undead elemental cousins of the genies, the most wicked members of an inferior order of jann. They haunt burial grounds and feed on dead human bodies.

name: Giant (Athas)
summary: The giants of Athas are huge, lumbering creatures who commonly inhabit the islands of the Sea of Silt. The most common varieties are the desert giants, the plains giants, and the psionics-wielding beasthead giants.

name: Giant (Cerilia)
summary: Several varieties of giant live in the wilder areas of Cerilia. For the most part, they prefer to leave their smaller neighbors alone, minding their own business and expecting others to do the same.

name: Giant Ant Lion
climateTerrain: Tropical and temperate/Mountains, hills, and plains
summary: The ant lion is a huge, vicious insect that lurks in the bottom of deep pits, feeding on creatures unlucky enough to fall in. Ant lions live in badlands, desert fringes, and other areas with loose soil and sand.

name: Giant Beetle
summary: Giant beetles are similar to their more ordinary counterparts, but thousands of times larger – with chewing mandibles and hard wings that provide substantial armor protection.

name: Giant Bladderwort
summary: The giant bladderwort is a rootless, freefloating water plant found drifting just beneath the surface of stagnant waters in deep marshes or swamps.

name: Giant Butterwort
summary: The giant butterwort grows in rosettes of 2-8 6'-long oblong leaves of pale yellowgreen, having a greasy appearance and a faint, funguslike scent.

name: Giant Clam
summary: Giant clams (including oysters, scallops, and similar shellfish) are found in shallow water, to a maximum depth of 200 feet. The soft-bodied mollusk lives in a hard, protective shell that it opens for feeding and closes against predators.

name: Giant Crustacean
summary: Giant crustaceans are peculiar mutations of crabs and freshwater crayfish. The first inhabits saltwater regions, while the latter is found only in fresh water.

name: Giant Damselfish
summary: This fish has a bony head and a slim, dull, dun-colored body. A specially modified dorsal fin trails a streamer that vaguely resembles a humanlike female.

name: Giant Fish
summary: Giant fish are a diverse group of creatures with varying attack and defense capabilities. While fish are all basically waterdwellers, some have the ability to survive out of water and breath atmospheric oxygen.

name: Giant Jellyfish (Mystara)
summary: Each variety of these huge, nearly transparent creatures possesses stinging tentacles up to 100 feet long. The tentacles look like weeds hanging down in the water, but these giant jellyfish can manipulate their tentacles to attack prey.

name: Giant Ogre
summary: Aside from their phenomenal size, ogre giants have more in common with ogres and ogre magi than they do with "true" giants (such as hill, stone, and jungle varieties). Ogre magi and other solitary beings may use ogre giants as guardians.

name: Giant Rainbow Plant
climateTerrain: Temperate and tropical forests and swamps
summary: The giant rainbow plant has a woody, trunklike stem from which grow 5-20 branchlike leaves that each end in a knobby tip. The stem grows up to 10' in height, with each leaf half the height of the plant in length.

name: Giant Scarab Beetle
summary: Scarab beetles are black- or brown-shelled beetles, familiar to many as the beetles adorning Egyptian amulets. In the underdark, they survive on bat guano and cave crickets, but they are not averse to a change of diet.

name: Giant Sea Horse
summary: Giant sea horses are simply a huge species of the more common sea horse. They have the characteristic horse-like heads and tapering tails of all sea horses.

name: Giant Skeleton
summary: Giant skeletons are similar to the more common undead skeleton, but they have been created with a combination of spells and are, thus, far more deadly than their lesser counterparts.

name: Giant Slug
summary: Giant slugs are huge, omnivorous mutations of the small and benign garden slugs. Their highly developed mouths are capable of chewing flesh and well as plants, and they spit a highly corrosive acid on their food.

name: Giant Squid
summary: Giant squids are huge varieties of the normal, peaceful, tentacled cephalopods (unshelled invertebrates).

name: Giant Starfish
summary: The giant starfish is a cousin of the normal, ocean-dwelling starfish. It has a central body of ten or 12 rays radiating from the center, the undersides of which are covered with sticky suckers.

name: Giant Strider
summary: These large, featherless, flightless birds are used as mounts by Firenewts.

name: Giant Turtle
summary: Giant turtles are simply huge varieties of the normal species encountered daily in the wild. They resemble their common counterparts in every respect except for size.

name: Giant Waterwheel Plant
summary: The giant waterwheel is a rootless plant that floats just below the water's surface, drifting with the currents.

name: Giant Worm
summary: These large pale worms have poisonous bite which causes 1d6 points of damage if a saving throw vs poison fails. - (Page 95 LNA2 Nehwon (9305))

name: Giant, Crag
summary: Crag giants are 25-foot-tall humanoids with thick black hair, rugged human features, and skin color ranging from dusky gray to stony brown.

name: Giant, Half-giant
summary: The half-giant is an enormous creature who has learned to adapt to the harsh life under the Athasian sun. No one knows when, or even why, the unlikely union between human and giant first occurred, giving birth to this unique species.

name: Giant, Shadow
summary: Shadow giants, or shadow people as they prefer to call themselves, are the descendants of the halflings who served Rajaat the Warbringer, during the Cleansing Wars. They appear either as shadowy, two-dimensional, vaguely humanoid-shaped silhouettes with ropy limbs, serpentine torsos, and blue embers in place of eyes, or as solid, three-dimensional shadows as tall as half-giants.

name: Gibbering Mouther
summary: The gibbering mouther is an amoeboid form of life composed entirely of mouth and eyes. With its eyes and mouths closed, it appears to be a lump of earthly material, surprising creatures that stumble across it.

name: Gibberling
summary: They come screaming, jabbering, and howling out of the night. Dozens, maybe hundreds, of hunchbacked, naked humanoids swarm unceasingly forward, brandishing short swords.

name: Giff
summary: The giff are a race of powerfully muscled mercenaries. They are civilized, though they lack mages among their own race.

name: Gigantes
summary: The Gigantes are a race of giants that Gaea gave birth to when the blood of her mutilated husband fell upon her earthly form. They are huge, man-like creatures with serpents for feet.

name: Gingwatzim
summary: Entities of synthetic origin, gingwatzim are blobs of raw life force. Those few that escaped their creator (a prime by the name of Castanamir) now reside on the Ethereal.

name: Gith
summary: The gith are a race of grotesque humanoids that appear to be a peculiar mixture of elf and reptile. They are extremely gaunt and lanky, with long gangling arms and spindly legs.

name: Gith Pirate
summary: When the githyanki, under their liberator, Gith, freed themselves from the yoke of mindflayer slavery, this branch of the race fled not to the Astral plane, but to arcane space.

name: Githyanki
summary: Githyanki are an ancient race descended from humans. They dwell upon the Astral plane but will often leave that plane to make war on other races.

name: Githzerai
summary: Githzerai are the monastic, chaotic neutral counterparts to the githyanki (q.v.).

name: Gk'lok-Lok
summary: The gk'lok-lok are a race of extraplanar creatures that spend their lives sleeping and dreaming, vicariously experiencing the lives of dead warriors of other races.

name: Glabrezu (True Tanar'ri)
summary: Glabrezu are the tanar'ri that typically respond to summonings from other planes. They go forth and secure power for their cause.

name: Gladiator Lizard
summary: This extremely rare creature is only found naturally on the Bleak Shore of Nehwon. Eggs of the gladiator lizard may occasionally be taken from the Bleak Shore and the hatchlings uses as guards or in zoos.

name: Glass and Gargoyle Golem
summary: The gargoyle golem is a stone construct designed to guard a given structure. It is roughly the same size and weight as a real gargoyle (6' tall and 550 pounds).

name: Gloom Raven
hitDice:
1 (2 at dusk or dawn)
hp 5 hp/die
summary: Gloom ravens (1d4+1): AC 6; MV 1, fly 27 (A); HD 1 (2 at dusk or dawn); hp 5 hp/die; THAC0 19; #AT 1; Dmg 1-2; SA eye peck (10% likely to attack an opponent's eye, 1-in-10 chance of plucking out an eye with a successful attack); SD never surprised, shadow images; SZ M (4' -6' wingspan); ML 12; INT low (5-7); AL N; XP 175.

name: Gloomwing Moth
summary: The creature commonly called the gloomwing is the adult stage of the tenebrous worm (see below). These huge moths are native to the demi-plane of Shadow.

name: Glouras
summary: The glouras is a rare faerie creature of the underdark, a gray-skinned humanoid creature with huge, moth-like wings, long fingers, sharp claws, and a mass of dark hair.

name: Gnasher
summary: Created by a master sorcerer ages ago, these creatures most closely resemble dogs, but their wolfish snouts sport many more razor-sharp teeth than their canine cousins, and there is a bristly tuft of hair that grows between their shoulders.

name: Gnasher, Winged
summary: These are slightly bigger cousins of normal gnashers, encountered only in areas with natural outcroppings of stone.

name: Gnoat (Centaur-kin)
climateTerrain: Temperate or tropical hill or mountain
summary: A gnoat has the upper body of a gnome and the lower body of a large mountain goat. Gnoats usually have brown skin, varying in shade from tan to a deep chestnut.

name: Gnoll
summary: Gnolls are large, evil, hyena-like humanoids that roam about in loosely organized bands.

name: Goatman
summary: A cross between a man and mountain goat, this creature is native to the Black Mountains east of the City-States, but it is becoming more and more common in the Savage Baronies.

name: Goblin
summary: These small, evil humanoids would be merely pests, if not for their great numbers.

name: Goblin (Cerilia)
summary: Goblins are common in Cerilia, controlling numerous kingdoms in the more desolate and dangerous parts of the land.

name: Goblin Rat
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate plain, forest, hill, and mountain
summary: The goblin rat is a repulsive, disease-ridden shapechanger and a cousin of the hengeyokai

name: Goblin Spider
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate mountains and forests
summary: The goblin spider, or earth spider, looks like a huge, furry spider of a particularly evil cast. It lurks in the wild, wooded mountains of Kara-Tur.

name: Goblin Vampire
summary: The goblin vampire is a rare form of undead creature. The creature is twice the size of a normal goblin.

name: Goblyn
summary: Goblyns are hideous creatures with slightly bloated heads, pointed ears, and glowing red eyes. They have long, mangy hair which grows only on the back of their head and necks.

name: Gohlbrorn (Bulette)
summary: The gohlbrorn, a relative of the fearsome bulette, hunts throughout the cavern complexes of the Underdark.

name: Gold Dragon
summary: Gold dragons are wise, judicious, and benevolent. They often embark on self-appointed quests to promote goodness, and are not easily distracted from them.

name: Golden Ammonite
summary: In oceanic abysses, where light never penetrates, lives a species of large-shelled mollusk that feeds upon the debris and minerals on the sea floor. Gold is extracted from the sludgy silt of the ocean floors that this monster consumes.

name: Golem (Athas) I
summary: Ash golems are grey in color, stand eight feet tall, and weigh only 150 pounds. As they move, ash golems leave a fine dusting of ash behind them, which makes tracking these creatures easy.

name: Golem (Athas) II
summary: Obsidian golems are massive statues, measuring 12 feet tall, and weighing up to 900 pounds. Their shape is humanoid.

name: Golem (Athas) III
summary: Sand golems are humanoid in shape and stand roughly eight feet tall. They have indentations where their eye sockets should be, though they have no actual eyes.

name: Golem (Athas), Magma
summary: Magma golems are forged by powerful wizards from the raw materials found in the Ring of Fire. They are comprised entirely of molten rock, weigh around 1600 pounds, and stand about 8' tall.

name: Golem (Mystara) I
summary: A golem is actually a “construct”, a powerful, enchanted monster created and animated by a high-level wizard or priest. The creatures can be made from almost any material.

name: Golem (Mystara) II
summary: A golem is actually a “construct”, a powerful, enchanted monster created and animated by a high-level wizard or priest. These creatures can be made from almost any material – in these cases, iron and mud.

name: Golem (Mystara) III
summary: A golem is actually a “construct”, a powerful, enchanted monster created and animated by a high-level wizard or priest. The creatures can be made from almost any material, including rock and silver.

name: Golem (Ravenloft)
summary: The mechanical golem is a nightmare combination of magic and technology first woven together in the mind of a madman. They come in many sizes, but are generally man-like in shape.

name: Golem, Brain
summary: A creation of the ancient race of mind flayers, brain golems may be the most horrible of all their kind. They exist purely for the desire of illithids and are unswayed from their goals.

name: Golem, Hammer
summary: The nightmare of orcs and other dwarf enemies, this rare golem is constructed by dwarf priests, using a process as rare and carefully guarded as the manufacture of the most powerful dwarven magical weapons.

name: Golem, Lightning
summary: The lightning golem is an artificial being given animation, if not true life, by the infusion of an elemental spirit. It is created and controlled by powerful magics or with the aid of a Manual of Golem Construction (see the Dungeon Master's Guide).

name: Golem, Mist (Ravenloft)
summary: Mist golems are creatures of fate, brought into being accidentally by misguided wizards and priests who do not fully understand what they are doing.

name: Golem, Snow (Ravenloft)
summary: First discovered on the arctic island of Todstein (as described in the adventure Ship of Horror), snow golems are similar to greater golems. Like others of their ilk, they are usually employed to guard an important item or entryway.

name: Golem, Stone Variants
summary: These variant golems are close relatives of the dreadful stone golems. They are generally created by powerful wizards and employed as guards or servants in a wide variety of settings.

name: Golem, Tin
summary: Construction of a tin golem requires a wizard and priest, each of at least 12th level, employing wish, polymorph any object, geas, resist fire, resist cold, and protection from normal missiles spells.

name: Golem, Vault Guardian
summary: Vault guardians are simple but expensive creations of Zhentarim wizards. They are sold to lords of Zhentil Keep and beyond to guard their most precious treasures.

name: Gonnlingdaah (Gonn)
summary: Though wildspace is fraught with mind-blasting perils, it also holds great beauty. The musical, pacifistic race known as the Gonnlingdaah (or the Gonn for short) brings much beauty to wildspace.

name: Goop Ghoul
summary: A goop ghoul is an amoeba-like creature similar to a black pudding or gray ooze. It is a translucent blob capable of only limited movement itself.

name: Goose
summary: The goose wears plate mail, wields a single handed weapon and has a shield.

name: Gorak
summary: Goraks are herd beasts that are valued by most of the intelligent, meat-eating races of Athas for their flesh, their colorful hide, and their keen sense of smell. They are fairly common and can be found in any desert area.

name: Gorbel
summary: The gorbel is an odd creature, believed by some to be a distant cousin to the beholder, or perhaps the result of some mad wizard's experiments.

name: Gorgimera
summary: The gorgimera has the hindquarters of a gorgon, forequarters of a lion, and body and wings of a red dragon. Like the chimera, it has the heads of its three constituent creatures.

name: Gorgon
summary: Gorgons are fierce, bull-like beasts who make their lairs in dreary caverns or the fastness of a wilderness. They are aggressive by nature and usually attack any creature or person they encounter.

name: Goristro (Greater Tanar'ri)
summary: Collectively known as goristroi, these huge tanar'ri can be found on nearly any plane of the Abyss, for they are adaptable and much desired by the rulers of the place to serve as engines of destruction.

name: Gorse (Petty Faerie)
climateTerrain: Subarctic to temperate grasslands, hills, and prairies
summary: The smallest of the faerie folk, and in some respects the most beautiful, are the gorse. Averaging one-quarter of the height of a full-grown atomic, the gorse must be secretive and unobtrusive to survive.

name: Gorynych
summary: The gorynych is unlikely to be mistaken for a true dragon if seen in good light. It has a long and supple body covered with tiny blue-green scales, and it has wings.

name: Gossamer
summary: Gossamers are the spacefaring cousins of the jellyfish. They travel in groups known as shoals.

name: Grav
summary: Gravs are short, stocky humanoids who manipulate gravity. They mine ore and gems from unclaimed asteroids and moons.

name: Gravislayer
summary: The gravislayer is a navigational hazard hated by spelljammers throughout the Known Sphere. Its unremarkable body hides one of the most destructive forces known.

name: Gray Linnorm Dragon
summary: Gray linnorms are ruthless and revel in harming intelligent creatures. They have the smallest bodies of all Norse dragons, but have long, whiplike tails which they employ in combat.

name: Gray Philosopher
summary: A gray philosopher is the undead spirit of an evil cleric who died with some important philosophical deliberation yet unresolved in his or her mind. In its undead state, this creature does noing but ponder these weighty matters.

name: Gray Troll
summary: Gray trolls are tall and gangly, and look much like normal trolls. Their gray or gray-brown skin is dry and flaky, like old parchment.

name: Gray Unicorn
summary: Gray unicorns are light gray unicorns with a gray horn and gray eyes.

name: Graz'zt, Abyssal Lord, Tanar'ri
summary: Each Abyssal lord is a single tanar'ri unlike any other, a unique creature with its own interests, strengths, and weaknesses. Most lords rule an entire layer of the Abyss, though the least among them fight for control of a layer with other lords.

name: Great Belial of Phlegethos Lord of the Fourth
summary: Belial is an old schemer whose good looks and glib tongue continue to serve him well in the machinations of Hell. An ally of Baalzebul's during the Reckoning Belial.

name: Great Dreamer
summary: These enormous spacegoing cetaceans are apparently responsible for the occurrence of whales and other cetaceans, both in space and on worlds with plentiful water.

name: Great Ghul
summary: The great ghuls are undead elemental cousins of the genies, the most wicked members of an inferior order of jann. They haunt burial grounds and feed on dead human bodies.

name: Great Spirits
summary: The great spirits are the most powerful and most distant of all spirit kind. Only powerful shamans can contact them, and those who attempt to use binding spells or other spirit-controlling magic on them come to bad ends.

name: Greater Air Elemental (Athas)
summary: Greater air elementals can be conjured in any area of open air where gusts of wind are present. They are often summoned in open areas of the Athasian deserts, during sand and wind storms.

name: Greater Animator
summary: The strongest of its kind, a greater animator can inhabit entire buildings or great sailing ships, turning them into vast, living death traps.

name: Greater Drake, Arsalon
summary: One of the more unusual of the greater drakes, the arsalon, or hive drake, generally conforms to the standard draconian shape, although its tail is shorter and thicker than normal and ends in a bony stinger like that of a purple worm or a dark naga.

name: Greater Drake, Fumarandi
summary: One of the smaller of the greater drakes, the fumarandi, or smoke drake, is nonetheless a formidable and fearsome-looking opponent. Its overlapping scales are the color of charcoal, and its eyes glow like burning embers.

name: Greater Drake, Kavainus
summary: The kavainus, or ghost drake, is covered with hard, bony scales ranging from bone white to snow white to a light, dusty gray. From a distance, they are easily mistaken for white dragons or ice lizards.

name: Greater Drake, Retchenbeast
summary: The retchenbeast, or muck drake, is not only the smallest of the greater drakes but also the ugliest.

name: Greater Drake, Silislithis
summary: A silislithis's scales are tiny and closest, giving the creature a sleekness that allows it to glide through the water with supple grace.

name: Greater Drake, Vandalraug
summary: The vandalraug, or battle drake, is the “heavy war horse” of the greater drakes, easily domesticated into service as a flying battle mount and able to carry a heavily armored warrior without sacrificing maneuverability or speed.

name: Greater Earth Elemental (Athas)
summary: Greater earth elementals can be conjured in any area of earth or stone.

name: Greater Fire Elemental (Athas)
summary: Greater fire elementals can be conjured in any area containing a large, open flame. Any flame used to conjure a greater fire elemental should be at least 6' in diameter.

name: Greater Gibbering Mouther
summary: The one greater gibbering mouther known to exist is Xuxeteanlahucuxolazapaminaco, god-king of the Amedio nation of Chetanicatla. Larger and stronger than others of its kind, it considers itself a god.

name: Greater Golem
summary: A greater golem is an artificial humanoid body which has been animated by an elemental spirit but remains under the complete control of its creator.

name: Greater Leucrotta
summary: Greater leucrotta, also commonly called changesteeds, are ugly in looks and temperament in their base forms; like the common leucrotta, the changesteed is 7 feet tall at the shoulder and is 9 feet in length, with the body of a stag, a badger's head, a lion's tail, and the cloven hoofs of a goat.

name: Greater Mummy
summary: Also known as Anhktepot's Children, greater mummies are a powerful form of undead created when a high-level lawful evil priest of certain religions is mummified and charged with the guarding of a burial place.

name: Greater Mummy (Senmet)
summary: The so-called Children of Anhktepot are a horrible and sinister lot. Most were created by the dread lord of Har'Akir himself and are wholly loyal to that vile creature.

name: Greater Raven
summary: Many believe (correctly) that Ravens Bluff is named for these avians, who dwell almost exclusively in the area. These large, glossy black birds are locally renowned for their ability to speak and foretell the future.

name: Greater Shedu (Savage Coast)
summary: Only one greater shedu exists on the Savage Coast. The avatar of the Immortal Idu appears as a greater shedu to his enduk servants.

name: Greatswan
summary: Greatswans are massive swans raised and trained by elves to act as guards and war mounts. Like normal groundling swans, greatswans are ferocious fighters, and many have a nasty temper.

name: Greelox
summary: Greelox are powerful, spiderlike creatures. In addition to eight spiny, spiderlike legs, greelox have two limbs that function as arms.

name: Green Dragon
climateTerrain: Sub-tropical and temperate forest and subterranean
summary: Green dragons are bad tempered, mean, cruel, and rude. They hate goodness and good-aligned creatures.

name: Grell
summary: The grell is a fearsome carnivore that looks like a giant brain with a vicious beak and 10 dangling tentacles, each 6 feet long. Some grell are rogues, while others live in family units.

name: Grell, Colonial
summary: The “civilized” grell is a colonial (as the term is used for ants and other colony animals) version of the underground ravager of Oerth. It is similar in size and appearance to terrestrial grells.

name: Grell, Wild
summary: The grell is an underground-dwelling, levitating jellyfish. This fearsome carnivore is feared for its ability to strike quickly before any defense can be set up.

name: Gremishka
summary: Like their close cousins, the gremlins, these diminutive humanoids are parasites and nuisances. They live under buildings and steal from the inhabitants.

name: Greyhawk Dragon
summary: Greyhawk dragons love to have human and demihuman companions, and, unlike other species of dragons, prefer to live amid the hustle and bustle of great cities. They often pose as sages, scholars, mages, or other intellectuals.

name: Griffon
summary: Half-lion, half-eagle, griffons are ferocious avian carnivores that prey upon horses and their kin (hippogriffs, pegasi, and unicorns). This hunger for horseflesh often brings griffons into direct conflict with humans and demihumans.

name: Grim
summary: A grim is a guardian creature bound to a particular spot and charged with protecting it from all evil creatures. A grim never abandons its spot, even if it becomes dilapidated and desolate.

name: Grim Reaper
summary: The grim reaper (or death spirit) is a creature from the negative material plane that appears only in Ravenloft.

name: Grimlock
summary: Powerfully-built humanoids clad only in dark, filthy rags, these warlike subterranean creatures emerge from their deep caverns at night to search for unlucky humans to add to their larders.

name: Grippli
summary: Grippli resemble small, intelligent, humanoid tree frogs. They are have a primitive culture and are nonaggressive.

name: Grist
climateTerrain: Any stone building or rocky mountainside
summary: The grist, or true gargoyle, is a rock-like creature that resembles a gargoyle or margoyle, but it is considerably larger and much more fearsome.

name: Griveling
summary: Grivelings are creatures believed to be natives of the elemental plane of Earth. It is unknown, even to the grivelings, whether they wandered through a portal to this plane or were transported here by mages.

name: Grommam
summary: Grommams are gorilla-like apes with heavy upper-body musculature. Their legs are short and their feet are roughly soled and their toes have a limited ability to grasp objects.

name: Grotesque
summary:
The gothic cathedral was more than a place of worship; it was also a work of art. Each was covered with hundreds of sculptures,
the most famous of which, the gargoyles, belong to a type of ornamentation referred to as grotesques.

name: Groundling
summary: Groundlings are assassins, magically altered by Zhentarim wizards. Originally of dwarven stock, they have been hideously transformed to a cross between dwarves and giant badgers.

name: Growler
summary: Growlers are amorphous beings whose lives are spent at sea. Looking like miniature icebergs, they are often found floating among normal ice formations near shore.

name: Grudgling
summary: These halfling-sized creatures have a combination of feline and human characteristics. Grudglings were originally created to serve as house pets and familiars to rakastas.

name: Grung
summary: Grung are highly territorial, toad-like humanoids that dwell in swamps and marshes.

name: Grythok
summary: Grythok range in size from 2” to 6” long. Their soft bodies are oval-shaped and covered by a tough, leathery shell.

name: Guardian (Yugoloth)
summary: These yugoloths are summoned by evil wizards or priests to guard something of importance. Yugoloth guardians always defend their charge with great ferocity.

name: Guardian Spirits
summary: Guardian spirits are often found at sites of desperate defenses and last stands that are featured in tales and legends.

name: Guardian Tasked Genie
summary: Guardian genie are powerful spirits sworn to defend specific items and locations tirelessly and without fail. They were once efreet, but have been reshaped to be both sleepless and loyal to the exact wording of their oath.

name: Guardian Warrior
summary: The guardian warrior and horse are ceramic constructs created to serve as protectors and bodyguards. Only those who discover the correct magic formula can animate these creatures.

name: Guardinal, Cervidal
summary: Cervidals are the most common of the guardinals. They're the people of Amoria, the uppermost layer of Elysium.

name: Guardinal, Leonal
summary: Leonals are the wisest and most powerful of the guardinals. They're chieftains and leaders when guardinals gather, but a leonal prefers to keep to itself when the forces of good allow it to rest.

name: Guardinal, Lupinal
summary: The lupinals're the front-line troops of Elysium. Packs of 'em roam all over the plane, and often into the Outlands, Bytopia, or the Beastlands, searching aggressively for any hint of evil intrusion.

name: Guardinal, Ursinal
summary: The scholars and philosophers of the guardinals are the ursinals, benevolent beings who resemble huge men and women with distinctive bearlike attributes. They're advisers to the leonals, and the record-keepers and magic-users of their race.

name: Gulguthydra
summary: The gulguthydrae combine the worst attributes of the gulguthras (otyughs and neo-otyughs) and hydrae. Six misshapen hydra heads perch in a circle atop the hulking body of this hybrid, which also possesses the gulguthra's two ridged tentacles.

name: Gullion
summary: Gullions are related to terrestrial seagulls but have adapted to life in space. Spelljamming crews despise them, because they waste precious air and demand a good deal of food.

name: Gully Dwarf
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Plain, swamp, forest, jungle, hill, and mountain
summary: Gully dwarves, also known as Aghar, are stupid, filthy, and obnoxious.

name: Gulper
summary: The gulper variety of fish consists of little more than a huge mouth, following by a trailing tail that seems to stretch on forever.

name: Gurik Cha'ahl
summary: The gurik cha'ahl (“ghost people”) are the dangerous and unpleasant offspring of the Ilquar goblins of Taladas. They are the ill-favored who, driven out of the villages, have managed to survive in the forests against the odds.

name: Guttar (Dwarven Ox)
summary: Dwarven oxen are bred to live in the underground tunnels or halls that the dwarves call home. Their dwarven name means “thunder” because of the rumbling echoes the herds make as they move through the dwarven tunnels.

name: Gyerian
summary: Gyerians – excitable, birdlike humanoids – make their home in the grasslands and forests of Mystara. Although flightless, gyerians are migratory beings that travel in flocks, moving east to west every spring and returning in the fall.

name: Gyre
summary: The gyre is a huge feathered bird similar in appearance to the terrestrial condor. While its wingspan is 20 feet or even more, its body length is rarely over 6 feet.

name: H'Calos
summary: H'Calos is a (hopefully) unique creature found in Maztica. It appears as a monstrous centipede with a black, chitinous shell.

name: Ha'pony (Centaur-kin)
summary: Ha'ponies have the upper body of a halfling combined with the lower body of a pony. Their pony hindquarters are varying shades of brown and chestnut, with some grays.

name: Hadozee
summary: Called “deck apes”, hadozee are indeed ape-like. Rough taller and more slander than the typical ape, hadozee have brown hair covering their bodies.

name: Hag
summary: Hags are witchlike beings that spread havoc and destruction, working their magics, and slaying all whom they encounter.

name: Hag, Sea, Greater
summary: One of the most dreaded denizens of the deep, greater sea hags are fortunately rare.

name: Hag, Spectral
summary: A spectral hag is the undead spirit of a hag who died during an evil ceremony. Returned to a mockery of the life she once knew, the hag is doomed to inhabit desolate places and seeks only to slaughter all she encounters.

name: Hai Nu
summary: The hai nu are a race of intelligent aquatic creatures. Though passive by nature, their close relationship with the Lord of the Sea can make them formidable enemies.

name: Hai Riyo
summary:
The hai riyo is also known as a dragon bird. This inhabitant of
Kara-Tur appears to be a massive bird, even larger than a roc,
but with the bewhiskered head of an oriental dragon.

name: Hakeashar
summary: A hakeashar, also known as an eater-of-magic, appears as a bright red sphere. Their bodies pulse and glow as they drift about.

name: Half-Dragon
summary: Half-dragons are the result of the mating of a demihuman female, usually elf, dwarf, or gnome, and a male metallic dragon – gold, silver, or bronze.

name: Half-Elf
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical and temperate/Forests and plains
summary: Half-elves are the offspring of human and elven parents.

name: Half-Golem (Desmond LaRouche)
summary: Both medical science and healing magic can accomplish wonders. Often, the application of a poultice infused with curative herbs or the weaving of a mystical spell can save the life of an injured or diseased person.

name: Half-Ogre
summary: When adventuring companies journey into the wilderness they often run into ogres; big, ugly humanoids.

name: Halfling
summary: Halflings are a hard-working race of peaceful citizens. Their communities are similar to those of humans, although they usually contain many burrow homes in addition to surface cottages.

name: Halfling (Athas)
summary: Throughout the Forest Ridge reside the multitude of halfling tribes. Though small, halflings are numerous enough to support their claim to this territory.

name: Halfling, Anadian
summary: Anadian halflings are the epitome of extremes. When they like something, they love it, but when they don't like it, they abhor it.

name: Halfling, Shadow World
summary: Similar in many respects to the Cerilian halflings who escaped the escalating darkness, those halflings who stayed behind have been forever changed by their everworsening environment.

name: Hama
summary: Hama are spirit birds formed when the soul rises from the body in bird-form upon a person's death. This spirit bird normally then leaves the Prime Material Plane and makes its journey to the afterlife.

name: Hamadryad
summary: These woodland spirits appear to be beautiful elven or human females, except that they have deep, sparkling, green eyes and long green hair. They are peaceful, quick-witted, and polite, but shy.

name: Hamatula (Lesser Baatezu)
summary: Hamatula are solitary patrollers of the third and fourth layers of Baator. They are large humanoids, covered from head to toe with sharp barbs right down to their long, meaty tails.

name: Hamster, Giant Space
summary: Giant space hamsters are exactly what they sound like-cute but brown-bear-sized rodents with thick fur. They are found on worlds having colonies of Krynnish gnomes (gnomoi and minoi).

name: Handmaiden of Takhisis
summary: The names of the great gods of Krynn are well known: Paladine, Takhisis, Gilean.

name: Hannya
summary: A vicious variety of oriental hag, the hannya is a cross between a wretched old woman and a serpent with an insatiable hunger for human prey.

name: Hannya
summary: Hannyas are the spirits of woman who were jealous in life. They have grotesque, evil faces with knobby chins, fangs, and horns upon their heads.

name: Harginn (Elemental Grue)
summary: The harginn, or flame horror, is a grue from the plane of elemental Fire. When summoned to the Prime Material plane, a harginn will typically appear in the form of a human with flames where its lower torso and legs would be.

name: Harpy
summary: Harpies are wicked avian beasts that prey upon nearly all creatures but prefer the flesh of humans and demihumans.

name: Harrier
summary: Harriers appear basically humanoid. They have two arms, two legs, and one head.

name: Harrla
summary: Every culture has reports of unusual behavior by otherwise normal people. Perhaps a wife who has been true and faithful for many years suddenly seeks passion in the arms of a stranger.

name: Hatori
summary: Hatori, sometimes called the “crocodiles of the sands” are giant reptiles dwelling within sandy desert wastes. The hatori's hard, knobby hide ranges in color from gray-white to red-brown and is virtually indistinguishable from stone.

name: Haun
summary: Hauns are chaotic ice worms with mental powers. They often parasite haundars which they use to travel outside their frozen tunnel lairs.

name: Haundar
summary: The haundar is a gargantuan ice-slug. A very thick, flat shell covers most of the haundar.s back and its head.

name: Haunt
summary: A haunt is the restless spirit of a person who died leaving some vital task unfinished. Its sole purpose is to take over a living body and use it to complete the task, thus gaining a final release from this world.

name: Haunt, Knight
summary: A knight haunt is a floating suit of Solamnic armor, always accompanied by some sort of weapon. If the battle where the knight fell was one where more than 100 Solamnic knights died then it is always riding a suit of floating horse barding.

name: Hawk
summary: Hawks are common throughout the world, from tropic to subarctic regions. They live mainly on vermin and rodents and thus are thought well of in many areas.

name: Head Hunter
summary: A head hunter is a horrid, spiderlike creature believed to have been created by the mysterious drow or some related, but even more sinister, race.

name: Headless Horseman
summary: Before the horseman comes, the night grows black and still. Clouds obscure the moon, leaving only a thin blue halo to outline its shape behind them.

name: Heart Tick
climateTerrain: Temperate to tropical urban and subterranean
summary: There are few creatures more horrid than the heart tick. Thankfully very rare, these terrible parasites feed on the blood of humans and demihumans.

name: Hearth Fiend
summary: Since the dawn of time, humankind has looked upon fire as a mixed blessing. It drives away the night and holds back the cold.

name: Hebi-No-Onna
summary: Hebi-no-onna, also known as snake women, are powerful spellcasters who can control snakes of all sorts. They often dupe normal men and women into forming cults dedicated to themselves in order to further their selfish and evil aims.

name: Hecatoncheire
summary: The Hecatoncheire was born to Gaea and Uranus. It resembles a huge giant that has fifty heads and a hundred arms.

name: Hej-kin
summary: Hej-kin are a race of vile-looking humanoids who inhabit the natural subterranean caverns and tunnels of Athas.

name: Helborn
climateTerrain: Subtropical and tropical swamps and jungles
summary: The helborn is a sentient, carnivorous plant with spell-like powers. It is also able to use a telepathic, nonverbal empathy within 60', allowing it to communicate with potential prey.

name: Helian
climateTerrain: The Sun, elemental plane of Fire
summary: These creatures are born on the elemental plane of Fire, formed from the union of the soul of a deceased follower of the fire elemental gods and the extreme heat of the plane.

name: Hell Hound
summary: Hell hounds are fire-breathing canines from another plane of existence brought here in the service of evil beings.

name: Helmed Horror
summary: A helmed horror is empty, animated armor, capable of independent reasoning. It is neither undead nor a summoned creature.

name: Hendar
summary: The heavily-bodied, fearsome, black hendar resembles a vast worm with bat wings and a horse-like head. It is a solitary hunter and is always encountered alone except during mating season.

name: Hengeyokai
summary: Hengeyokai are a race of intelligent shapechangers. Several subraces exist, each representing a different type of animal.

name: Hephaeston (Giant)
summary: Hephaestons spend their time and energy forging weapons in the highest mountains or deepest caverns of Mystara. These solitary giants have resilient, dark skins of flexible iron.

name: Herathian Voat
summary: Also known as Slagovich juggernaut, this meat-eating horror is the product of yet another ancient Herathian experiment. It is also one of the Savage Coast's most destructive monsters.

name: Herdsman Tasked Genie
summary: Capable of running all day with their herds, herdsman tasked genies are dedicated and sociable creatures.

name: Herex
summary: Herex are giant, insectoid creatures with dangerous, acidic bites. Characters can encounter them in any of the three stages of their hfe cycle egg, larva, or adult.

name: Hermit, Sea
summary: The sea hermit poses a very significant danger to the unwary. This creature appears to be nothing more than a lonely, benevolent person living in a huge shell on a deserted beach.

name: Hero Spirits
summary: Hero spirits are figures of myth and epic legends— founders of tribes, great warriors who saved an entire people, and so on.

name: Heucuva
summary: The heucuva is an undead spirit similar in appearance to a skeleton, but more dangerous and more difficult to dispel.

name: Heway
summary: The heway is a large white snake with a deadly stare, a creature of the desert that enjoys poisoning wells and oases.

name: Hezrou (True Tanar'ri)
summary: The hezrou, among the least powerful of the true tanar'ri, are still creatures of formidable power. They perform the will of the nalfeshnee by wandering the Abyss and overseeing the formation of armies.

name: Hide
summary: The hide is a bottom-dwelling octopus of enormous size, with comparatively short tentacles. In basic appearance, it resembles a dirty floor mop or an opened umbrella, and in general is quite a disgusting sight.

name: High Ogre (Irda)
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Plain, forest, swamp, jungle, hill, mountain
summary: High ogres, also known as Irda, are a handsome and gentle race of ogres inhabiting an idyllic island located far from the civilized lands of Ansalon.

name: Hill Dwarf (Neidar)
summary: Hill dwarves, also known as Neidar, are the most commonly encountered dwarven race on Krynn.

name: Hill Giant
summary: Hill giants are oddly simian and barbaric in appearance, with overly long arms, stooped shoulders, and low foreheads. Even though they are the smallest of the giants, their limbs are more muscular and massive than those of the other giant races.

name: Hippocampus
summary: The hippocampus is the most prized of the marine steeds, a creature that combines features of a horse and a fish.

name: Hippogriff
summary: Hippogriffs are flying monsters that have an equal likelihood to be predator, prey, or steed.

name: Histachii (Yuan-ti)
summary: Once human, yuan-ti histachii are near-mindless abominations who have been transformed into reptilian humanoids to serve their yuan-ti masters. Most often, they are found guarding yuan-ti brood chambers.

name: Hive Mother (Beholder-kin)
summary: The legendary hive mothers are also called the Ultimate tyrants, or just Ultimates. They are twice the size of typical beholders, and differ in appearance as well.

name: Hobgoblin
summary: Hobgoblins are a fierce humanoid race that wage a perpetual war with the other humanoid races. They are intelligent, organized, and aggressive.

name: Holbag
summary: Holbags are huge, gas-filled bags that float in the atmosphere of the third layer of Alabeth (refer to the description of that planet for details on layers, etc. in the Practical Planetology book).

name: Hollyphant
summary: A hollyphant looks like a tiny, golden-furred elephant only 2 feet long, with a pair of shining white wings sprouting from its back. Its coat shimmers and gleams, and its eyes dance with a rainbow of colors.

name: Holstein
summary: These happy cows live on R.S. Claws' island, in a sunny green pasture.

name: Homonculous
summary: Homunculi are small mystical beings created by magicians for spying and other special tasks.

name: Homunculus, Elemental
summary: As planewalkers cope with the problems presented by travel on the Inner Plancs, more and more solutions present themselves. Sometimes those solutions come from the most unlikely sources.

name: Hook Horror
summary: The hook horror is a bipedal, underground-dwelling monster that looks like a cross between a vulture and a man with hooks instead of hands.

name: Hook Spider
summary: Spiders of all kinds are fairly common throughout the Outlands and the Great Wheel. Normal-size hunters and web-spinners can be found in the strangest places, surviving where no other mundane animals can.

name: Horag
summary: The horag is a very rare crossbreed that arises from a union between an exceptionally large ogre and a relatively small hill giant.

name: Horax
summary: The horax are insectoid creatures, as ferocious as they are mindless. They are long with 12 legs, small but powerful mandibles, and tough chitinous plates that cover the back.

name: Horde
summary: The bodies of a particular horde consciousness all look alike, and different hordes often feature their own distinct body types.

name: Hordling
summary: Hordlings are the uncounted hordes of the Gray Wastes. They form the majority of the population of that plane.

name: Horg
summary: Horgs are strange sentient lifeforms perfectly adapted for life in the asteroid belt of the Grinder. At a distance, they look like winged humanoids, standing about 7' tall.

name: Horgar
summary: This immense and powerful creature eats its way through solid rock, creating tunnels, passageways, and caverns in its wake. When not in motion, a horgar resembles a lava formation.

name: Hornet, Giant
summary: Giant hornets are nothing more than fantastically enlarged versions of normal insects. Unlike their more common cousins, they are often hostile and aggressive.

name: Hound of Ill-Omen
summary: The hound of ill-omen is one of the many beasts that the gods use to punish mortals who have offended them in some way.

name: Hound of Kyuss
summary: The Hounds of Kyuss were created ages ago by the high priest Kyuss for use as guardians and pets. A Hound of Kyuss appears as a huge undead scarab beetle the size of a large mastiff.

name: Hound of Law
summary: The hound of law is a form of will o'wisp that the wind dukes (the vaati) use as trackers. guards, and messengers.

name: Hound, Phantom
summary: A phantom hound is a dog so devoted to its former master that it returns after its death to guard that master's property or final resting place.

name: Howler
summary: Howlers are the keening brood-hounds or Pandemonium, the singers of dementia who cluster around the great rocky spires in those plunging caves. In that eternally night-lit plane the howlers are drawn to shriek their madness to the moonless heavens

name: Hsiao
summary: The hsiao (sh-HOW), or guardian owls, are a race of peaceful philosopher-priests inhabiting the woodlands of Mystara.

name: Hsing-sing
summary: The hsing-sing are a race of reclusive ape-like humanoids. Many scholars consider the hsing-sing to personify the principles of pacifism and harmony with nature.

name: Hu Hsien
climateTerrain: Temperate plain, forest, hill, and mountain
summary: Lesser spirits who are cousins of the hengeyokai, the hu hsien are a race of shapeshifting foxes—cunning, clever, and capable of endless mischief.

name: Human
summary: The ka'ardani (Draxan for “outlanders” or “exiles”) are residents of the outer valley, a people descended from escaped slaves, lost travelers, and exiled criminals.

name: Human (Abber Nomad)
summary: The Abber nomads are a stoic and proud people who dwell in the dreaded Nightmare Lands.

name: Human (Dragon-Slayer)
summary: The dragon slayer is a human warrior specially trained to battle dragons.

name: Human (Kara-Tur)
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate oceans and coasts
summary: Of all the men of Kara-Tur, few are more feared than the wako and frost barbarians. Wako are merciless pirates, preying on all who travel the seas.

name: Human (Vistana)
summary: The Vistani (singular, Vistana) are a mysterious nomadic people resembling gypsies in manner, dress, and custom.

name: Human (Wonderseeker)
summary: "Wonderseekers" are spacefaring humans who roam space in search of entertainment, conducting elaborate games among themselves in which other beings may become unwitting accomplices or pawns.

name: Human - Lost Ones & Madmen (Ravenloft)
summary: In a land as filled with nightmares and unspeakable horrors as Ravenloft, there are persons who have seen more evil than they can possibly bear. These shattered and broken souls are known throughout the demiplane as “the lost ones”.

name: Human, Abber Shaman
summary: Abber shamans are the holy men and women of the Abber nomad tribes. The shamans, like the rest of the Abbers, dwell in the dread Nightmare Lands, specifically in the Forest of Everchange.

name: Human, Amazon
summary: These barbarian warrior women are, in effect, heroines all. They are exceptionally tall human women.

name: Human, Draxan
summary: Draxans are the citizens of Ur Draxa, the City of Doom within the Valley of Dust and Fire. From birth they are trained as warriors, psionicists, templars, or defilers.

name: Human, Pygmy
summary: Pygmies are small humans who live in the deepest jungles or on isolated tropical islands. They were once widespread, but competition with taller neighbors has forced them into small pockets of wilderness unclaimed by others.

name: Hummerfly
summary: The hummerfly is a docile insectoid creature whose pleasant sound and sweet aroma makes it a welcome presence in most civilized areas.

name: Hunting Cactus
summary: Hunting cacti are a pale green color. They stand 3 feet high and have a number of oval shaped pods attached to the main trunk.

name: Huptzeen
summary: Huptzeens are lesser magical constructs animated by a combination of arcane rituals and the cooperation of an inhabitant of the Outer Planes.

name: Hurdu
summary: Hurdu are physically powerful fighters who favor weapons that they can use with two hands, taking full advantage of their reach and height to land smashing blows.

name: Hutaakan
summary: The Hutaakans are a haughty, callous race, dominated by their priests.

name: Hybsil
climateTerrain: Any temperate forest, plains, or hills
summary: Hybsils look like a cross between a small antelope and a pixie, brownie, or sprite. These antelope centaurs can be found in large forests or small woods across the Heartlands, and often venture into nearby plains or hills to hunt or forage.

name: Hydden
summary: A hydden is a humanoid creature possessing two standard human legs that are used to propel the creature across ground . It also has four arms which it can use independently.

name: Hydroloth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: Hydroloths are elite fighting forces commonly used in yugoloth ambushes or amphibian attacks. They are squat humanoids with underarm gliding flaps, frog-like faces, and warty yellow skin.

name: Hyena
summary: Hyenae are canines who roam warm grasslands and plains. They are primarily scavengers, but will hunt small game on occasion.

name: Hypnos
summary: Hypnos is sleep personified, the one member of the Nightmare Court who never leaves his bed of glass. This villain favors dreams of inadequacy and frustration, seeking to destroy a dreamer's self-esteem through endless nocturnal episodes.

name: Ibrandlin
summary: Ibrandlin, or lurkers-in-darkness, as they are formally called, are creatures created from fire lizards by human clerics of the god Ibrandul (see Ecology below).

name: Ice Bear
summary: Resembling a cross between a polar bear and a cave bear, the ice bear is a ferocious meat-eater inhabiting the southernmost regions of Krynn. It is the most intelligent of all bears.

name: Ice Gnome
summary: Ice gnomes are fierce warriors in large groups. They can carry any weapon appropriate to their size, and their tough skin provides a natural AC of 9.

name: Ice Lizard
summary: In its natural form, the ice lizard is a snow-white lizard, some 3' long, and strikingly similar in appearance to a very young white dragon. Its scales are tinged in places with a dull silver or palest blue.

name: Ice Mephit
summary: Ice mephits are angular, with translucent, ice-blue skin. They live on the colder Lower Planes and thus never mix with fire, magma, smoke, or steam mephits.

name: Ice Mummy
summary: Leathery, desiccated brown skin is drawn tight over the bones of an ice mummy. The hair and clothing remain intact but show the effects of centuries of entombment.

name: Ice Spire Ogre
summary: Ice Spire Ogres are bigger, smarter, and generally more dangerous than their more common cousins found elsewhere in Faerûn. Spire ogres are approximately 10.

name: Ice Troll
climateTerrain: Temperate or Arctic but always near water
summary: The ice troll is a smaller, more intelligent relative of the normal troll, and is probably the result of magical experimentation. It closely resembles its more common cousin, but has semitransparent, very cold skin.

name: Ice Vampire
summary: Not true vampires, ice vampires are the spirits of Kagonesti women who have drowned themselves in grief. They take two forms: a female Kagonesti surrounded by mist, or a pool of water (of varying size).

name: Id Fiend
summary: The id fiend is a psionic predator whose greatest weapon is its ability to draw images of its victims' fears from their minds.

name: Iguana, Giant
summary: The giant iguana is a large, omnivorous reptile found in wilderness forests.

name: Ikiryo
summary: A projection of the evil thoughts of a living person, the ikiryo is a lesser spirit that obsessively pursues its victim until either it or the victim is destroyed.

name: Ildriss (Elemental Grue)
summary: The ildriss, or wind terror, is a creature from the plane of elemental Air. When on the Prime Material plane, an ildriss is either as invisible as the wind or it is seen as a fog-like cloud with vaporous tentacles and three faintly gleaming red eyes.

name: Illithid (Mind Flayer)
summary: The illithid, or mind flayer, is an evil and feared creature of the Underdark; its powers are formidable and it feeds on the brains of any creature it encounters.

name: Illithid Vampire (Athaekeetha)
summary: One of the most terrible domains in Ravenloft is the dread Bluetspur. Located in the far south of the core lands, it is a land of madness and insanity.

name: Illithocyte
summary: Illithocytes are squirming subpenumbran lifeforms that subsist on random psychic energy alone, but whose lashing tentacles are capable of delivering painful stings to those that encounter them.

name: Imbul (Falx)
summary: The Falx imbul, or rock lizard, is a large, heavy lizard, about 3 feet long (4–5 feet including tail), resembling a pugnacious iguana. Its color ranges from dusty grey to dark brown, and its remarkably thick skin is very similar in texture to rock.

name: Immoth
summary: Words are power. It's been said many times, and each time it's the truth.

name: Imp
summary: Imps are diminutive creatures of an evil nature who roam the world and act as familiars for lawful evil wizards and priests.

name: Imp (Mystara)
summary: Imps are nasty, diminutive creatures that roam the world causing mischief to all they meet. Three forms of imp inhabit the wilds of Mystara: the wood, bog, and garden imp.

name: Imp, Blood Sea
summary: Blood Sea imps, also known as vapor imps, are hateful, vicious creatures dwelling in tropical oceans They delight in tormenting all those who dare enter their waters.

name: Impersonator
summary: The impersonator is strange form of life that lurks in swamps, wetlands, and caverns, waiting for its chance to drain the blood from a living creature.

name: Incantifer (Sect)
summary: Centuries ago, a faction called the Incanterium schemed and maneuvered in the kriegstanz of Sigil‘s factions. They were known as the Magicians or the Wanters; it's said they believed that the secret to everything was wizardly magic.

name: Incarnate
summary: Incarnates are sapient embodiments of the pure energy of abstract principles. For instance, an evil incarnate is formed of pure living evil energy, and a courage incarnate is the living energy of pure courage.

name: Infernite
climateTerrain: Fire-based worlds, volcanic vents, dim solid stars
summary: Infernites are a race of intelligent humanoids inhabiting many known fire-based worlds. They are fire-based themselves, and some are proficient in the use of magic and spelljamming craft.

name: Infinity Vine
summary: An infinity vine is a leafless, bright green plant with an extremely rapid rate of growth. It consists of an enormous number of thin, interwoven stems, all part of the same plant.

name: Ingundi
summary: The ingundi is an intelligent humanoid reptile that can cloak itself in illusion to fool its prey.

name: Inheritor Lich
summary: These vile undead creatures are the remnants of high-level Inheritors who sought to increase their power. Through arcane, alchemical processes, they transform from living beings into powerful undead creatures.

name: Innugaakalikurit (Arctic Dwarf)
summary: Squat, hardy, and eccentric, the arctic dwarves, or Innugaakalikurit, are the only dwarven race native to the Great Glacier region.

name: Inquisitor
summary: Created by evil wizards centuries ago, inquisitors are a shambling, rotting, undead abomination, living on sheer terror. Each is an ancient expert in torture and information extraction, an artist who works in screams and agony.

name: Insect Swarm
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical or temperate/Forest, hills,and plains
summary: As individuals, velvet ants, grasshoppers, and locusts are relatively harmless. But in swarms, these insects can cause immense damage to fields and forests, as well as threatening the lives of all creatures in their path.

name: Insect Swarm (Athas)
summary: The insects of Athas are of a hearty breed, and insect swarms are among the most deadly plagues that this world has ever been subject to.

name: Insectare
summary: lnsectare are a humanoid race rumored to be the descendants of a magical union of elves and insects. The insectare's goal is to rule the spaceways, but they wage this campaign subtly, trying to play one race against another.

name: Intellect Devourer
summary: Ustilagor are the larval form of intellect devourers. Like their parents, they look like brains with four legs.

name: Invisible Flying Ray
summary: Were these creatures visible, they would be graceful, mantalike creatures which swim through the air by use of a bladder filled with lighter-than-air gas.

name: Invisible of Stardock
summary: The invisible race of Stardock has inhabited their inaccessible kingdom for many centuries. Their origin is uncertain though the ice wizard Khahkht may have had some role in their creation.

name: Invisible Stalker
summary: The invisible stalker is a creature from the elemental plane of Air. Those encountered on the Prime Material plane have almost always been summoned by wizards to fulfill a specific task.

name: Iron Cobra
summary: An iron cobra appears somewhat similar to a normal poisonous snake, yet it is a programmable, magical automaton, constructed of an unknown metal by some ancient wizard, or perhaps even a minor deity.

name: Iron Dragon, Ferrous
summary: Iron dragons are the most powerful of all ferrous dragons. They are the rulers of all the ferrous dragons, and the sovereign iron dragon is said to be nearly unbeatable.

name: Ironmaw
summary: There are layers of the Abyss where the plants're just as dangerous as the tanar'ri.

name: Island Giant
summary: Island giants are a twisted, horrid variety of their towering kind, as malicious and hateful as they are ugly. Their appearance varies, though all are vaguely humanoid.

name: Isopterite
summary: Isopterites are semi-intelligent, bipedal termites that live beneath the ground or in trees in giant hives.

name: Ityak-Ortheel, the Elf-Eater (Elder Eternal Evil)
summary: Ityak-Ortheel, the Elf-Eater Ityak-Ortheel is one of the elder, eternal evils of the Outer Planes.

name: Iuz the Old One Demigod (Cambion) Patron of Wickedness
summary: Thief Abilities: PP 95, OL 100, F/RT 95, MS 110, HS 115, DN 95, CW 95, RL 105

name: Ivory Figurine
summary: Ivory figurines, like their counterparts, are small golems. They are often employed as guardians or assigned simple tasks suited to their diminutive size.

name: Ixitxachitl
summary: Ixitxachitl are a race of intelligent, aquatic beings that resemble small manta rays with barbed tails. They have an evil disposition and worship evil powers; they love to hunt marine humanoids, and then sacrifice or devour their catch.

name: Ixzan (Ixitxachitl)
summary: Ixzan are a freshwater offshoot of the ixitxachitl race. They are intelligent, evil creatures who resemble manta rays with barbed tails.

name: Jabberwock
summary: The jabberwock is a curious creature found only in dense, virgin forests. In appearance it resembles a dragon in its general outlines but lacks a breath weapon or any treasure-hoarding instinct.

name: Jacinth Dragon, Neutral
summary: Jacinth dragons may be the rarest of any nonunique dragon species; only a dozen at most exist on any given world.

name: Jack Frost
summary: A jack frost is a malicious ice spirit that lives on mountain tops or in arctic terrain. It delights in tormenting helpless creatures and subsists on the body heat that it drains from its victims.

name: Jackal
summary: Jackals are small, canine scavengers that roam the warm grasslands of the world. They are neither fierce nor brave, but are quite common.

name: Jackalwere
summary: The jackalwere is a terrible and savage creature which preys on unsuspecting travelers and other demihumans that it can ambush. Its ability to alter its shape at will makes it a most dangerous foe.

name: Jade Dragon (Mystara)
summary: The jade dragon is among the most conversational and least hostile on the planet Mystara. At a distance of 120 feet or more, it cannot be distinguished from a green dragon.

name: Jagre
summary: These monstrosities were spawned by Zaltec on the Night of Wailing, though they did not make their appearance until later.

name: Jakar
climateTerrain: Valley of the Mage and surrounding area
summary: The jakar (pronounced ye-kare), or changer, is similar to a lycanthrope in that it can change from a human to an animal form. However, the jakar can assume any animal form and can appear as a human of any age.

name: Jalath'gak
summary: First domesticated by the kreen of the distant North, wild jalath'gak are the scourge of herdsmen throughout the Tablelands. It is an enormous winged insect, 13 feet long, with a wingspan of nearly 20 feet.

name: Jaleeda Bird
summary: A jaleeda bird is a bizarre creation of Jason Krimeah, the Exalted One. It was a by-product of his research to create a jakar.

name: Jammer Leech
summary: Resembling the barnacle-like immature krajens, jammer leeches are unwittingly attracted by the spellcasters who power ships through wildspace and the phlogiston.

name: Janni (Zakhara)
summary: The weakest of all genies, jann are native to the Prime Material Plane. ( Jann is plural; janni is singular.) They are servants to other genie races and keepers of the wild, inhospitable reaches of the Zakharan desert.

name: Jarbo
summary: The jarbo is a hardy rodent that resembles the kangaroo rat, but it's larger, reaching a mature height of 2 feet at the shoulder. Its coat is typically sand colored or tawny, but pelt markings vary, the better to blend with their home terrain.

name: Jellyfish, Giant
summary: Portugese men-o-war are [giant jellyfish that float in warm sea waters, trailing their deadly tentacles below. They most often float at or just below the suface of the ocean, and often wash up on beaches during storms.

name: Jermlaine
summary: Jermlaine are a diminutive humanoid race that dwells in tunnels and ambushes hapless adventurers. They are known by a variety of names such as jinxkin or bane-midges.

name: Jhakar
summary: The jhakar (singular and plural) is a powerful reptilian predator resembling a scaled bulldog. Its hide is thick and wrinkled, and it has four short, muscular legs and a short, stumpy tail.

name: Jibarú Phanaton
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical jungles and forests
summary: Phanatons are seldom-seen, intelligent forest dwellers that have very strong ties to nature. A phanaton looks like a cross between a raccoon, a monkey, and a flying squirrel.

name: Jishin Mushi
summary: The jishin mushi is a giant carnivorous insect. Also known as the earthquake beetle, it is capable of generating tremors of extraordinary magnitude.

name: Jolly Roger
summary: A jolly roger is the undead spirit of a pirate or buccaneer who died at sea. These foul creatures were usually captains or officers while living, and retain their taste for command after death.

name: Jorri
summary: Resembling nothing so much as otters, these creatures can be found in the seas and along the shoreline of the Savage Coast. They can also be a great source of information to those who treat them well and are often quite helpful a crisis.

name: Jozhal
summary: Standing about four feet tall, the jozhal is a small, two-legged reptile with a skinny tail, a long flexible neck, and a narrow, elongated snout.

name: Juhrion
summary: These huge, bearlike creatures are completely hairless, covered with a tough, reddish, leathery skin that is actually the detrimental effect of an Armor Legacy. They possess large teeth and short, harpoon-shaped claws.

name: Jungle Giant
summary: Powerful, lanky, and strictly carnivorous, jungle giants are a terror to all the animals of the tropical forests. They are great hunters and stalkers, able to clear a huge tract of forest of all game and then move on.

name: K'r'r'r
summary: The k'r'r'r are sentient spiders that developed in deep space. Unfettered by a dependency on gravity.

name: Ka
summary: A ka is a kind of super-mummy. Once, the ka was a noble, king, or pharaoh.

name: Kada
summary: Kada are magical spirits formed when a person dies in a manner which evokes emotion not quite sufficient to cause the formation of a ghost. The dying person's emotion casts a shadow, and a kada is formed.

name: Kaisharga
summary: The kaisharga are a class of Athasian undead similar to the liches of other worlds. They have sought undeath, unnaturally extending their lives past the endurance of their mortal frames.

name: Kala
summary: The kala are a primitive spirit race of ferocious flesh-eaters and cannibals found in icy wastelands.

name: Kalin
summary: Kalin are large insectoid creatures that appear to be a monstrous mix of spider and ant. Mottled brown to yellow chitinous plates cover their long bodies.

name: Kalmari
summary: In its natural state, a kalmari is an amorphous being with a smoky, mistlike consistency. It appears as an inverted teardrop, with a 3'-long prehensile tail.

name: Kalothagh
summary: The kalothagh, also known as the prickleback, is an aquatic version of the manticore. Though sluggish and not particularly aggressive, the kalothagh is a known man-eater, which makes it a creature to be avoided.

name: Kaluk
summary: A greater spirit, the kaluk is a manifestation of human avarice and a scourge of the greedy.

name: Kamatlan
summary: Kamatlan resemble large jaguars with two snakes growing from each shoulder. They are very likely related to displacer beasts.

name: Kani Doll
climateTerrain: Rural societies of any terrain or climate
summary: In their usual form, kani dolls are created by members of primitive tribes to serve as simple good-luck charms; they have no life of their own. However, when enchanted by evil forces, they become chillingly relentless killers.

name: Kank, Wild
summary: Not all kanks on Athas are maintained by the nomad herdsmen. Many herds of kanks roam wild across the Tablelands.

name: Kappa
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate lakes and rivers
summary: The kappa are a race of amphibious humanoids who live in freshwater lakes, ponds, rivers, and streams.

name: Kasharin (Beholder)
summary: The kasharin are those beholders who contracted the Blinding Rot disease and who survived long enough to seemingly die from the disease and not from beholder retaliation.

name: Kazgaroth
summary: In its true form, Kazgaroth resembles a huge tyrannosaur with forelimbs that, while still short, match the rest of its body and allow the Beast to run on all fours if it wishes.

name: Kech
summary: Kech are forest fiends that prey on humans and demihumans.

name: Keeper
summary: Who are the keepers? What is it they want?

name: Kelpie
summary: The kelpie is a form of intelligent, aquatic plant life that is able to alter its shape and cast a charm spell. Its purpose is to drown the foolish.

name: Kender
climateTerrain: Tropical subtropical, and temperate/Plains, forests, jungles, hills, and mountains
summary: Kender are diminutive humanoids who are insatiably curious and utterly fearless, with an uncanny knack for getting into trouble.

name: Kenku
summary: Kenku are bipedal, humanoid birds that use their powers to annoy and inconvenience the human and demihuman races.

name: Ker (Ghost)
summary: A ker (plural, keres) is a malignant undead spirit that seeks revenge against the living. It looks like a horrible black winged humanoid with gleaming fangs and long, pointed nails.

name: Kercpa
summary: The kercpas, a reclusive race of intelligent squirrel-folk, inhabit dense forests far from human civilization. Shy of most races except elves, and skilled at remaining undetected, these small archers are rarely seen, even when their homes are nearby.

name: Kes'trekel
summary: The scourge of the Tablelands, kes'trekel are vile avian creatures that feast upon desert carrion. Although they are weak and cowardly in small groups, kes'trekel can become a devastating force in larger numbers.

name: Kezef the Chaos Hound (Elder Eternal Evil)
