summary: Kezef the Chaos Hound is one of the elder, eternal evils of the Outer Planes created in the dawn of Abeir-Toril's prehistory. The ravager of the heavens appears as a huge mastiff with unearthly, malevolent, red eyes and a ratty tail.

name: Khaasta
summary: The khasta are raiders, slavers, and smugglers who plague the Outlands and the chaotic planes. They're vicious, unreliable cutthroats and cross-traders who'll turn stag on a cutter as soon as look at him.

name: Khargra
climateTerrain: Elemental Plane of Earth (Any underground on PMP)
summary: Khargra swim through the earth, riding geological movements like a fish swims through the water by riding the currents. Some berks even call khargra “earth fish”, but the name's really not any more accurate that calling birds “air fish”.

name: Kholiathra
summary: The kholiathra are cunning spirits, usually unseen, who keep watch on elven lands. They protect native elves, ward off lesser evils that stray too close, and avert minor accidents.

name: Ki-rin
summary: The ki-rin is a noble creature that roams the sky in search of good deeds to reward or malefactors to punish.

name: Killer Spruce
summary: A killer spruce is an ill-tempered tree that can stand no other kinds of life near it.

name: Killmoulis
summary: Killmoulis are diminutive beings who like to provide useful services but also commit mischief.

name: Kindori (Space Whale)
summary: Kindori are called space whales, and they are among the largest living creatures found in space. They resemble aquatic whales in general shape and are mammals as well.

name: King-wight
summary: A king-wight was once a powerful evil king. When he died, he became undead, continuing to rule the ranks of the walking dead.

name: Kirre
summary: The kirre is one of the more vicious animals of the forests and jungles of Athas. Resembling a tiger in many ways, the kirre is a beast not to be trifled with.

name: Kitsune Kasumi (Mist Fox)
summary: The kitsune kasumi, or “mist foxes” are minor nature spirits associated with misty places. They are beautiful, pure-white foxes with slim and delicate bodies.

name: Kizoku
summary: A kizoku is an oriental creature that assumes the form of an irresistibly handsome man. He courts beautiful women, leading them to betray and murder their lovers or husbands.

name: Kla'a-Tah
summary: This highly intelligent turtle is primarily a sea creature, occasionally seen wandering the shores of the tortle people.

name: Klar
summary: The klar looks much like a large kodiak bear with a head that seems a little too large for the body. Its back is covered with a chitinous plate.

name: Kleshite Ghoul
summary: “Hast ever heart,” the tall Northerner intones, “of those sinuous earth-hued tropical Kleshite ghouls with hands like spades that burrow beneath cemeteries and their environs, silently emerge behind you, then seize you and drag you down before you can gather your wits to oppose it, digging more softly than the armadillo?

name: Kluzd
summary: Kluzd are snake-like reptiles that inhabit mudflats and other muddy areas. They are about ten feet long and two to three feet in diameter.

name: Klyndes
summary: When light filters through the constant haze of the quasiplane of Steam, it creates strange shadows cast upon nothingness. Lacking surfaces on which to form, the shadows nevertheless rise and fall again upon nothing but more steam and other shadows.

name: Kna
summary: A kna (pronounced NAH) is an aquatic humanoid well known for its strength. These creatures live exclusively in saltwater and cannot breathe air.

name: Kobold
summary: Kobolds are a cowardly, sadistic race of short humanoids that vigorously contest the human and demi-human races for living space and food. They especially dislike gnomes and attack them on sight.

name: Kobold, Dragon Mountain
summary: The kobolds of Dragon Mountain are well off compared to their more mundane cousins. They live a prosperous life and are well protected by the dragon Infyrana.

name: Kopru
summary: Koprus are a degenerate race of heat-loving amphibians. Though they possess intelligence and power, their civilization has been in decline for generations.

name: Korobokuru
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate mountains, hills, jungles, and forests
summary: The korobokuru are a race of Oriental dwarves who live in remote areas. They seldom come in contact with other races.

name: Korred
summary: When wandering through the world's sylvan forests, travelers should be wary of music and laughter coming from a clearing. More than likely, the cause is the dance-loving korred, a race that is close to nature and jealously protects its way of life.

name: Krag
summary: Krags are undead created when a cleric aligned to an element or para-element dies in the medium diametrically opposed to their own.

name: Kragling
summary:
**Psionics Summary**
| Level | Dis | Sci | Dev | Attack/Defense | Score | PSPs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 2 | 2 | 7 | II,EW/M-,TS | 12 | 60 |

name: Krajen
summary: The krajen develops in three stages: small spaceborne spores, a barnaclelike immature stage, and the huge, adult krajen that is the bane of the shipways.

name: Kraken
summary: A kraken is a rare form of gargantuan squid. It is one of the most deadly monsters in existence.

name: Krakentua
summary: Among the most fearsome creatures in all of Kara-Tur, the krakentua is a powerful demon spirit with an insatiable appetite for destruction and an obsessive desire to enslave those it considers inferior.

name: Kreel
summary: Kreel are large domesticated eels that lizard men use both as a source of food and as beasts of burden. When mature, they range from four to six feet long, and can be up to one foot in diameter.

name: Krotter
summary: Krotter are heavy, well muscled herd animals resembling large yaks. They sport thick, stringy fur that hangs down off their bodies so far that it nearly touches the ground.

name: Kruel
summary: These creatures were once good sylvan folk, but some great evil blighted their race and gained them their new name.

name: Kuei
summary: A lesser spirit of the dead, the kuei is a manifestation of a human or humanoid who died by violence unavenged or with a purpose unfulfilled. The spirit's former body was not buried.

name: Kuo-Toa
summary: Kuo-toa are an ancient race of fish-men that dwells underground and harbors a deep hatred of surface dwellers and sunlight.

name: Kupuk
summary: Trustworthy, dependable, and easily domesticated, the dog-like kupuk is one of the most valuable creatures to the tribes of the Great Glacier, both as a pack animal and loyal companion.

name: Kyrie
summary: Kyrie are an ancient race of bird-men. Small in numbers, their primary holdings are a few high, steep-walled valleys along the main mountain ridge of Mithas, homeland of the minotaur.

name: Kyton
summary: Kytons are a race of creatures inhabiting the city of Jangling Hiter on the third layer of Baator. They are the city's constabulaly, ferreting out transgressors.

name: Lacerial
summary: Lacerials are intelligent, bipedal lizards descended from creatures similar to dinosaurs. Lacerials are not native to Malatra, but claim to come from some other realm or world.

name: Lacunae Ghost
summary: This creature appears only as a thin gray outline of a person killed in an ashfall or pyroclastic surge. Not strictly a ghost, these creatures are host spirits animated by parasitic creatures from the Plane of Vacuum.

name: Lady Fierana of Phlegethos Lord of the Fourth
summary: Lady Fierana is the daughter of Belial and the coruler of Phlegethos. After the Reckoning, Belial thought it was best to retreat somewhat from the spotlight.

name: Laerti
summary: Also called asabis, these desert-dwelling reptilian humanoids are superficially like the lizard men of the swamplands. Laertis tend to be brown or gray in hue, with dun or light green underbellies.

name: Lakshu
summary: Lakshu are tall, beautiful, well-muscled, green-haired amazons. These teeth-gritting, armored harridans have laid waste to a thousand worlds, all in the name of their masters, the reigar.

name: Lamia
summary: Of all the hazards that the desert presents, few can compare with the cruel race of flesh-eating creatures known as lamias.

name: Lammasu
climateTerrain: Warm, with visits to other climes
summary: The lammasu, a winged leonine figure with a human head, aids and protects lawful good persons. They are generally kind and friendly to all good creatures.

name: Lammasu, Celestial
summary: Celestial lammasu are close relatives of the lammasu native to the Prime Material plane. These, however, make their homes among the wilderlands of Olympus.

name: Lamprey
summary: Lampreys are leech-like eels that dwell in deep fresh and salt water. They feed by biting their victims, fastening on with their teeth, and draining blood from their prey.

name: Land Linnorm Dragon
summary: Land linnorms are driven solely by greed, and they enjoy twisting humans and the land to their own corrupt desires.

name: Laraken
summary: A araken, also known as a magic-drainer, appears as a shining yellow sphere. It can wink out at will, reappearing elsewhere in a moment.

name: Larva
summary: Among the odder treasures of Castle Neutomas is a branding iron bearing a letter from an alphabet of the Lower Planes. Famed planar traveler Mordeia the Great tells how she got it in her Signs and Wonders: A Planar Tour.

name: Lashweed
summary: Lashweeds spew a terrible poison into the eyes of their prey, then move in for the kill with slashing tendrils.

name: Lavaworm
climateTerrain: The Sun, elemental plane of Fire
summary: The lavaworm looks as though it is made of living semimolten rock. It moves about like an inchworm, hunching its body up as it moves its end forward, and lowering its body as its head moves forward.

name: Lebendtod
summary: The lebendtod are a greatly feared form of undead, once believed to exist only in rare and isolated instances.

name: Leech
summary: Giant leeches are horrid, slug-like creatures that dwell in wet, slimy areas and suck the blood of warm-blooded creatures.

name: Leech Toad
summary: Small horns protrude from the heads of leech toads. With pitch-black skin, these creatures are difficult to see at night, when they are most likely to be encountered.

name: Leech, Magical
summary: In the wet grasses of some realms lurk strange leeches capable of draining a wizard's magical essence. They are a bane to any magic-wielding creature or those who depend on spellcasting in combat.

name: Leech, Psionic
summary: These disgusting leeches lurk in ponds, swamps, or other wet areas, waiting to drain the mental energies of any psionicists unlucky enough to wander into their midst.

name: Legacy Leech
summary: A legacy leech is the essence of a tanar'ri that has been banished to the Prime Material Plane. The legacy leech looks like a slug with writhing tendrils along its tail and head and no discernible eyes or facial features.

name: Lemure (Baatezu)
summary: The lowliest denizens of Baator, lernures are grotesque, disfigured blobs of molten flesh, with a vaguely humanoid torso and head.

name: Lensman (Abomination)
summary: A lensman has one eye set in the chest of its five-limbed, starfish-shaped, simian body. Beneath the eye is a leering, toothy maw.

name: Leomarh
summary: The realms of the Great Road don't always answer to the same natural laws that hold sway on the Prime Material Plane. From place to place, local ecologies are dictated by the high-up cutters who rule there.

name: Leprechaun
summary: Leprechauns are diminutive folk who are found in fair, green lands and enjoy frolicking, working magic, and causing harmless mischief.

name: Leshy
summary: Leshies are magical protectors of old and ancient forests. There is always only one leshy per forest, and they can never go more than 100' from their domain, as they are tied to it as a dryad is bound to her tree.

name: Lesser Golem
summary: A golem is an artificial humanoid body which is animated by an elemental spirit and under the control of its creator.

name: Leucrotta
summary: The leucrotta is a creature of ugly appearance and temperament that haunts deserted places in search of prey.

name: Lhee
summary: The lhee are canine pranksters of wildspace, more of a nuisance than anything else. Their behavior swings wildly from acting like regular groundling dogs to being irresponsible imps.

name: Lhiannan Shee
summary: Rare in the extreme, the lhiannan shee (LAN-an SHE) is an undead vampiric spirit with an affinity for men of high Charisma and strong poetic ability – bards. The lhiannan shee looks like a stunningly beautiful female human, elf, or half-elf.

name: Li Lung (Earth Dragon)
summary: A li lung (earth dragon) has a lion's body and tail and a human face. Small black pupils are centered in its golden eyes, and colorful quills resembling the feathers of a peacock extend from its leathery wigs.

name: Lich
summary: The lich is, perhaps, the single most powerful form of undead known to exist. They seek to further their own power at all costs and have little or no interest in the affairs of the living, except where those affairs interfere with their own.

name: Lich's Blood
summary: The lich's blood is an artificial monster created by the necromancers final experiment. Fittingly, the first monster slew its maker before slinking off to find more of his kind, planning to take out its vengeance on all of its creator's ilk.

name: Lich, Defiler
summary: Though there is nothing more loathsome than the foul undead, the defiler lich raises even this putrid circle of fiends to new levels of destruction and malevolence.

name: Lich, Elemental
summary: Elemental liches are diabolical wizards who studied and mastered the use of Ravenloft's strange elements before or during their undeath.

name: Lich, Master
summary: The master lich is a variation of the standard lich developed from a combination of incantations, potions, and promises made to dark, extradimensional powers.

name: Lich, Psionic
summary: There are few who dare to argue that the power of a master psionicist is any less than that of an archmage.

name: Lichling
summary: The lichling is a vicious, insect-like terror spawned from the body of a demilich.

name: Light (Aasimon)
summary: These energy creatures, swirling mists of light that shift shape constantly, are champions of good. Deep inside a light, rainbow colors change rapidly and randomly.

name: Lightning Mephit
summary: A lightning mephit's torso and limbs are thin, jagged bolts of black lightning; its hands and feet are oversized, bulbous, and white.

name: Lillend
summary: Lillendi are natives of Ysgard, though they can travel astrally to the Prime and may also be found on the planes of Arborea and Limbo. On the Prime Material Plane, they prefer to dwell in temperate or tropical woodlands.

name: Lindworm
summary: The lindworm is a deficient form of evil dragon, one that may be born to a black, blue, green, red, or white dragon. This may be due to a curse of the gods or simply nature's way of insuring that the population of true dragons doesn't grow too large.

name: Linqua
summary: Linquas are short, squat humanoids native to Gehenna. Though they appear male, they are actually sexless, being more construct than creature.

name: Lirr
summary: The lirr is a large, warm-blooded reptile that resembles a large lion. It possesses bright, multi-colored plumage that it uses for silent communication.

name: Living Brain (Rudolph Von Aubrecker)
summary: The Living Brain is a horrible result of Victor Mordenheim's early experiments in the creation and artificial sustenance of life. Like many of his other projects, the gods looked upon this as a violation of their sacred tenets.

name: Living Hair
summary: A person who is extremely vain concerning the appearance of his hair can create a living hair creature.

name: Living Lahar
summary: Lahars are the flows of seething black mud that boil down the side of an erupting volcano.

name: Living Steel
summary: Living steel usually appears as a humanoid mass of pure, shining steel, almost liquid in its motions. It reflects bright light and absorbs heat; to those with infravision, it appears as a cold blue lump.

name: Living Wall
summary: Living walls appear to be normal walls of stone or brick, although they radiate both evil and magic if detected. Infravision will not detect any peculiar patterns.

name: Living Weapon
summary: Living weapons are conjured spirits that are bound into weapons by powerful magicians. They are highly evil creatures, capable of animating their weapons and attacking with them.

name: Living Web
summary: Living webs, also known as carnivorous webs or duleep, are omnivores that roam subterranean caverns and deserted ruins.

name: Lizard Man
summary: Lizard men are savage, semi-aquatic, reptilian humanoids that live through scavenging, raiding, and, in less hostile areas, by fishing and gathering.

name: Lizard Man
summary: Lizard men are semi-aquatic, reptilian humanoids that live through scavenging, raiding, fishing, and gathering.

name: Lizard Man (Athas)
summary: Athasian lizard men are amphibious humanoids who survive by herding kreel and by fishing. Adults stand six to seven feet tall, weighing 200 to 250 pounds.

name: Lizard Man (Krynn)
summary: Jarak-sinn are a vile race of lizard men devoted to the worship of Chislev. All civilized races avoid associating with the vulgar, vicious, foul jarak.sinn.

name: Locathah
summary: The locathah are a humanoid race of aquatic nomads that roams warm coastal waters.

name: Lock Lurker
summary: The tiny lock lurker is the bane of thieves and is often placed as a guard against such infiltrators. It looks like a coin – a cold, hard, coppery or bronze disk (25% are silver or golden).

name: Long-necked Merhorse
summary:
This creature is about the
size of the Merhorse, and some people
mistakenly assume they are different sexes of the same species. However, the differences are too great for that.

name: Losel
summary: Losels are an arboreal orc/baboon cross. They resemble a primitive human in some respects, most obviously in torso shape and size, and are strong-shouldered.

name: Lost Souls
summary: Lost souls are the animated mortal remains of wanderers who die in the Nightmare Lands. Different types of lost souls can be encountered in both the Terrain Between and in the dreamscapes.

name: Loup de Noir (Lycanthrope)
summary: The loup du noir, or skinchanger, is a lycanthrope that transforms by donning the skin of a wolf.

name: Loup-garou (Lycanthrope)
summary: Loup-garous are powerful cousins of the common werewolf. Like most true werewolves in Ravenloft, they can assume three forms: human, man-wolf, and wolf.

name: Loxo
summary: A loxo appears to be a humanoid elephant. Its skin is bluish-gray and wrinkled, with rough hair sparsely covering it.

name: Lumineaux
summary: The lumineaux are vast, diaphanous creatures that inhabit the flow. Some sages liken them to the giant mantas of earthly seas.

name: Lung Wang (Sea Dragon)
summary: A relative of the dragon turtle, a lung wang (sea dragon) has a turtle's body, a crested neck, and a head like a shen lung (spirit dragon), complete with long, golden whiskers. Its shell is made of thick green scales with silver flecks.

name: Lupasus
summary: These huge winged wolves are native to the Yazak steppes. Lupasi come in various colors and breeds, much like horses or dogs.

name: Lupin
summary: Lupins are canine humanoids. While a few sages believe the creatures descended from a cross between gnolls and humans, many others argue that they are an offshoot of true werewolves (although lupins abhor all types of lycanthropes).

name: Lurker
summary: The lurker is a carnivorous scavenger found only in subterranean settings. It resembles a large manta ray; its grayish belly is textured like stone.

name: Luthax the Fiery
summary: As the Scourge of Smoke, Luthax the Fiery resembles an ashen gargoyle. His skin is powdery gray and prone to billowing off in acrid puffs, while his wings are made of living smoke and constantly trail long wisps.

name: Lutum (Mud-Woman)
summary: In their true forms, the malicious lutums appear to be amorphous beings of tan, gelatinous clay that move by rolling. They fashion limbs for themselves as needed to aid in locomotion or combat.

name: Lycaeonorukke
summary: Lycaeonorukke (pronounced Lie-KAYon- oh-ROOK-ah), A.K.A. the Silver Wolf, was fashioned by Warthyr the Worrier of Silverymoon as a gift for Lyosse, an adventuring priestess of Tymora.

name: Lycanthrope, Wererat Lord
summary: Wererat lords are the aristocracy of their genotype and as such are capable of much more than ordinary lycanthropes. They generally live longer than others of their genotype who regard them as something near divine.

name: Lycanthrope, Wereshark (Ravenloft)
summary: If all fishermen fear sharks, they fear the wereshark even more so. It is an avaricious hybrid of man and shark or even worse, sahuagin and shark.

name: Lyra Bird, Saragòn
summary: The Saragòn lyra bird is a tiny, colorful bird about the size of a hummingbird. It has a long, pointy beak which it uses to prey upon small insects, especially parasites like cardinal ticks and Inheritor lice.

name: Lyrannikin (Black Treant)
summary: Lyrannikin are treants that have become evil.

name: Lythari (Lycanthrope)
summary: The reclusive lythari, known among the wood elves as silver shadows, are true lycanthropes: good-aligned elves capable of changing into lupine form. The details are for wolf form (no hybrid form).

name: Lythlyx
summary: These strange, eel-like creatures are sometimes called “spirals” because of their appearance. They are almost always found in remote areas, dancing in midair or underwater.

name: Madman Human (The Midnight Slasher)
summary: The city of Karina lies nestled in a wooded valley carved by the sparkling wafers of the Musarde River.

name: Maedar (Medusa)
summary: Maedar attack with powerful fists that each cause 2d4 points of damage. One every three turns, the maedar can turn stone to flesh by touch.

name: Maelephant
summary: The frightening but fascinating maelephants guard the Lower Planes. They are large, roughly bipedal creatures with huge pachyderm heads that have a viciously barbed trunk.

name: Magebane
summary: These mysterious creatures inhabit tombs, ruins, and caverns. They resemble large black bats with needlelike barbed tails and cold, blue, glowing eyes.

name: Magedoom
summary: Non-Zhentish wizards are all viewed as a threat by Zhent wizards. And there are usually lots of wizards, Zhent and non-Zhent, in Zhentil Keep.

name: Maggot Golem
summary: A maggot golem at first glance appears to be a shambling, offwhite mound that is vaguely humanoid but with a constantly shifting form.

name: Magic Golem
summary: A magic golem appears as a humanoid creature composed of iridescent yellow energy – pure magic. It is the unholy union of a human being and an area of wild magic.

name: Magma Mephit
summary: Magma mephits, or lava mephits, are the least intelligent of all mephits and hence the brunt of fire mephit jokes.

name: Magma Paraelemental Beast
summary: Paraelemental beasts of magma are found only near volcanos and other places lava flows to the surface. When summoned they form themselves from the magma as it pours from the ground.

name: Magma Silt Horror
summary: The magma horror inhabits areas that are rife in volcanic activity. It is a blood-red color, deepening to black near the top of the head.

name: Magman
summary: Magmen are creatures of the Paraelemental Plane of Magma. They stand 3 feet tall and are glowing, humanoid creatures, much like fire-cloaked gnomes or goblins.

name: Magran
summary: Magran are huge creatures that dwell on the Ethereal Plane.

name: Maladomini Tiger
summary: SA claw rake - if attack hits with both forepaws, rakes with rear claws for 1d6+1 points of damage each.

name: Malagard, Hag Countess of Malbolge Lord of the Sixth
summary: Formerly ruled by Moloch, who was cast down by Asmodeus, Malbolge is one of the most inhospitable layers of Hell. The current lord is Malagard, the Hag Countess.

name: Malatran Korobokuru
summary: Korobokuru are a race of dwarves who thrive throughout the Living Jungle. A somewhat xenophobic people, their villages tend to be in remote areas of the jungle, and earning their trust is often difficult.

name: Malfera
summary: The malfera is a foul creature summoned from the Dimension of Nightmares, where many bad dreams are bred and released into the minds of sleeping people. A malfera appears only through acts of powerful mortal magic or through the will of an Immortal.

name: Man-Drake
summary: A man-drake is a duck that has the magical ability to periodically assume the form of a very charismatic and comely (but stupid) human, elven, or half-elven male.

name: Mandalain (Night Terror)
summary: The night terror called Mandalain has two distinct forms. Both of these forms have ghostly qualities.

name: Manes (Least Tanar'ri)
summary: Manes are the most pathetic beings on the lower layers of the Abyss, vast and endless as the layers themselves. They have pale white skin that appears bloated.

name: Manggus
summary: The manggus is a powerful evil spirit that lives in the lands of men. There it uses its powers to terrorize and exact sacrifices from the population.

name: Manikin
summary: The manikin, a tiny humanoid with gray or brown rubbery skin, smells of freshly turned earth. It does not speak or write.

name: Manni
summary: The manni, also known as kara or “black ones”, are a pestiferous and evil race that haunt the bleak and wasted corners of the steppe. They are fond of decay and death and are often found near grave mounds and in ruins.

name: Manotaur
summary: A manotaur somewhat resembles a centaur. Unlike a minotaur, which has the body of a man and the head of a bull, a manotaur has the body of a bull and the upper torso of a man.

name: Manscorpion
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical desert or caves
summary: These horrors, sometimes called tlincallis, are part human and part scorpion. A manscorpion has a dark-skinned human torso, its abdomen is protected by bony plates, and its ribs and backbone protrude from the body.

name: Manscorpion, Nimmurian
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical deserts or caves
summary: These part-human, part-scorpion creatures are sophisticated and civilized, while still cruel and self-serving.

name: Mantari
summary: Mantari bear a close resemblance to marine rays, and in fact may be related to them. Mantari have flat bodies about 3' long and 4' wide, and are generally black or dark gray in color.

name: Manticore
summary: The manticore is a true monster, with a leonine torso and legs, batlike wings, a man's head, a tail tipped with iron spikes, and an appetite for human flesh.

name: Mantidrake
summary: The mantidrake is the offspring of a manticore and an evil dragon. It looks like a scaled manticore, with dragonlike wings and a dragon's head instead of a manlike one.

name: Mara
summary: Mara are chaotic evil spirits that inhabit great bodies of stone. In this form they walk the cold regions at night, slaying all who cross their path.

name: Marble
summary: On that horrible night years ago, when Marble's life blood spewed onto Kartak's reconstructed corpse, she willed herself to avenge her murder.

name: Marid (Zakhara)
summary: Marids are genies from the Elemental Plane of Water. In the eyes of many Zakharans, they are the most wondrous and powerful of all geniekind.

name: Marikith
summary: Although marikith are common enough in the domain of Timor, they are only rarely seen, for they slide through the shadows, exposing themselves only when their victim has no chance of escaping.

name: Marilith (True Tanar'ri)
summary: Bold and cunning, mariliths are the generals and tacticians for the Blood War. Where balors are the influence and energy behind the war effort, mariliths are the brains and tactics.

name: Marine Cat
summary: Found only on sailing vessels, this rare breed of cat is thought to bring luck on long voyages.

name: Markeen
summary: A markeen, or genie double, is a lesser form of genie exiled from the majority of their kind. Each genie double is cursed at birth to be the spitting image of a human from Zakhara.

name: Marl
climateTerrain: Temperate or tropical swamps and rivers
summary: Marl are giant aquatic snakelike creatures with hoods like those of cobras. Three to eight arms sprout from a marl's long body each about three feet long and ending in a hand like that of a human.

name: Marraenoloth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: The marraenoloths are a special type of yugoloth. The thin, gray, pale-eyed humanoids are easily identified by their skeletal faces, somber hooded robes, and eyes that glow red when they are angry.

name: Marrashi
summary: The marrashi (plural: marrash), or winged archer, is an evil spirit of pestilence that sometimes agrees to serve a wizard or evil genie in exchange for treasure and the opportunity to spread contagion.

name: Marsh Leopard
summary: Marsh leopards have brown and yellow spots for camouflage. Travelers can detect it by its glowing blue eyes.

name: Marsh Vulture
summary: Their talons and beak are so slime encrusted that there is a 95% chance of catching marsh fever after a single successful attack. - (Page 94 LNA2 Nehwon (9305) )

name: Martinet, Constable of Asmodeus
summary: Martinet is the constable of Asmodeus. His job is to clean up the frequent political messes of Hell.

name: Marut
summary: Maruts are the servants of the powers throughout the Upper Planes. They go forth from Mechanus and spread the powers' will across the Outer Planes.

name: Masgai
summary: The Masgai are tall and long-limbed insect humanoids. They walk upright on spindly legs, and their thin arms extend almost to their knees.

name: Maskhi
summary: Maskhi are humanoids capable of transforming into an animal, tree, or stone. They dwell in small, xenophobic tribes in the wilderness, far from Zakharan civilization.

name: Mason Wasp, Giant
summary: Giant mason wasps are enlarged versions of the normal variety, which is found throughout Zakhara. Both kinds are viewed as messengers of the gods and bringers of good fortune.

name: Master Sea Spawn
summary: The master sea spawn is one of the most horrid creatures to lurk beneath the oceans of the Demiplane of Dread. They infiltrate coastal villages with their disgusting spawn and then use them to take control of the minds they come into contact with.

name: Mastyrial
summary: The mastyrial lives in the desert regions of Athas, spending most of its time hibernating beneath the sands. It resembles an oversized scorpion.

name: Maurezhi (Lesser Tanar'ri)
summary: The maurezhi are a plague in the worlds beyond the Abyss, a scourge of evil that taints any plane it seeps onto. Maurezhi prey on mortals, spreading chaos and evil through their fearsome appetites.

name: Meazel
summary: The meazel is a vicious, malevolent creature that preys on other subterranean dwellers or anyone else in the area. The meazel is slightly smaller than a human.

name: Meazel (Salizarr)
summary: People have always feared the darkness, often with good reason. After all, there are things in the black shadows of night more horrible than any vision that might come to a person in sleep.

name: Mechanical Golem (Ahmi Vanjuko)
summary: Of all the tragic and misshapen creatures to survive the nightmare experiments of fiends like the wizard Hazlik or the mad butcher Markov, none is more dreadful than Ahmi Vanjuko.

name: Mediator
summary: Mediators are proxies of the powers of neutrality.

name: Medusa
summary: Medusae are female humanoids with hair of swarming snakes. They are hateful creatures that can petrify any creature that meets their gaze.

name: Medusa (Althea)
summary: Northwest of the domain of Lamordia, beyond even the terrible Isle of Agony, lies a small island known only as Demise. Those who pass near the island have reported hearing songs of great beauty drifting out across the waves.

name: Meenlock
summary: Meenlocks are shadow-dwelling, bipedal creatures that use gruesome tortures to transform humans and demihumans into monsters like themselves. They are seldom seen, for they shun light.

name: Megapede
summary: Megapedes are colossal centipedes which roam the sandy deserts of Athas.

name: Mek
summary: Meks (possibly a derivative of the word “mechanical”) are huge metallic creations, fabricated by a long-dead race of inhuman, insectlike sorcerers.

name: Meme
summary: A graybeard on the Prime named Mogen Wym believes a body undergoes a gradual process that cycles through every seven years, completely exchanging a body's old tissue for new.

name: Memedi
summary: The memedi include a broad variety of lesser spirits. They are responsible for many of the strange phenomena that frighten and perplex the living.

name: Memento Mori
summary: While most undead are evil parodies of life, one type of undead has an entirely different origin and purpose.

name: Men-shen
summary: Men-shen are greater spirits who serve as guardians. They protect a place or person against intruders, evil spirits, or similar threats.

name: Menglis
summary: The Outer Planes and the Inner Planes differ in many, many ways. One of the most striking differences is that on the Inner Planes, it's possible for a body to walk (or swim, or whatever) from one plane to another.

name: Meorty
summary: Meorties are undead guardians from the Green Age who continue to watch over their ancient domains and enforce their ancient laws.

name: Mercurial
summary: [Items in brackets reflect hyper-reality. The XP award becomes 22,000 in hyper-reality if the mercurial is wearing the manacles of lesser reality.]

name: Mercurial Slime
summary: The mercurial slime is widely feared by wildspace sailors as a mindless, swift, and deadly organism.

name: Mercury Dragon
summary: Mercury dragons are fast, highly-maneuverable creatures with relatively small bodies and long tails. Although good in alignment, they are very whimsical, making and changing decisions frequently.

name: Merendil the Bloody
summary: Merendil the Bloody is the Scourge of War. Her appearance seems a grotesque fusion of woman and insect, with a powerful torso, tiny waist, and a pair of huge wasplike wings.

name: Merhorse
summary:
This creature is built like a
slender-bodied plesiosaur, but appears to be a form of enormous sea lion. It gets its name from an impressive horselike mane of reddish hair on its neck.

name: Merineth the Grasping
summary: Melineth the Grasping is powerful-looking figure with a broad chest, hulking shoulders, and long gangling arms. His face is blocky and ruggedly handsome despite a flat orcish nose, thick jutting brow, and dark goat horns curling up from his hairline.

name: Merkhant (Sect)
summary: Money is power. Ever notice how a cutter with jink seems to avoid all kinds of trouble that a stretched-out sod can't get away from?

name: Merman (Merfolk)
summary: Mermen are marine-dwelling, amphibious humanoids with the upper torso of a human and the lower torso of a fish.

name: Metagolem (Golem)
summary: Metagolems are hollow, metallic humanoid constructs that have been given magical life. There are as many varieties of metagolems as there are metals, ranging from those made of copper to those made of platinum alloys.

name: Metalmaster (Sword Slug)
summary: The metalmaster (or sword slug) is a large, leather-skinned sluglike monster, dull purple to rust-red in hue (rarely, smoky-gray or black), with large sawlike teeth that can bite through metal.

name: Meteorspawn
summary: For as long as the human race has been in space, sages have wondered what creates meteors. The meteorspawn is not necessarily the only source, but its presence certainly explains the reason for some of these flying rocks.

name: Mezzikim (Lesser Baatezu)
summary: Mezzikim are the tortured souls of devils in Hell, sent to the Prime Material Plane to cause pain and suffering among mortals. They are invisible to the naked eye, and insubstantial as well.

name: Mezzoloth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: Mezzoloths, the most common yugoloths of the Lower Planes, are as plentiful as they are lowly and wretched. They look like humanoid insects covered in chitinous plates of a dirty ivory color.

name: Midnight Cat
summary: Little is known about these brooding creatures save that they are found most frequently in the company of evil spellcasters.

name: Milkshade
summary: Milkshades are chocolate-brown shadowy folk who take care of the Holsteins on R.S. Claws' island.

name: Mimic
summary: Mimics are magically created creatures with a hard rock-like outer shell that protects their soft inner organs.

name: Mimic, Greater
summary: Greater mimics are presumed to be either common mimics that have survived for a century or more and grown to great size, or mimics altered by the strange magics of the dungeon and its wizardly denizens.

name: Mimic, House Hunter
summary: House hunters are large relatives of mimics. They have lost some of the latter's camouflage versatility, but they have gained the ability to live above ground.

name: Mimic, Space
summary: Mimics are the result of a magical experiment. Despite their very thick, resilient hide, these creatures have the ability to change their shapes and colors at will in order to fool nearby victims, which they then feed on.

name: Mineral Mephit
summary: These thickly-built mephits look like earth mephits. Their skin and wings glitter with ground mica.

name: Minion of Set
summary: Minions of Set are proxies of Set (of the Egytian mythos). In their natural form, the minions appear to be warriors wielding broad swords and dressed in black, scaly plate mail armor.

name: Minion of Set (Dungeon)
summary: Minions are special servants of the deity Set. These minions usually appear as normal humans or demihumans to do their master's evil bidding.

name: Minion of the Lost
summary: More than two millennia ago, even before the first Adurian tribes fled to Cerilia's shores, Azrai hand-picked twelve vile humans and instructed them in the arts of dark sorcery.

name: Minion Sea Spawn
summary: The minions of the sea spawn are tiny creatures that seek to inhabit the skull of a coastal villager and control his will and body. Their sole purpose is to provide living flesh for their horrid master.

name: Minor Animator
summary: As the weakest of its kind, a minor animator can only take control of small objects. Thus, a minor animator might possess a clay mug and cause it to topple over, spilling the hot coffee within onto its target.

name: Minotaur
summary: Minotaurs are either cursed humans or the offspring of minotaurs and humans. They usually dwell in underground labyrinths, for they are not confused in these places, which gives them an advantage over their prey.

name: Minotaur, Krynn
summary: The minotaurs of Krynn are a highly organized warrior race primarily occupying the remote islands of Mithas and Kothas. Huge and brutish, the minotaurs believe their destiny is to conquer and enslave the world.

name: Misi
summary: When a party encounters a pack of misi, always roll 1d6 to determine the number present, as the number of misi encountered may have a serious effect on any combat that follows.

name: Miska the Wolf-Spider
summary: During the ancient war between Law and Chaos, Miska was an invincible general.

name: Mist Dragon
climateTerrain: Tropical and subtropical/Forests, lake shores, sea shores, and river banks
summary: Mist dragons are solitary and philosophical. Their favorite activity is sitting quietly and thinking.

name: Mist Ferryman
summary: Some call these spectral ambassadors of Ravenloft grim reapers, confusing them with those sinister creatures.

name: Mist Horror
summary: Mist horrors lurk in the swirling banks of fog that encompass all of Ravenloft. Any creature who lingers too long in the mist is sure to draw the attentions, and earn the wrath, of these horrid creatures.

name: Mist Mephit
summary: Both mist and steam mephits originate on the quasielemental Plane of Steam, the only known plane that has spawned two varieties of mephits. Possibly for this reason, the two varieties have developed an intense rivalry bordering on hatred.

name: Mist Wolf
summary: Mist wolves are cousins of normal wolves, but they are larger and have some magical abilities. Although they're lawful good in alignment, mankind's innate fear and hatred of wolves ensure that these creatures are treated with distrust.

name: Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco
summary: Mistinarperadnacles, or Mist as she is more commonly known, is both a typical and an atypical specimen of the red dragon species. Physically, she is as formidable as any red of her age, but psychologically, she's most unusual.

name: Mite
summary: Mites, and the related snyads, are tiny, mischievous humanoids that waylay dungeon adventurers for fun and profit.

name: Mithril Dragon
summary: Mithril dragons are graceful, slender creatures with long necks - which accounts for much of their relatively great body length - and comparatively small heads.

name: Moat Cat
summary: Moat cats are magical crossbreeds of newts and large cats such as cheetahs or mountain lions. Amphibious, they must keep their skin wet, and thus make perfect guardians for a wizard's castle moat.

name: Moigno
summary: uR2B2, 4uR ≠ [not equal to] or ∫ [integral] 2 ∞ [infinity]. лВгƒ [function]; лВг∪ [logical sum and union].

name: Moilian Heart
summary: A moilian heart is an example of a previously undiscovered class of undead creatures created by the dissolution of the lost city of Moil.

name: Moilian Zombie
summary: Moilian zombies usually look like sprawling, frost-coated humans. They lie as dead, although they are not marked by violence, as their deaths came to them in dark slumber.

name: Mold
summary: Molds are a variety of spore-producing fungi that form in decaying food or in warm, moist places. These fungi usually have a woolly or furry texture.

name: Mold II
summary: These deadly molds are spore-producing fungi that grow in decaying organic materials. Like all molds, these have a fuzzy, harmless appearance.

name: Mold Man (Vegepygmy)
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical moist forests and caverns
summary: Mold men, sometimes derogatorily called vegepygmies or even moldies, are short, bipedal fungus creatures. They have sharp, thorn-like claws, and leaf-like tendrils form a fringe on their shoulders, abdomens, and limbs.

name: Mold, Chromatic
summary: Chromatic mold is a spore-producing fungus that grows in warm, damp caverns such as exists in the twisted passages of the Underdark. The fungal growth has a thick, furry texture and appears dark brown in color to normal sight.

name: Molikroth - The Baron of Cania
summary: Molikroth is devious and cruel. No surprise there.

name: Molydeus (Guardian Tanar'ri)
summary: The only guardian tanar'ri, the molydeus enforces the war effort as a sort of political officer.

name: Monadic Deva (Aasimon)
summary: Monadic devas have dark brown skin, jet hair, and piercing green eyes. Their Charisma is 19.

name: Monarch Scorpion
summary: Shattados the Cruel's curse transformed him into a horrific creature, a great and powerful giant scorpion with awesome psionic abilities and a deep hatred for humanity. A new species of scorpion appeared in the desert soon thereafter.

name: Mongrelman
summary: Mongrelmen are a mixture of the blood of many species: humans, orcs, gnolls, ogres, dwarves, hobgoblins, elves, bugbears, bullywugs, and many others. Their appearance varies greatly, combining the worst features of their parent stocks.

name: Mongrelman, Infiltrator
summary: Much as doppelgangers, infiltrators were (and possibly still are) created by wizards as servitors.

name: Mongrelman, Infiltrator
summary: Malatran plantmen are medium to large sized, bipedal fungus creatures. They have sharp, thorn-like claws, and leaf-like tendrils form a fringe on their shoulders, abdomens, and limbs.

name: Monitor
summary: The monitors are benevolent beings who patrol the farflung reaches of wildspace and the phlogiston. However, space is quite large, and the monitors' forces are spread thin.

name: Monkey (Greater Spirit)
summary: Monkey is a truly unique being. Once he was an official of the Celestial Bureaucracy in the Outer Planes.

name: Monolisk
summary: The monolisk is a large, water breathing mammal that hunts schools of fish. It electrically charges the water to stun these creatures, so that it can then scoop them into its huge maw.

name: Monster of Legend
summary: Hydras, chimaeras, gorgons, medusae – any number of bashers have encountered these creatures in the Prime Material Plane, but there aren't so many of 'em out on the Great Ring.

name: Moon Dog
summary: Often mistaken for baneful monsters, moon dogs are native creatures of Elysium and champions of the causes of good. They often appear in the Prime Material plane to fight evil wherever it shows itself.

name: Moon-Horse
summary: Moon-horses, also known as teu'kelytha, are a race of highly intelligent, magic-using horses that are unique to elven lands. These magnificent animals vary from white to silvery-gray in color, with manes ranging from white to black.

name: Moor Man
summary: Moor men are a race of wild humanoids that live in the most dismal fens of Ravenloft. They hunt by ambushing unwary travelers by night and feasting on their steaming remains.

name: Morin
summary: The morin is a dangerous, but rarely seen, creature of the steppes. However, when it does appear, its ferocity, speed, and numerous attacks make it dangerous.

name: Morkoth
summary: Of all the creatures that inhabit the deep, only the kraken exceeds the morkoth in malice and cruelty. Also known as the “wraith of the deep”, the morkoth lurks in tunnels hoping to lure its victims into a trap from which they cannot escape.

name: Morpheus
summary: Morpheus is one of the strangest members of the Nightmare Court, a chaotic imp who loves to confuse, confound, and shock the dreamers who provide the energy to sustain him.

name: Mortai
summary: Mortai are a mystery of the Beastlands, enigmatic creatures of immense intelligence and power. They keep their own darks close in the chest, but they're glad to help a cutter out with just about any problem he might bring before 'em.

name: Mortiss
summary: Mortiss are called the “termites of wildspace” though scholars draw a closer analogy to aquatic coral. Mortiss are a colony of wildspace worms that bore through vegetable and mineral matter.

name: Mountain Dwarf (Hylar)
summary: Mountain dwarves are the oldest of the dwarven races. The best known and most revered of mountain dwarves are the Hylar.

name: Mountain Giant
summary: Mountain giants are huge humanoids that live in remote mountain caverns.

name: Movanic Deva (Aasimon)
summary: Movanic devas have milky white skin and silvery hair and eyes. Their Charisma is 18.

name: Muckdweller
summary: Muckdwellers are a species of small intelligent bipedal amphibians that lurks in swamps, marshes, or still, mud-bottomed waters. They have been known to serve lizard men and kuo-toa.

name: Mud Zombie
summary: Mud zombies are mindless, animated corpses that consist of a thick layer of slimy mud over a framework of bones.

name: Mudman
summary: Mudmen are formed in pools of mud where enchanted rivers (even mildly enchanted ones, such as a stream eroding a magical structure) collect and evaporate and concentrate the dweomer.

name: Mujina
summary: Mujinas are magical creatures created to plague the human race. In their natural form, mujinas look like humans (of either sex) except that they have no faces.

name: Mul
summary: Muls became common shortly after the Cleansing Wars about 2,000 years ago. They were intentionally bred by the sorcerer-kings for use in the armies and gladiatorial arenas of their respective city-states.

name: Mullonga
summary: The aboriginal witch Mullonga is one of the most active members of the Nightmare Court. She may look like an old woman who is so small as to be harmless, but she is evil and malicious.

name: Mummy
summary: Mummies are corpses native to dry desert areas, where the dead are entombed by a process known as mummification.

name: Mummy, Creature
summary: Creature mummies are undead whose bodies are preserved, then animated by their restless spirits. They draw their power from the Plane of Positive Fnergy.

name: Murdakus
summary: These behemoths are more than 90' long when fully grown and vaguely resemble dragons. They have six powerful legs, a pair of batlike wings, and a long prehensile tail tipped with a scythelike stinger.

name: Murderoid
summary: Murderoids, so named by travelers because of their aggressive, evil nature, are perhaps the largest denizens of space.

name: Murska
summary: “Am I the friend you sent out into the night to check on the howlers, howlers that screamed so deliciously in their stables? They are silent now – did you notice?

name: Myconid
summary: Myconids, or fungus men, are a race of intelligent fungi that live in the remote reaches of the Underdark. They are cautious creatures that deplore violence; myconids have no desire to conquer anybody and would prefer to be left alone.

name: Myrlochar
summary: Myrlochar, or "soul spiders,' are the servants of Lolth most often summoned from her dark otherplanar domain by rituals of worship or supplication to the Spider Queen.

name: Mystran Talisman Servant
summary: Created by a powerful mage and a priest of at least 17th level, this talisman servant is named after Mystra, the Lady of Mysteries. The mystran is the most refined-looking of all the talisman servants.

name: Mythuínn Folk
summary: Mythuínn folk look like cute, shaggy teddy bears, roughly the size of a human hand. They have big, deep-brown eyes and white, brown, or black fur.

name: Nabassu (Greater Tanar'ri)
summary: Nabassu are creatures spawned in the Abyss but nurtured on other planes, where they grow and gain power by slaying and devouring humans. They communicate using telepathy.

name: Naga
summary: Possessing high intelligence and magical abilities, naga are snake-like creatures with human heads. They prefer warmer climates and tend not to wander far from their lairs.

name: Nagpa
summary: Nagpas resemble dried, withered humans with the heads of vultures. They are intelligent, magical creatures that shun the company of other races.

name: Nalfeshnee (True Tanar'ri)
summary: Few beings terrify mortals more than the nalfeshnee. Mortals who pass into the Abyss eventually come before one of these “lords of woe”, there to suffer judgment and the pain of transformation.

name: Narek
summary: Alas, poor Narek! One of the many bastard children of Kas the Destroyer, he – it – now resides forever in a prison forged of betrayal and jealousy.

name: Narvaezan Fiend
summary: This creature of half shadow and half substance intentionally materializes as a being of twisted features, with dark horns and squirming shadows behind it. These shadows alternately appear as a billowing cloak or large bat wings.

name: Nasnas
summary: Nasnas are humanoid with only half a body: one arm, one leg, half a face and half a torso. They are the creation of evil priests and wizards desiring vigilant guardians to secure their strongholds.

name: Nat
summary: The nats are a group of lesser spirits who resemble small, squat humanoids. They have brightly colored skins – usually red, blue, or yellow.

name: Nathri
summary: The nathri are 4-foot-tall humanoids with dark greenish skin and long, unruly black hair. Fierce and wild, they nevertheless wear clothes and use weapons, so they're not totally barbaric.

name: Nature Elemental
summary: The nature elemental is a being whose origins date back to the height of Netheril, and adventurers can find the spell to summon one only in libraries and tombs dating back more than 2,000 years.

name: Nautilus, Giant
summary: The giant nautilus is a native of the Elemental Plane of Water. It has also been encountered on Thalasia, a layer of Elysium; the ocean Lunia, on the first layer of Mount Celestia; and on Arborea, in the depths of Poseidon's realm.

name: Nawidnehr (Sharkwere)
summary: The nawidnehr (NAH-widd-near) is a great shark capable of assuming humanoid form. This powerful marine predator has an insatiable desire to kill.

name: Nay-Churr
summary: The nay-churr (the name is singular and plural) are members of a very rare and widely dispersed species whose origin is lost in antiquity.

name: Naàruk (Golem)
summary: Built by enduk priests in their grand temples, the naàruk is a golem which looks like a 10-foot-tall winged bull. The naàruk is usually fashioned of gleaming bronze with extremely lifelike workmanship.

name: Necrophidius (Golem)
summary: The necrophidius, called the “death worm” by some, is an artificial creature, built and animated by a wizard or priest for a single task, such as protecting a particular treasure or assassinating a specific target.

name: Necrophidius and Scarecrow Golem
summary: The necrophidius and scarecrow are constructs like all other golems, but they are less powerful because of the magical shortcuts employed in their construction.

name: Needleman
summary: This wood-dwelling, intelligent form of plant life has many similarities to a zombie, but it is in fact neither animal nor undead.

name: Neglected Spirit, Ancestral
summary: Among the most terrifying monsters that inhabit the Chinese countryside are the neglected spirits of ancestors. As long as one's descendants make the proper sacrifices, ancestral spirits are neutral or beneficent beings.

name: Nemesis Spirits
summary: Nemeses are legendary figures from the folk tales of a specific culture. They may be evil kings, faithless advisers, or monsters, but they are always the epic foes who were overcome by the culture's heroes.

name: Neo-Orog (Orc)
summary: The neo-orog is a magical hybrid of ordinary orcs, ogres, and other creatures. The two breeds of neo-orog, red and black, are warrior creatures, loyal and skillful.

name: Neogi
summary: The neogi appear as a cross between a wolf spider and a moray eel. The short, furry, eight-limbed body is topped by a lithe, bare, fleshy neck with a serpentine head, its mouth filled with needle-sharp teeth.

name: Neogi, Undead Old Master
summary: Certain cunning, magic-using neogi who grow old resist their coming transformation into great old masters, and flee neogi society to achieve undeath through their magic.

name: Neothelid
summary: A slime-covered worm of dragonlike proportions, a neothelid leaves a poison trail of mucous in its wake. It brings its prey down with flesh-corroding exhalations that dissolve all but the fatty brain, an essential component of its diet.

name: Nereid
summary: Many a male has thrown his life away for the fleeting embrace of the “honeyed ones”, the beautiful nereids from the elemental plane of Water.

name: Neshezu
summary: Neshezues resemble large orang-utans, with slight orc and goblin features. An adult male attains a height of about 5 feet and a weight of about 175 pounds.

name: Netherbird
summary: These black, dusty-feathered birds have grotesquely large talons and razor-sharp beaks.

name: Netherese Zombie
summary: Netherese zombies are undead creatures resembling normal zombies that move about the surface of Netheril on various errands for their master, the Lichlord.

name: Nethling (Neth's Child)
summary: Neths children are formed directly from the substance of the Demiplane That Lives. As such, each child is an “avatar” of Neth, going forth from its parent to search for meaning on the Ethereal Plane.

name: Ni'iath
summary: The propensity for creatures to adapt to environments both dangerous and varied is remarkable. No creature offers a better example for this than the ni'iath.

name: Nic'Epona
summary: Nic'Epona, also known as Epona's daughters, are among a few creatures with the ability to move between the planes at will. They are, rumor says, direct descendants of the horse-goddess Epona, and they derive their power from her.

name: Nickel Dragon, Ferrous
summary: Nickel dragons are the weakest of the ferrous dragons. They make up for their smaller size and lesser power with a tenacity and viciousness that would make even the boldest adventurers think twice about wanting to face one a second time.

name: Night Gaunt
summary: These undead were people who made a dark pact with evil forces and died before completing their appointed tasks. They turn as wights.

name: Night Hag
summary: Night hags inhabit the Gray Waste and, practically speaking, rule it.

name: Night Hag (Styrix)
summary: Styrix is a night hag, a member of the foul and horrible race that rules Hades. In her normal form, she appears as a withered old crone with skin the color of a fresh bruise, tangled black hair, and eyes that burn a bright red in the darkness.

name: Night Rider
summary: These undead are created by Myrkul and a few liches and evil clerics. They are usually found as guardians or servants, and resemble zombies or (more rarely) skeletons or partially skeletal corpses.

name: Nightmare
summary: Nightmares, the evil steeds of the Lower Planes, serve as mounts for baatezu, tanar'ri, night hags, and powerful undead lords. They look like large, powerful horses with a jet black coat.

name: Nightmare Beast
summary: Of all the creatures that roam the planet Athas, none except the Dragon is as feared, or as dangerous, as the nightmare beast.

name: Nightmare Man, The
summary: The mysterious entity known as the Nightmare Man rules over the Nightmare Court from his lair in the Grieving Cathedral. It is the Nightmare Man's curse that gives shape to this domain and binds the rest of the Court to the land.

name: Nightshade (Mystara)
summary: Nightshades are powerful beings from the Negative Energy who seek to spread death and destruction everywhere. Similar to undead, they are found on the Prime Material Plane only if summoned by powerful sorcerers for dark purposes.

name: Nightshade (Toril)
summary: Nightshades, or wood woses, are the elemental spirits of poisonous plants like mistletoe, hemlock, foxglove, and belladonna. They live in dark, unhallowed forests and caverns.

name: Nikaal
summary: The nikaal are a mysterious race of lizard-like humanoids. They are far-wandering traders and explorers.

name: Nikt'oo
summary: These large, turtlelike creatures serve as mounts for the more intelligent tortles. Nikt'oos are amphibians, and their shells are just hard layers of leathery skin underlaid with large, bony plates.

name: Ningyo
summary: Eastern relatives of mermen, ningyo are a reclusive, peace-loving race of intelligent sea-dwellers.

name: Nishruu
summary: These weird creatures are believed to come from an alternate Prime Material Plane. Known to sages of old as Eaters of Magic, they feed on magical energy and are greatly feared for the damage they can do.

name: Nixie (Water Sprite)
summary: Nixies are water sprites that live in fresh water lakes, and while they carry no grudge against humankind, they delight in enslaving men as their beasts of burden.

name: Noble Dao (Genie)
summary: Noble dao are the rulers of the genies from the Elemental Plane of Earth. They command earth elementals, dao, xorn, and other slaves who toil for them searching for the gems they prize.

name: Noble Djinni (Genie)
summary: Noble djinn are the rulers of all genies on the Elemental Plane of Air, and they are masters of the province of wind. They can speak their own tongue and that of any intelligent creature they meet through a limited form of telepathy.

name: Noble Efreeti (Genie)
summary: These hulking warlords are the cruel rulers of the efreet, though in theory they all obey the Sultan of the City of Brass. They plot and scheme against one another with a degree of cunning and skill usually seen only in the Lower Planes.

name: Noble Marid (Genie)
summary: Noble marids are masters of the oceans. With currents as their muscles and pearls as their teeth, they are the handsomest and most powerful race of geniekind.

name: Noctral
summary: Noctrals are creatures of Mount Celestia who act as advisers and sages to the other residents of the plane. They're an avian race, resembling great owls with golden eyes.

name: Noran
summary: The noran, although a rather ridiculous-looking creature, is one of the more fearsome monsters one can find underground. It looks like a sickly, petrified treant, with knots and holes covering its entire surface and a face hidden in the trunk.

name: Norker (Hobgoblin)
summary: Distant relatives of hobgoblins, norkers are nasty little humanoids with a war-like disposition. They are intelligent and aggressive.

name: Nosferatu
summary: A nosferatu is a powerful and fearsome undead creature that strongly resembles a vampire. Unlike its dark cousin, the nosferatu neither drains levels nor fears sunlight.

name: Nosferatu (Vampire)
summary: Nosferatu are variants of the common vampire.

name: Noviere (Lesser Eladrin)
summary: The seas and islands of Ossa, the second layer of Arborea, are the home of the noviere eladrins. Like the bralani, the novieres are a people who celebrate the beauty of the lands and emerald waters around them.

name: Nuckalavee
climateTerrain: Temperate or subarctic coastal waters, ruins
summary: Nuckalavee are evil amphibious creatures, related distantly to centaurs. These hideous beings are friendly with all types of undead.

name: Nupperibo (Least Baatezu)
summary: Nupperibos are baatezu petitioners, slightly higher in station than the lemures. They are lowly and woeful beings, used as fighting, feeding, and tormenting stock by all baatezu from the pit fiends on down.

name: Nycaloth (Greater Yugoloth)
summary: Observers and reporters, nycaloths reconnoiter the Lower Planes and observe the Blood War.

name: Nymph
summary: So beautiful that a glimpse can blind or even kill a man, the nymphs are the embodiment of loveliness, a triumph of nature.

name: Nymph, Grain
summary: Grain nymphs are related to their woodland sisters, but have adopted cultivated fields for their homes. Like other nymphs, they are extraordinarily beautiful, possessing great appeal for most males.

name: Nyth
summary: Often mistaken for the eerie will o'wisp, the nyth is a rare predator. It appears as a glowing sphere of light, which it can alter in hue and intensity just as its more famous relative does.

name: Obedient
summary: The Obedient are those unfortunate souls who have been mesmerized into lifelong servitude by the lord of Dementlieu, Dominic d'Honaire.

name: Obliviax
summary: Obliviax is a black moss with an evil nature and the magical ability to steal memories from intelligent creatures. It is called “memory moss” and is a bane to wizards everywhere.

name: Observer (Beholder-kin)
summary: Primes always seem surprised to learn that there are observers that lair on the Outlands and lawful planes, but it only stands to reason that a monster so widespread as the beholder would've spawned planar offspring.

name: Obsidian Retriever
summary: While at first this creature appears to be some form of spider, the obsidian retriever is the product of some ancient Athasian sorcery long lost to the known realm.

name: Octo-Jelly (Octopus)
summary: This deep water predator is a bell-shaped octopus with a pair of swimming fins protruding from its body.

name: Octopus, Giant
summary: The dreaded “cuttlefish” are the scourge of ocean-going sailors and fishermen. Malicious and cunning, giant octopi have been known to attack ships, sinking smaller craft and stealing crew members from the larger ships.

name: Odem
summary: An odem is an undead spirit that moves into living bodies and takes control of them.

name: Ogre
summary: Ogres are big, ugly, greedy humanoids that live by ambushes, raids, and theft. Ill-tempered and nasty, these monsters are often found serving as mercenaries in the ranks of orc tribes, evil clerics, or gnolls.

name: Ogre (Krynn)
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Plain, swamp, forest, jungle, hill, mountain, subterranean
summary: The ogres of Krynn are bloodthirsty, savage brutes. They are feared and despised by all intelligent races.

name: Ogre (Zakhara)
summary: In most lands, ogres are big, ugly, greedy humanoids who live by ambushes, raids, and theft; not so in Zakhara. While still big and ugly by human standards, and sometimes greedy, Zakharan ogres are respected members of civilized society.

name: Ogre, Mischta
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Plains, forests, swamps, jungles, hills, and mountains
summary: Once the Mischta were the great Irda, the First Born, among the noblest and most powerful of all of the humanoid races. But pride caused the Cataclysm to strike against them, and now they are Twilight Irda.

name: Ogre, Nzunta
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Plains, forests, swamps, jungles, hills, and mountains
summary: There is a legend that the First Born, the ancient ogres, will one day rise up and try to dominate Krynn, as they did in the ancient days. Some scholars laugh at these legends; all of the ancient ogres are debased, bestial creatures.

name: Ogrima
summary: Found only in the lands where both ogre and ogre mage dwell, the ogrima is a half-breed resulting from the intermingling of blood between the other two races, although by now the ogrima qualify as a separate race.

name: Ohdowa
summary: The ohdowas are short, scaly humanoids who inhabit caverns and other subterranean areas. They raise snakes and the like, which they have complete control over.

name: Omm-wa
summary: The omm-was, or “water-people” as they are sometimes called, are large, intelligent relatives of the manatee. These air-breathing, marine mammals are found in tropical or subtropical waters and can move freely from fresh water to saltwater.

name: Omshirim
summary: Omshirims look like veins of gold, platinum, silver, or other precious metal embedded in rock. The omshirim is the result of a Herathian magical experiment gone awry.

name: Onco
summary: The onco is an aggressive mammal closely related to the elephant, though it is about the size of a bear. Its tusks never grow to more than one foot in length.

name: Ondonti (Orc)
summary: North of The Ride, in a secluded part of the Tortured Lands, dwells a race known as the ondonti, a close cousin of the orc. This race lives as peaceful farmers and gatherers, taking only what they need from the land to survive.

name: Oni
climateTerrain: Temperate mountains, hills, plains, forests, and subterranean
summary: Oni are ferocious lesser spirits who use their awesome strength and magical abilities to dominate and terrorize the regions they inhabit.

name: Ontalak (Plasmoid)
summary: Ontalaks can produce a covering made of fibrous material that has the density of any material from brass to cloth. They have learned to make coverings of interest to those they feed upon.

name: Onyx Dragon (Mystara)
summary: Onyx dragons inhabit dismal swamps and dark fens. They are not especially intelligent dragons, but are cunning and stealthy when hunting prey.

name: Oortling
summary: Oortlings are a pathetic race, dwelling on the natural comets that exist within the crystal spheres. While the oortlings once had a fairly sophisticated culture, they were dominated by the mind flayers early on in their evolution.

name: Ooze Mephit
summary: These unctuous creatures sidle up to strangers and, in purring, sibilant voices, use flattery to ingratiate themselves. “Oooh, what sssplendid armor!

name: Ooze Sprite
summary: Now here's a misnamed creature. There's nothing less spritely than this pile of ooze and muck.

name: Ophidian
summary: Ophidia, or snakemen, look like large snakes with humanoid arms and hands, but they aren't long and slender like true snake. They are usually mottled green and yellow in color.

name: Opinicus
summary: An opinicus (the term is plural as well as singular) is a desert-dwelling creature of good will. It is an odd-looking creature, seemingly a blend of several creatures.

name: Opposition
summary: Strength comes from adversity. Adversity comes from struggle.

name: Orange Dragon (Sodium)
climateTerrain: Tropical rain forest riverbanks and lakeshores
summary: Orange Dragons are as likely to roar a defiant challenge as to attack from ambush, whichever they think will more terrify their intended victim.

name: Orbus
summary: The orbus is either a genetically bred or a stunted and immature form of the standard beholder. It is only found in space aboard the tyrant ships of the beholder nations.

name: Orc
summary: Orcs are a species of aggressive mammalian carnivores that band together in tribes and survive by hunting and raiding.

name: Oread
summary: Oreads are to mountains what dryads are to oak forests: They are guardian spirits, protectors, and shepherds. Oreads are lithe, stony women with skin the color of the rock of the mountain they protect.

name: Orglash (Ice Spirit)
summary: Orglash are Rashemaar ice spirits that protect high mountain peaks but descend to lower levels in winter. They are chaotic and unpredictable but valued for their role as protectors.

name: Ormyrr
summary: Some sages believe these seldom-glimpsed creatures are natives of another plane. An ormyrr is pale-mushroom white to dun in color, with a purplish underbelly.

name: Orpsu
summary: Orpsu, also known as “night stirges”, are flying predators who feed on fresh blood. They are unrelated to the more common stirge, and do not grip victims to feed.

name: Oscray
summary: The oscray are a race of demi-humans originally descended from orcs. They somewhat resemble orcs, but are larger and have grayer skin than true orcs.

name: Osquip (Rat)
summary: Not all monsters are fearsome dragons and giants. The osquip is a multi-legged giant rodent native to dungeon corridors and cellars.

name: Osyluth (Lesser Baatezu)
summary: The “police officer” of Baator, the osyluth is horrid: bony and wretched, almost a dried husk of a human form, with a fearsome human skull covered by sickly dried skin stretched tight.

name: Otyugh
summary: Otyughs (Aw-tee-ug), also known as the gulguthra, are terrifying creatures that lurk in heaps of dung and decay, waiting for something to disturb it.

name: Overseer (Abomination)
summary: Overseers resemble fleshy trees. They have 13 limbs, each of which ends in a bud that conceals an eye; one of these limbs forms the top spine, and three yammering mouths surround the spine.

name: Owl
summary: Owls are a family of nocturnal birds of prey. There are many different species and varieties are found in every clime but owls are most common in temperate and subarctic climates.

name: Owlbear
summary: Owlbears are probably the crossbred creation of a demented wizard; given the lethality of this creation, it is quite likely that the wizard who created them is no longer alive.

name: Owlbear II
summary: Arctic owlbears are the polar cousins of the normal owlbear. They resemble a cross between a snowy owl and a polar bear.

name: P'oh
summary: This diminutive humanoid boasts impressive powers, and is greatly feared by the common folk. He is among the most arrogant and obnoxious of the lesser spirits.

name: P'oh, Gohei
summary: Gohei p'oh, also known as paper ghosts, are spirits that act as servitors and guards for evil wu jen.

name: Pack Lizard
summary: Pack lizards resemble giant iguanas, except that they are a dull, mottled olive-gray in hue, and are unusually broad of body (averaging 22-24' in overall length, they are always around 10' wide).

name: Pack of the Wild Hunt
summary: The individual hounds of the Wild Hunt are formidable beasts. There are 20 dogs in the pack.

name: Pahari
summary: Pahari are shapeshifting, marine nymphs that dwell in Zakhara's seas and oceans. In their natural forms, they are similar in appearance to mermaids.

name: Paka
summary: Paka are an ancient and sinister race of shapechanging feline humanoids who prey upon the settlements of humankind. Able to pass easily for human, they can spend years sowing evil before their true nature is discovered.

name: Pakubrazi
summary: Pakubrazi are insect creatures that feed on the blood of living creatures. They look like crosses between giant ticks and giant flies.

name: Palimpsest
summary: A palimpsest is a sheet of magical, carnivorous parchment or paper that has become semi-sentient and animated by the magical runes it contained for long ages.

name: Palomino Unicorn
summary: Palomino unicorns have white to creamy yellow hair. Their eyes are usually gray to brown in color.

name: Pan Lung (Coiled Dragon)
summary: Pan lung are a thinner and longer variety of shen lung. A hatchling has grey scales at birth, which change color as the dragon grows.

name: Paper Dragon
climateTerrain: Any place with magical scrolls, books, etc.
summary: Legend holds that this almost twodimensional creature was created to resemble, or possibly is, a true dragon. The wizard responsible for its creation was a bit eccentric (obviously) and had set out to make a guardian for his library of spells.

name: Paraelemental Beast, Sun
summary: Paraelemental beasts of sun can be summoned anywhere there is strong sunlight, of which there is no shortage in Athas.

name: Parai
summary: Native to Mechanus, this creature weals a floor-length black leather dress, the top of which molds to every curve of its body.

name: Parasite (Savage Coast)
summary: Parasites do not inflict combat damage. Each parasite has a special attack mode, outlined below.

name: Pardal
summary: The laziest of the great cats, and also one of the most successful because of its magical method of attack, is the pardal.

name: Pasari-Niml
summary: Pasari-nimal (sometimes called mants) are horrid, tool-using, insectoid predators. They appear to be very large black ants with human heads.

name: Pasocada Ghost
summary: In the Pasocada Basin and in similar areas of the True World, those who die but are not buried properly often return as ghosts who haunt the places of their deaths.

name: Pavilion Dragon (Dragonet)
summary: Pavilion dragons live in the tops of the tallest trees in tropical rainforests. Some people compare them to faerie dragons, colorful tropical birds, or a cross between the two.

name: Pazrael, Abyssal Lord, Tanar'ri
summary: Each Abyssal lord is a single tanar'ri unlike any other, a unique creature with its own interests, strengths, and weaknesses. Most lords rule an entire layer of the Abyss, though the least among them fight for control of a layer with other lords.

name: Pearl Dragon (Neutral)
summary: Pearl dragons are easily identifiable because their scales appear to be made of that precious substance for which they are named. As they age, their scales become increasingly lustrous.

name: Pegasus
summary: Pegasi are magnificent winged steeds that often serve the cause of good. These intelligent creatures are very shy and wild, not easily tamed.

name: Pegataur
summary: Pegataurs are winged centaurs with the upper bodies of elves. They are skilled warriors sometimes hired as mercenaries.

name: Peltast
summary: A peltast is an amorphous creature about the size of three human fists in volume. Its skin has a textured, mottled brown hue resembling worn but sturdy leather.

name: Peluda
summary:
The peluda, or "shaggy beast," is a dragonlike creature with a
long neck and tail, no wings, four feet like those of a giant snapping turtle, and a back covered with bright orange quills. The
base of these quills is pine green.

name: Penanggalan
summary: A female vampire variant of great power and horrifying appearance, the penanggalan appears during daylight as an attractive human female of any character class. This “person” will resemble the penanggalan before its death.

name: Per
summary: Pers guard the portals of the Upper Planes. They are tireless warriors at those gates.

name: Pernicon
summary: The pernicon is a brightly colored insect that resembles a grasshopper. lts coloring is an odd mixture of red, yellow, ochre, and blue.

name: Peryton
summary: High above the mountains and rocky hills of most lands flies a sharp-eyed monster known as the peryton. Intelligent, patient, and malevolent, it watches and waits for prey – to pluck their hearts out.

name: Petrification and Phobia Virus
summary: The petrification virus causes its victim's body to gradually harden and eventually turn to stone.

name: Phaerimm
climateTerrain: Any (in Faerûn, confined to subterranean Anauroch)
summary: Phaerimm are powerful magic-using beings that move by natural levitation. They resemble upright cones, the widest part uppermost, and the point ending in a barbed stinger-tail.

name: Phaethon
summary: In their normal state, phaethons look just like very thin, short half-elves. Their hair color varies, though bright, coppery red is common.

name: Phanaton
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical jungles and forests
summary: Phanatons are odd, seldom-seen, intelligent forest-dwellers that have very strong ties to nature.

name: Phantom
summary: Phantoms are images left behind by particularly strong death traumas. A phantom is like a three-dimensional movie image filmed at the time of death, in the place where it died.

name: Phantom Flyer (Golem)
summary: This magical creation offers swift and discreet service in the realms of the night. It can hide from prying eyes during the day until the disappearance of the hateful light.

name: Phantom Stalker
summary: Phantom stalkers are creatures from the Elemental Plane of Fire, and are found on the Prime Material Plane only in the role of servants to high-level mages.

name: Phaze Troll
summary: Phaze trolls appear as normal trolls in most regards. However, they are only slightly more than half as tall as a true troll and their frames are thick with corded muscle.

name: Phirblas
summary: “The chant says that there wasn't always a City of Doors or a Lady of Pain. Sometime in the past, she built the city as a… well, no one knows the dark of why.

name: Phiuhl
summary: Dark and horrible is the realm of Gehenna, where the only source of light is the magma from the spewing volcanoes, and scalding heat and acidic condensation fill the air. From these horrible conditions, the phiuhl is born.

name: Phlog-Crawler
summary: The phlog-crawler is a form of phlogiston entity. It takes the form of a piece of the phlogiston and enjoys total access to wildspace.

name: Phoenix
summary: The phoenix is a great, extra-planar bird thought to represent the spirit of freedom and rebirth. It is a mortal creature that displays the ultimate in godlike detachment.

name: Phouka
summary: The phouka is a very strange creature. It seems to have no natural form of its own but can take any shape it pleases at will.

name: Phthisic
summary: The phthisic begins as a repressed memory or a buried neurosis. A skilled illithid can wrench this creature free from the subconscious mind and physically embody it in living, breathing flesh!

name: Piercer
summary: Piercers resemble stalactites found on cave roofs. They are actually a species of gastropods that, without their shells, resemble slugs with long tails.

name: Pigeontoad
summary: These awkward, oviparous crossbreeds are usually found only in swampy conditions, although they sometimes dwell in dark forests near pools of water. They have also been found underground, but again only when they have easy access to water.

name: Pinto Unicorn
