summary: Pinto unicorns are unicorns with patches of differently colored hair distributed randomly upon their hides. They usually have doe-brown eyes, but some have green and some have yellow.

name: Piranha
summary: With the exception of the shark, there is no more feared fish than the piranha, the terror of tropical rivers. For sheer voraciousness, the piranha has no equals.

name: Piranha Ant
summary: At a mere inch in length, an individual piranha ant is easily dismissed as a harmless insect unworthy of notice.

name: Piscoloth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: Piscoloths are the sergeants and overseers of yugoloth mercenary armies. These creatures hold dictatorial sway over companies of dergholoths and mezzoloths throughout the Lower Planes.

name: Pit Fiend (Greater Baatezu)
summary: The most terrible baatezu of the Nine Hells, pit fiends appear to be giant, winged humanoids, very much like gargoyles in appearance, with huge wings that wrap around their bodies for defense.

name: Pit Snatcher
summary: Pit snatchers are creatures that dwell in the tar pits of Athas.

name: Pixie
summary: Of all of the magical faerie-kin (brownies, sprites, nixies, leprechauns, and pixies), pixies are perhaps the most intelligent and mischievous.

name: Plague Moth
summary: These peculiar creatures were created by the wizard in an attempt to manufacture potions “naturally”. The moths turned out less than perfect, with a tendency to produce bad potions and an intense craving for blood.

name: Plains Cat
summary: Plains cats are large black felines with bobbed tails. The males have distinctive white tufts of hair at the ends of their ears.

name: Plainsjan
climateTerrain: Deserts of Anadia and other planets
summary: These creatures look much like gremlins or imps, belonging in fact to the same family.

name: Planetar (Aasimon)
summary: Planetars are powerful spirits that directly serve the powers of the Upper Planes. They are tall, commanding humanoids who have smooth emerald skin, white feathered wings, hairless heads, and eyes of a penetrating blue.

name: Plant, Carnivorous (Oerth)
summary: These two species of deadly plants are considered to be corrupted offshoots of treants. As such, these creatures tend to resemble withered, decrepit old trees of various species common to the local area.

name: Plant, Dangerous II
summary: The bloodthorn, or vampire thorn vine, resembles a normal patch of thorny vines. A healthy adult bloodthom has a 10-foot-long yellowish brown trunk from which four tendrils spring.

name: Plant, Vampire Moss
summary: Vampire moss hangs from trees and branches in marshy or tropical environments, waiting for other creatures to wander past it so that it can feed upon them.

name: Plasm
summary: Plasms are hideous skeletons composed of solid ether and raw elemental matter; they are usually encountered on the Ethereal Plane or their respective Elemental Planes, but can be brought to the Prime Marerial Plane through planar gates.

name: Plasman
climateTerrain: Any land, fire-based worlds, cool stars
summary: Plasmen are the peculiar constructs of deranged wizards, conjured simultaneously from the elemental planes of Fire and Earth. Bizarre and completely unnatural (even from a magical standpoint), plasmen are internally at war with themselves.

name: Plumazotl
summary: Payit legends tell of a time long ago when a powerful plumaweaver, Itzamna Manik, set out to create life with his magic. After many years of labor, using spells that have long been forgotten, he created a plumazotl, a living creature of pluma.

name: Plush Golem
summary: Plush golems are every parents nightmare. They are typically given as gifts to young children, usually by obnoxious aunts or uncles.

name: Poisonous Eel
summary: These eels are a Lankhmar delicacy, but retain their poison unless properly cooked. Their bike is poisonous (saving throw vs.

name: Poltergeist
summary: Poltergeists are the spirits of restless dead. They are similar to haunts but are more malevolent.

name: Polyroach
summary: Polyroaches are a magical breed of the common city cockroach able to merge into larger versions of themselves.

name: Porcupine
summary: Porcupines are large rodents native to temperate forested areas. There are many species of porcupines that differ only in minor details.

name: Porton
summary: The porton is a strange creature unique to the world of Gnibile. It appears as a shimmering disk, definitely insubstantial and not truly visible in and of itself.

name: Power Symbiont
summary: Power symbionts are the bane of all spelljamming farers. They do nothing but rob the power from various magical items on the ship.

name: Power Tree (Living Machine)
summary: Power trees are vast, slow-moving towers of metallic beams branching from a squat, multi-legged base covered in huge, polished plates of crystal that harness the power of sunlight.

name: Primal (Sect)
summary: "Power told is power lost." So states the creed of the Primals, an extremely secretive society based on the Inner Planes .

name: Prince Levistus of Stygia Lord of the Fifth
summary: Levistus has a long history in Hell. Some experts say that he is even older than Dispater, a claim hotly contested by supporters of the Lord of the Second.

name: Princess Glasya, the Dark Prodigy
summary: Princess Glasya is the daughter of Asmodeus and Bensozia. The circumstances of her conception and birth are mysterious, and Asmodeus is not known to have any other children.

name: Prismatic Dragon
summary: Prismatic dragons are closely related to the gem dragons, although some of their characteristics, and their almost superstitious reverence for copper dragons suggest that they are somehow related to that subspecies as well.

name: Pristatic
summary: Pristatics resemble a sphere of swirling colors, much like the prismatic sphere spell. Within the sphere is the actual pristatic, a small gnome-like humanoid.

name: Prolonger
summary: The Prolongers - also called Cheaters - are a secret brotherhood of cutters who believe that life is the only point to living, and that death is the end, or the doorway to a dark and frightening eternity.

name: Propagator (Living Machine)
summary: Propagators appear in a variety of animalistic and humanoid shapes, from a distance. From within 30 feet, it's easy to see the "animal" for what it is: a sheen.

name: Protein Polymorph
summary: Protein polymorphs are intelligent cellular colonies with the ability to assume almost any form they choose. In their natural state, they appear as large amorphous blobs or columns of glistening, protoplasmic gray matter.

name: Pseudo-Familiar
summary: A pseudo-familiar is a twisted, evil creature that appears to be a normal wizard's familiar.

name: Pseudodragon (Dragonet)
climateTerrain: Temperate or subtropical forests and caves
summary: Pseudodragons are a species of small flying lizard that inhabits heavily forested wilderness areas. These playful, benign creatures have magical powers that they can share with others, so they are often sought as companions.

name: Psionic and Shadow Virus
summary: The psionic virus opens pathways in a victim's mind, granting the character tremendous psionic abilities whether or not he had them before the infection.

name: Psionocus
summary: A psionocus is a creature created by powerful psionicists for use as a familiar and a scout.

name: Psurlon
summary: Psurlons are extremely intelligent wormlike humanoids. The psurlons are an advanced race living on the Astral Plane, and are sometimes summoned by evil psionicists who have the power to summon planar creatures.

name: Pteraman
summary: In effect, pteramen have three forms: that of a lizard man with no tail, a lizard man with webbed wings, and a miniature pteranodon with a 15-foot wing span. This third form is achieved by a natural polymorph ability.

name: Pterran
summary: Pterrans are a race of lizard men who inhabit the Hinterlands near the Ringing Mountains.

name: Pterrax
summary: Pterrax are large pteranodon-like creatures which are capable of flight. They occupy the plains and rocky barrens of Athas.

name: Puddingfish
summary: The puddingfish is a gigantic sort of jellyfish found only in Athas's Last Sea. It looks similar to a traditional jellyfish, only larger and slightly more substantial.

name: Puffer
summary: The puffer is a durable creature that can bear the rigors of wildspace for years at a time while in its dormant state.

name: Pulp Bee
summary: Pulp bees are large wasps which inhabit the plains along the edges of the Athasian deserts. Pulp bees secrete a pasty substance which hardens into a material similar in texture and consistency to wood.

name: Purple Dragon (Energy)
climateTerrain: Prairie, grasslands, and low scrub-covered hills
summary: Purple Dragons are deeply, sadistically evil. They delight in spreading fear far and wide, combining raids for food with outright destruction and mayhem.

name: Pyreen
summary: Pyreens (or Peace-Bringers) are mysterious beings that roam the world of Athas. They are powerful psionicists and very powerful druids.

name: Pyrolisk
summary: Frequently mistaken for its less malignant relative, the pyrolisk is virtually identical to the cockatrice except for the single red feather in its tail and the reddish cast of its wings.

name: Pyroserpent
summary: The pyroserpent is a feared denizen of the phlogiston. It is a large snake about 15 feet long, covered with slick scales of the same swirling rainbow color as the phlogiston (effectively giving it +1 to surprise).

name: Q'nidar
summary: The q'nidar are bat-like creatures that frequent the warmer areas of wildspace in search of food. They appear as gigantic bats with a semi-crystalline hide (not unlike that of the radiant dragon in appearance).

name: Quaggoth
summary: Quaggoths are humanoids with long, shaggy, white hair covering their entire bodies. They wear no clothing.

name: Quakedancer
summary: The quakedancer (a.k.a. quakebeast, quakemaker, thunderer) is a large reptilian beast that resembles a Brontosaurus, except for the fact that it has six legs.

name: Qualinesti (High Elf)
summary: The Qualinesti, also known as the Western Elves, are exiles from the Silvanesti High Elves.

name: Quelzarn
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate fresh and salt water
summary: Quelzarn are giant, solitary water snakes found in both fresh- and saltwater. They are swift, agile hunters, and may be of magical origin.

name: Quesar
summary: Quasar, it is said, were created by a group of lawful aasimon to serve as guardians over celestial treasures. These aasimon went to the radiant plains of Elysium and into the layer known as Belierin.

name: Quevari
summary: The quevari are a race almost indistinguishable from normal humans. As a rule, they are friendly and helpful people who seem to go about their lives without concern for the evils that abound in the land around them.

name: Quickwood
summary: This great hardwood tree appears to be an oak, although close inspection reveals that it has a visage and sensory organs that resemble a distorted human face.

name: Quill
summary: Quills are natural animals native to some of the most inhospitable reaches of the Great Wheel.

name: Raaig
summary: Raaigs are incorporeal undead who serve as guardians of temples dedicated to ancient, long-forgotten gods. All raaigs are thousands of years old and the shrines they guard include stone buildings, underground complexes, wooded groves, and deserted grottos.

name: Rabbiun
summary: The serpentine rabbiun fly like spears through the Deep Ethereal, fying to avoid all beings larger than themselves. Fact is, rabbiun are just animals that migrated to the Ethereal ages ago.

name: Racked Spirit
summary: Racked spirits are the evil remnants of persons who committed acts during their lives that violated the very nature of their being.

name: Radiant Golem
summary: The radiant golem is a unique creature that some claim is as old as the races of elves, gnomes, and dwarves.

name: Radiant Mephit
summary: Prone to non sequiturs and glazed looks, radiant mephits appear permanently, blissfully dazed by the glories of the quasi-plane of Radiance. They peer fixedly at people and say things like, “Have you too seen the majesty of the Ultimate Light?

name: Radiant Spirit
summary: A radiant spirit is the ghost of a powerful paladin or lawful good cleric killed while pursuing a holy cause. The anguish that fills his heart traps his spirit on the demiplane and taunts him with the failure of his quest.

name: Rager (Sect)
summary: Ask any blood in Sigil, and she'll tell you that the Ragers are a band of addle-coved bashers who're a menace to anything in their path. Then she'll tell you what she really thinks, in words that can't be repeated here.

name: Ragnhilder
summary: The ragnhilder are as large as normal trolls but are weaker (18 strength, +2 damage) and sometimes use hand-to-hand weapons.

name: Rain Linnorm Dragon
summary: Rain linnorms are quite vain, to the point of demanding credit for their atrocities. The more heinous the act, the more powerful the rain linnorm feels.

name: Rain Paraelemental Beast
summary: Paraelemental beasts of rain are the rarest of all the paraelemental beasts because they can only be conjured where it is currently raining.

name: Rakasta
climateTerrain: Temperate to tropical plains and deserts
summary: Rakasta are a race of intelligent, nomadic, catlike humanoids. They are a proud, barbaric race of warriors who, while not prone to initiating hostilities, quickly respond when provoked.

name: Rakshasa
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical forest, jungle, or swamp
summary: Rakshasas are a race of malevolent spirits encased in flesh that hunt and torment humanity. No one knows where these creatures originate; some say they are the embodiment of nightmares.

name: Raptor Bird
summary: These great birds soar over the high peaks of Kharolis, making their nests among the in accessible reaches of the Anviltops. Throughout the centuries they have developed a wary respect for the dwarves.

name: Rasclinn
summary: The rasclinn is a small dog-like creature that feeds on almost any vegetation that grows in the Athasian badlands. They extract trace metals from the plants, which gives them an almost metallic hide.

name: Rast
summary: Amid the cinders and soot of the Quasiplane of Ash, amid the choking clouds and wisps of smoke, the rast makes its home. The main body of the creature is fairly small – just big enough to hold its stomach and heart, really.

name: Rastipede
summary: The rastipede is an insect-like creature that can be encountered virtually anywhere, usually accompanying a wide variety of other creatures. A rastipede has a hard shell covering its body, which accounts for its low Armor Class.

name: Rat
summary: Rats are long-tailed rodents 5-12 inches long. They are aggressive, omnivorous, and adaptable, and they often carry diseases.

name: Rat (Greyhawk)
summary: Camprats are rodents with voracious appetites that belie their small size. They're generally harmless, but their ability to get their teeth into anything edible is aggravating to travelers.

name: Rat Burglar
summary: Rat burglars are magically-enhanced rats, usually dirty gray or black, with beady red eyes. They appear to be no different from the ordinary black rat, but appearances are definitely deceiving.

name: Ratatosk
summary: Ratatosk are tree-dwtlling gliders, able to leap wide chasms from branch to branch of Yggdrasil with sure-fooled ease.

name: Rautym
summary: The rautym resembles a small, eyeless, hairless, freckle-backed monkey. It is never found far from its companions, not because it is fearful, but because rautym gain power by being together.

name: Raven/Crow
summary: Ravens and crows are large, black birds known primarily as one of nature's primary scavengers. They are often mistaken as bad omens by superstitious farmers and peasants.

name: Ravenkin
summary: The ravenkin are an avian race that have been trapped within the misty confines of Ravenloft. They are on of the few forces for good in this otherwise dark land of evil.

name: Ravenous
summary: The ravenous are zombie-like creatures created by Meyanok's famine in the city-state of Tolanok. They appear to be normal humans or mundane snakes that move with a slight stiffness and look emaciated as if from starvation.

name: Ravid
summary: The ravid is a creature native to the Positive Energy Plane. That alone makes it a rare beast, since very little life hails from that brilliant place.

name: Ray
summary: Rays, also known as sea bats, are native to warm tropical shallow waters. They are broad, flat creatures, with eyes on the upper, dark-colored surface of their body and the mouth and gills on the lighter underbelly.

name: Razhak
summary: Razhaks do not care for combat, being essentially peaceful creatures. But if pressed, they strike with up to four pseudopods (formed from their bodies).

name: Razorvine
summary: Razorvine's a fact of life in Sigil and on some of the Lower Planes. It's a black-leaved creeper or ivy with an exceptionally sharp-edged stem hidden under the lush foliage.

name: Razorwing
climateTerrain: Sea of Silt, Inland silt basins
summary: The razorwing hides under the silt and bursts out of the sand to slash at creatures flying above it. It is a vicious carnivore, and packs of razorwings have brought down creatures much larger than themselves.

name: Reave
summary: The reaves are a race of violent marauders and plunderers who live for battle and pillage. They've been wandering the planes for centuries now, preying on the weak and defenseless wherever they find them.

name: Reaver
summary: The race of reavers are an evil and dark people who live beneath the waves on Ravenloft's western shore. Here, they lurk in hopes of attacking swimmers, fishermen, and small ships.

name: Recluse
summary: Recluses are female Vistani who have decided to forego their clan and commune with the spirits that thrive on the Demiplane of Dread.

name: Red Dragon
climateTerrain: Tropical, sub-tropical, and temperate hills and mountains
summary: Red dragons are the most covetous and greedy of all dragons, forever seeking to increase their treasure hoards. They are obsessed with their wealth and memorize an inventory accurate to the last copper.

name: Red Silt Horror
summary: The red silt horror is the most mobile of the horrors, able to propel itself across the surface of Athas using four tentacles that can support its weight.

name: Red Widow
summary: The red widow, or spider queen, is an evil and deadly shape changer. Spinning a web of evil to all the lands about its lair, this foul creature derives a vile pleasure in the murder of those lured to it by its many charms and promises of delight.

name: Red Zombie
summary: Red zombies are usually formed when a wicked mage or priest uses the spell animate dead to enchant the corpse of an Afflicted person.

name: Reef Giant
summary: Reef giants are the loners of giant-kind, although they often live in remarkably well-appointed mansions that seem to be no more than huts from the outside. They sometimes become sailors, but their huge mass limits them to the largest of vessels.

name: Reggelid
summary: Reggelids are tall and angular, looking something like ugly elves with flat faces and an extra finger on each hand. Their origin is unknown, even to them, but they seem unconcerned about preserving their past or their heritage.

name: Reigar
summary: The reigar are a near-legendary race, only rarely encountered by the average spacefaring adventurer. They are famed for their artistic prowess and fabulous command of craftsmanship.

name: Reindeer
summary: The 10 reindeer who pull TG's sleigh of delivery are Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Conner, Blitzen, Rudolf, and Buck (Common myths are inaccurate as to the correct size of TG's herd; it actually contains 10, not nine, deer.

name: Remorhaz
summary: Remorhaz, sometimes known as polar worms, inhabit only chill arctic wastes. They are very aggressive predators that devour any animal matter, including humans, demihumans, and humanoids; they have even been known to attack frost giants.

name: Render
summary: Created deep within the experimental labs of Darkhold, the render is without a doubt one of the most savage creatures to ever walk the face of Faerûn.

name: Render (Living Machine)
summary: These terrible machines resemble monstrously swollen insects, complete with dozens of writhing metallic legs, feelers, and lethal projections good only for cutting and ripping.

name: Renegade Halfling
summary:
While most 
halflings found on Athas belong to the more or less civilized clans located in the Forest Ridge near the Ringing Mountains, there exist tribes of so-called “renegade” halflings.

name: Resident
summary: A resident is a tormented soul, doomed to exist among the living until it can find self-forgiveness.

name: Retriever
summary: Retrievers are living constructs, creatures of nightmare manufactured by the tanar'ri lords to act as their emissaries and enforcers.

name: Revenant
summary: Revenants are vengeful spirits that have risen from the grave to destroy their killers. The revenant appears as a spectral, decayed version of its appearance at the time of its death.

name: Reverend Ones
summary: There is much debate among elven scholars as to exactly what the reverend ones are. Some claim that they are spirits of ancient elven warriors who have chosen to fight for their people even beyond the barrier of death.

name: Reviler
summary: Revilers are undead spirits similar to haunts. They are created by evil gods for the purpose of spreading strife, woe, and terror.

name: Rhaumbusun
summary: The rhaumbusun is a small, reptilian creature distantly related to the basilisk. It is a timid herbivore wih a dangerous paralyzing gaze.

name: Rhoeghn
summary: The rhoeghn (ROON) resembles a human child, though its skin is the color of rich, brown earth. Its long, flowing locks are green and leafy.

name: Riding Lizard
summary: Riding or “mount” lizards are light, sleek reptiles, able to run swiftly on their hind legs when unencumbered. Unknown on the surface, they take the place of the horse as the general steed of intelligent races in the Underdark.

name: Rilmani, Cuprilach
summary: Cuprilachs're the spies, assassins, and secret soldiers of the rilmani.

name: Rilmani, Ferrumach
summary: When the rilmani are moved to take direct action in the cause of neutrality, it's the ferrumachs who answer the call of duty. They're the soldiers of the Spire, the iron legions who wait to serve in battle whenever and wherever they're needed.

name: Rilmani, Plumach
summary: The least powerful rilmani are the plumachs, the common citizens of the Spire. Their brand of neutrality is the simplest and most apathetic view held hy the rilmani: Don't get involved.

name: Ring-Worm
summary: If a party of adventurers finds a ring-worm, they see a plain gold ring. It can be worn as a ring and radiates an aura of weak magic.

name: Roc
summary: Looking almost too big to be real, rocs are huge birds of prey that dwell in warm mountainous regions and are known for carrying off large animals (cattle, horses, elephants) for food.

name: Roc (Athas)
summary: The Athasian Roc is a huge bird of prey that dwells in warm mountainous regions. It is known for carrying off large creatures (kanks, inix, and erdlu) for food.

name: Roc, Zakharan
summary: Rocs are huge raptors that dwell in Zakharan mountains and on rocky, secluded islands. They frequent regions in which they can readily find large prey, such as the mountains bounding the Ruined Kingdoms and the island of Afyal.

name: Rock Cactus
summary: Rock cacti are small, spherical plants that can be found anywhere water is not plentiful. They are generally brown in color, but deepen to black as they increase their fluid storage.

name: Rock Hopper
summary: Rock Hoppers are small humanoids about the size of gnomes. Their backs and the backs of their arms and legs are covered with very short, white hair.

name: Rock Man
summary: Rock men are cone-shaped humanoids with the appearance of granite. Devoted mountain dwellers who jealously guard their territory, rock men are fond of gems and little else.

name: Rockseer (Elf)
summary: Rockseer elves are the rarest of all elvenkind. They are far taller than most of their kin, with a few reaching almost eight feet in height.

name: Rogue Hero
summary: Rogue heroes are hero spirits who have been forgotten by their peoples or turned into figures of evil.

name: Rogue Moon
summary: The rogue moon, a wandering monster the size of a whale, earned its name from the fact that it resembles a ball glowing in the dark. It dwells in the more remote regions of wildspace where, from a distance, it may be mistaken for a moon.

name: Roller (Living Machine)
summary: A roller's body is composed of two parts. The lower chassis takes the form of six metallic barrel-like wheels on flexible axles.

name: Roller (Living Machine)
summary: Among the most recent generation of sheens sporting dangerous new abilities, the phaser is the least noted. The reason: The phaser can skip through solid matter like a flat stone skips on water.

name: Rom
summary: The rom are a race of subterranean, undead giants that withdrew from the surface world in the distant past. They are sullen, malicious, and angry creatures, attacking any who disturb their final dwelling places or cairns.

name: Roper
summary: A roper resembles a rocky outcropping. The creature's hide is yellowish gray and rough, and its body very malleable.

name: Rot Grub
summary: Rot grubs are disgusting little creatures that resemble maggots. They would be considered inconsequential if not for their horrifying attack form.

name: Rothé
summary: Rothé (pronounced "roth-AY") are squat, strongly-built creatures who resemble musk oxen - with curving horns, cloven hooves, and long, shaggy coats of thick hair.

name: Ruby Dragon (Mystara)
climateTerrain: Non-arctic hills and mountains, and any subterranean
summary: At a distance of 120 feet or more, the ruby dragon cannot be distinguished from a red dragon. At closer ranges the dragon's scales shimmer, revealing the mighty reptile's true nature.

name: Ruktoi
summary: The ruktoi is a solitary sentinel of the silt sea, able to paddle along its surface or lurk just beneath patiently awaiting prey. Some ruktoi have been captured and either domesticated or controlled to ferry passengers or small cargos across the endless silt basin.

name: Rushlight
summary: Rushlights are malevolent spirits of the pyre that escape their burning beds to spread fire and death to the denizens of Ravenloft.

name: Rust Monster
summary: Rust monsters are subterranean creatures with an appetite for all sorts of metals. These unique creatures, though generally inoffensive, are the bane of fighters everywhere.

name: Rutterkin (Least Tanar'ri)
summary: The rutterkin are pathetic, malformed tanar'ri. They wander the planes of the Abyss, outcasts in their own deranged society.

name: Ruve
summary: Ruve are a breed of dog which possesses formidable intelligence and psionic powers. Their coloring ranges from a sandy brown to glossy black, and they are often mistaken for wild dogs or war dogs.

name: Ruvoka
summary: As if geniekind, elemental grues, animentals, Archomentals, and, of course, elementals themselves weren't enough, the Elemental Planes are also the home of the ruvoka.

name: Ruvoka (Athas)
summary: Ruvoka are creatures from the elemental planes. They travel the planes easily, even the Astral Plane, but on Athas they are bound to certain locations.

name: S'kin'di, T'chowb Agent of Abalach-Re
summary: More information on the t'chowb can be found in the DARK SUNtm Monstrous Compendium. As always, the DM must know the strengths and weaknesses of this NPC to use him to the fullest.

name: Sabreclaw
summary: Saberclaws are large, hairy, flying creatures magically created from tainted waters through an ancient spell. These magical creatures act as agents for the evil wizards and priests who create them.

name: Sabu Lord
summary: Sabu lords, or Lion Lords, are proud giant cats that live on the arid plains and savannahs of Zakhara. These intelligent lions are extremely territorial and will harass those who travel through their domains without first asking permission.

name: Sacaanti
summary: A sacaanti is a magical amalgamation of an imp and a quasit. Sacaantis are used by evil Zhentarim wizards as utterly loyal familiars.

name: Sacrol
summary: Sacrols are undead entities of fearsome power and overwhelming hatred. They are spawned in sites of great death, and they exist solely to bring more living creatures into the realm of the dead.

name: Sahuagin
summary: Sahuagin are a vicious, predatory race of fish-men that live in warm coastal waters. They are highly organized and greatly enjoy raiding shore communities for food and sport.

name: Sakina
summary: Sakina are friendly air sprites, faerie creatures native to Zakhara. They roam the skies looking for interesting scents and amusing adventures.

name: Salamander Noble & Lesser
summary: Most folks have heard of salamanders – the creatures appear more frequently than a body'd think, even off the Elemental Plane of Fire – but few really know the dark of them. See, the creatures've got a fairly complex life cycle.

name: Salt Golem (Athas)
summary: The salt golem is created by powerful defilers and sorcerer kings and is favored by those near the salt flats. The golem is 8 feet tall and weighs roughly 600 pounds.

name: Salt Mephit
summary: Salt mephits look like grainy white humanoids with wings made of cubical white crystals. They have large red eyes and gaping, grinning mouths.

name: Salt Spider
summary: They build large webs, some stretching 150', to trap prey. Their wide food pads allow them to move over water easily.

name: Sand Bride
summary: The sand bride is a negative material plane creature trapped on Athas. It uses its powers of illusion to lure victims to a cold death.

name: Sand Cactus
summary: Sand Cacti are a vile form of plant life that dwells anywhere there is sand. It feeds on the blood of its victims.

name: Sand Cat
summary:
The sand cat is a small desert feline that preys on many of the small mammals of the desert and dry steppe regions. Slightly larger than a regular 
house cat, it is a sandy brown color.

name: Sand Cow
summary: Sand cows are six-legged crosses between a bull and a camel, native to Arcadia; their hide is white, and they whistle softly as they walk. (In the Cage: A Guide to Sigil - Page 112)

name: Sand Howler
summary: Sand howlers are desert-dwelling creatures that hunt in packs. They are known for their terrible howls that they use to signal each other when tracking down then prey.

name: Sand Spawn
summary: Sand spawn can be raised by the power of the Daemonlord, either in his direct presence or by the use of his Chaos meteors. They resemble small tornadoes, with a top that is about 3 feet in diameter and which tapers to a narrow bottom.

name: Sand Vortex
summary: The sand vortex, or silt vortex as it is sometimes called, is a huge creature that lies in wait for unsuspecting prey crossing the Sea of Silt.

name: Sandling (Earth Kin)(Elemental)
climateTerrain: Temperate or tropical, sandy or subterranean
summary: A solitary and non-carbon based life form, sandlings seem content to eat and guard their territory. Not aggressive unless provoked, sandlings are hard to see and consequently easy for some hapless adventurer to provoke.

name: Sandman (Elemental)
summary: The sandman's name describes it exactly: This elemental is a manlike biped made entirely of sand, held together by magical cohesion.

name: Sandraksiva, The Black Courser
summary: While accompanying Prince Surtava on his search for enlightenment, Gaumahavi (see her entry) bore a litter of cubs. Like its mother, one of those cubs developed an animal soul and began a series of reincarnations.

name: Sapphire Dragon
summary: While not actively hostile, sapphire dragons are militantly territorial and initially distrustful of anyone who approaches.

name: Saqualaminoi (Yeti-kin)
summary: The Saqualaminoi (yeti-kin) are a race of humanoid creatures, hulking in height. Adapted to the harsh conditions of the high frozen mountams, their bodies are covered with white or gray fur.

name: Sarphardin
summary: ﻿Sarphardin resemble nagas, with snakelike prehensile bodies and huge dragon-like reptilian heads.

name: Sartani
summary: Sartani are terrifying creatures, part giant and part enormous crab. Their legs and torsos are those of a muscular giant, but their heads and hands are those of an enormous crab, including eyestalks and mandibles.

name: Saru
summary: Saru are gorilla-like apes native to the Malatran Plateau. Saru have heavy upper-body strength, short legs, feet with limited grasping ability, and black or copper-red fur covering their body except on their faces, palms, and soles of their feet.

name: Satyr
summary: Also called fauns, satyrs are a pleasure loving race of half-human, half-goat creatures. They symbolize nature's carefree ways.

name: Saugh, Dearg-Due
summary: The saugh are an army of the dead created by Loht, Prince of the Sith, to serve him when he moves against the lands of mankind. The ghoulish dearg-due serve as the front ranks of this menacing army.

name: Saugh, Gossamer
summary: Gossamers are spectral creatures that feed upon the life energy of their victims. They are counted among Loht's host of the dead, or saugh.

name: Savant Aboleth
summary: Savant aboleth are the great spellcasters of the aboleth species. Physically they resemble ordinary aboleth.

name: Scalamagdrion
summary: The scalamagdrion resembles a gray-scaled, green-eyed dragon with stubby wings and a long, bone-spiked prehensile tail. The creature's overall build is like that of a silver dragon.

name: Scamille
summary: Scamilles are amorphous, amoeba-like creatures that can change their shapes. They dwell in subterranean areas and are related to ochre jellies.

name: Scarecrow (Golem)
summary: Scarecrows are powerful enchanted creatures made from the same materials as normal scarecrows. They are non-intelligent but capable of following simple instructions from the priest who created them.

name: Scarecrow (Ravenloft)
summary: The Ravenloft scarecrow is a magically-animated creature that moves about under the influence of an evil force. Usually found only in agricultural regions, it is often the chosen form of a vengeful farmer's spirit.

name: Scarlet Dancer (Mist)
summary: Scarlet dancers are similar to crimson deaths, but are much smaller in size. Scarlet dancers also gather together in clusters of 10 to 100, unlike crimson deaths.

name: Scathe
summary: Scathes are a uniform milky-white in color. Their tough, leathery skin is completely hairless.

name: Scavenger Spawn
summary: Scavenger spawn are grotesque, bony beasts resembling a cross between a human skeleton and a vulture. The power of the Daemonlord generates and animates them from corpses.

name: Scavver
summary: Scavvers are long, fishlike creatures of space, dominated by a single huge, humanlike eye at the leading edge of the head, and a wide, sweeping mouth.

name: Scile
summary: “Now what do I sodding do? Reide sends me on this berk's errand to the Quasielemental Planes, and I run afoul at the first one I hit.

name: Scorpion
summary: Giant scorpions are vicious predators that live almost anywhere, including relatively cold places such as dungeons, though they favor deserts and warm lands.

name: Scorpion (Athas)
summary: Barbed scorpions are incredibly large creatures that prey on any living thing they find. They make their homes in caves among the rocky badlands, but are found all over Athas, living wherever they can find enough food to exist.

name: Scrab
summary: Scrabs are small, three-sectioned, insect-like men who live in nests in the desert. They are highly intelligent, and some of them are even able to cast spells.

name: Scro
summary: The highly militaristic scro are a violent goblinoid race that has only recently appeared. They are still rarely encountered, but if present trends continue, wildspace travellers will unfortunately see much more of them.

name: Scryxull
summary: The scryxull can best be described as a zombie snake. They are created by evil clerics and magic users to serve as guardians in vile and loathesome places.

name: Scylla
summary: Scylla and Charybdis: This danger lies in the straits of Messina between Italy and Sicily. Scylla is a sea monster in the form of a woman with six dogs' heads around her waist.

name: Sea Cloaker,
summary: These mantalike creatures may be related to the more common cloaker. They inhabit the sunken realm of Simorgya and may follow the orders of its rulers.

name: Sea Cow
climateTerrain: Warm, shallow ocean areas, often along coastal cities
summary:
The term "sea cow", often used interchangeably with either "manatee" or "dugong," is also used to describe a specific magically-
enhanced offshoot of the manatee species.

name: Sea Demon
summary: The sea demon resembles a giant octopus, but is much larger. The smaller version of the sea demon has ten tentacles, averaging 30 feet long, and a body diameter of 15 to 18 feet.

name: Sea Dragon
summary: Related to the dragon turtle, the sea dragon resembles a giant turtle with a dragon's head and massive flippers. A thick shell, usually black or dark green, covers most of its body.

name: Sea Glutton
summary: The sea glutton is a form of giant serpent – the kind mariners have whispered tales of since the beginning of ocean travel. They are most often reported lying on top of the water, sunning themselves; provoking one is a poor idea.

name: Sea Linnorm Dragon
summary: Sea linnorms are cold and vicious, viewing land dwellers as a threat to all marine life.

name: Sea Lion
summary: A sea lion is a fearsome creature with the head and forepaws of a lion and the body and tail of a fish.

name: Sea Unicorn
summary: Sea unicorns have three forms. The first form is that of a small whale with a long unicorn's horn, the second is that of a sea horse with the same horn, and the third is that of a unicorn with a blue-white coloration.

name: Sea Wyrm (Dragon-kin)
hitDice:
Young (7-8 HD)Adolescent (9-10 HD)
Adult (11-12 HD)
Ancient (13-14 HD)
summary: Sea wyrms are elongated legless and wingless sea dragons found in tropical and subtropical seas.

name: Seawolf (Lycanthrope)
summary: The seawolves are humans who can assume a form combining aspects of a seal and a wolf. Their packs roam the seas in search of ships to attack.

name: Seed, Brain
summary: The brain seed is a rare and cunning plant with strong psionic abilities. The plant has a deep-seated hatred for wizards, especially defilers.

name: Seelie Faerie (Cerilia)
summary: Seelie faeries are among the Shadow World's oldest and most numerous residents. The ancient fair folk are to this twilight land what the elves are to Cerilia, and are as in tune with the Seeming as the elves are with nature.

name: Seelie Faerie (Sprite)
summary: In the mystical reaches of sylvan woodlands, where ancient elves once walked and worshiped strange gods, live faeries of a most unusual type.

name: Seemer
summary: Seemers are creatures who play upon the fears of those they encounter, making themselves appear to be whatever their observers most dread.

name: Seeming Walker
summary: Seeming walkers are chameleonlike creatures that “wade” through the Seeming, camouflaged by the illusions then in effect.

name: Segarran
summary: Segarrans are special minions of Ragarra, an ancient, evil goddess of the jungle, typhoons, and revenge, once openly worshipped in the Ruined Kingdoms.

name: Selkie
summary: Selkies are seal-like beings that have the ability to change into human form for a few days at a time.

name: Selkie, Star
summary: Star selkies, though large and carnivorous, are actually an ethereal, shape-changing humanoid race. In their human form, they are kind, gentle, individuals of remarkable beauty.

name: Sentinel
summary: These golem-like creations are actually animated suits of armor crafted for the Sazaur beholders by the Arcane. The suits were meant to help the Sazaur guard against unwanted intrusion into the Hive complex.

name: Serpent
summary: Two rare varieties of serpents, the herald serpent and the teak serpent, can be found in teeming tropical jungles, often in the company of other intelligent reptilian creatures.

name: Serpent Griffon (Golem)
summary: The terrible golems of the Temple of the Abyss have slain hundreds of intruders, and the priests never clean the guard beasts' claws, the better to warn off others.

name: Serpent Lord
summary: Serpent lords, who resemble giant white cobras with human faces, are renowned healers and sages. They have a kind and compassionate nature.

name: Serpent Vine
summary: Serpent vines are a magical cross between a giant constrictor snake and a plant. They live in the vast subterranean forests.

name: Sha'az
summary: These creatures are a race of insect-humanoids that have adapted to arctic temperatures. Sha'az are enemies of the haun.

name: Shaboath (Golem)
summary: Shaboath golems are a unique creation by the Grand Savant Aboleth of the city of Shaboath. They are polymorphous watery creatures, not unlike water elementals in appearance (and are 90% likely to be mistaken for one).

name: Shad
summary: Long ago, a druidic cadre on a prime-material world known as Verdorth gathered together in order to perform a task so monumental that only a clueless prime would think it possible. They sought to transform the Elemental Plane of Earth.

name: Shade
summary: Even the most astute observer could mistake a shade for a human. In fact, most shades once were human, but have shed their mortality for the essence of shadowstuff.

name: Shade
summary: Shades are former humans transformed into creatures of shadow. They move freely through both the Shadow World and Cerilia, doing the bidding of their evil masters.

name: Shadeling
summary: Shadelings are bizarre and dangerous denizens of the demiplane of Shadow. They are often compared to doppelgangers, for they seek to mimic the forms of others and then kill them.

name: Shadevari
summary: Beasts from the long-lost past of Toril, shadevari were recently summoned to be the servants of Shadowkings. They are bipedal and covered with irongray lizard scales, with misshapen faces; two black tusks curving like scimitars from their mouths.

name: Shadow
summary: Shadows are shadowy, undead creatures that drain strength from their victims with their chilling touch.

name: Shadow Asp
summary: In all of Ravenloft, no place reveres the tombs of its dead more highly than Har'Akir. Recently, the priests of this desert realm have found deadly wardens for the tombs of their pharaohs: shadow asps.

name: Shadow Dragon
climateTerrain: Non-arctic/Ruins, subterranean, and plane of Shadow
summary: Shadow dragons are sly and devious. They are instinctively cunning and are not prone to taking risks.

name: Shadow Ether
summary: Ether shadows, also known as greater shadows, are the progenitors of the more common shadows of monster fame. Like shadows, their chilling touch drains strength at the increased rate of two points per hit.

name: Shadow Fiend
summary: The shadow fiend looks like a tall, slender humanoid with small batlike wings and a body composed of darkness. Both the long fingers and slender toes of the creature end in terrible claws that inflict gaping wounds on enemies.

name: Shadow Lurker
summary: Shadow lurkers appear similar in shape to normal lurkers, a large manta-ray that skulks along ceilings and walls, though it is less distinct or material – it is, as its name suggests, a dark shadow in the shape of a lurker.

name: Shadow Mastiff
summary: Shadow mastiffs are native to the Demiplane of Shadow, appearing on the Prime Material Plane only when summoned by ambitious wizards and clerics.

name: Shadow Steed
climateTerrain: Shadow World; Cerilia within 100' of a portal
summary: Shadow steeds are stallions made of shadowstuff— the shadows, twilight, and mists that permeate the Shadow World and help create its sinister atmosphere.

name: Shadow Symbiont
summary: Shadow symbionts are mysterious creatures from the Plane of Shadows. Each of these creatures can take one of four different shapes: a black scarf, a cloak, a pair of boots, or a set of gloves.

name: Shadow Warrior
climateTerrain: Shadow World; near portals in Cerilia
summary: Shadow warriors are spirits of noble Cerilians who fight on behalf of good in the Shadow World. Killed trying to defend their land from shadow incursions, they now continue their battle from the other side.

name: Shadow, Slow
summary: Slow shadows are undead creatures that prey upon humans and demihumans. They are similar in many ways to shadows and, like shadows, exist primarily on the Negative Material plane.

name: Shadowdrake
summary: There are a few things in the Lower Planes that even the fiends're afraid of, and the shadowdrake is one of 'em.

name: Shadowhound
summary: Like hell hounds, shadowhounds are fierce canines from another plane of existence sent to the Prime Material Plane in the service of evil beings.

name: Shadowmasters a.k.a The Malaugrym
summary: The Shadowmasters, also known as the Malaugrym, are a clan of shape-shifting humans who make their home in the Castle of Shadows on the Demiplane of Shadow. Further, they travel to Toril whenever they can.

name: Shadowperson
summary: The shadowpeople are a race of mammals that lives underground in small self-contained communities. One of the oldest races of Krynn, they are little known to the outside world.

name: Shadowrath
summary: Shadowraths are created by a fell artifact, the Crown of Horns. All shadowraths are intelligent, but are totally under the control of the wearer of the Crown of Horns if the latter is within 100 yards of their location.

name: Shadowsponge ("Air Stealer")
summary: These strange monsters are feared by all spacefarers. They drift in space until they sense the approach of an atmosphere, and attack mindlessly, absorbing precious air.

name: Shadowstaff
summary: Shadowstaves are former mortals who resemble ghosts or wraiths.

name: Shalarin
summary: Shalarin are a highly developed race that shares many characteristics with both humans and elves. On Toril, they are found only in the Sea of Fallen Stars.

name: Shambling Mound
climateTerrain: Wet subterranean or swamps and marshes
summary: Shambling mounds, or “shamblers”, appear as heaps of rotting vegetation.

name: Shan Sao
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate hills and forests
summary: The shan sao are a race of tiny humanoids who live in woodland hills. Fearless and private, they have little contact with the outside world.

name: Shaqat Beetle
summary: Shaqat beetles are natives of the grasslands and mud flats of Athas. In their natural state, they are annoying pests.

name: Sharg
summary: Physically, the sharg looks like a cross between a giant shark and a squid. Its skin is dull black, failing to glisten even under the brightest lights, and its dark eyes are near invisible against it.

name: Shargugh
summary: Shargugh (pronounced SHAR-guh) are small hairy humanoids about 3 feet tall. Their long, chronically matted and tangled hair is usually walnut brown, although some very rare individuals have dark-green locks.

name: Shark
summary: Sharks are large, finned, voracious carnivores that inhabit all known oceans and seas. They are perhaps the most aggressive eating machines found in the murky deeps.

name: Shark (Athas)
summary: Athasian sharks are similar to sharks of other worlds in many ways. They are large, cartilaginous, seagoing invertebrates that are basically cold-hearted eating machines.

name: Shark-kin
summary: These nomadic marine humanoids have large, staring eyes, fin-crested heads, and scaly skin. Their hands and feet are webbed and clawed.

name: Sharn
summary: An enigma little understood by sages or adventurers of the Realms, these curious creatures are resident in several large underground complexes, including Undermountain.

name: Shatjan
summary: The shatjan is a powerful protector of the icy far north. There it lives in solitude, watching over the flocks of reindeer that roam the tundra.

name: Shattered Brethren
summary: The Shattered Brethren are largely the same as common broken ones – they are the result of the cruel experiments of mind flayers.

name: Shedu
summary: Shedu are native to hot, arid climates. They have powerful, stocky equine bodies with short, powerful feathered wings.

name: Sheet Ghoul/Sheet Phantom
summary: Sheet ghouls are created when sheet phantoms kill their victims. Under normal circumstances, sheet ghouls are indistinguishable from normal ghouls.

name: Shen Lung (Spirit Dragon)
summary: Shen lung (spirit dragons) are slender and bright-eyed, with spiked tails, ridged backs, and two sharp horns rising from the tops of their heads. Golden whiskers grow from their snouts.

name: Shiere (Lesser Eladrin)
summary: The warriors of Arborea are the shieres, graceful eladrin knights who fight with skill, strength, and honor.

name: Shimmerfish
summary: Shimmerfish are deadly, evil relatives of the friendly dolphins. These sleek and powerful swimmers are found in warm seas.

name: Shimmering Wraith
summary: These entities are nonliving energies created by combining the forces of the Negative Energy Plane and the Quasi-elemental Plane of Lightning. Shimmering wraiths resemble shadows filled with sparkling points of light.

name: Shimmerweed
summary: Shimmerweed is a most unusual, and beautiful, variety of plant that is found in temperate regions throughout the world.

name: Shimnus, Greater Spirit
summary: The shimnus is a fearful denizen that once dwelt on some outer plane. Through unfortunate circumstance, the race found its way to the Prime Material plane and has decided to make its home here.

name: Shirokinukatsukami
summary: A powerful and kindly greater spirit, the shirokinukatsukami is a nemesis of evil and a protector of worthy humans.

name: Shivak
summary: The shivaks are only found aboard the Spelljammer, and they are constructed (grown) in a manner similar to the smalljammers.

name: Shocker
summary: Shockers are energy creatures of the Quasielemental Plane of Lightning. They're composed entirely of electricity and thus quite alien to most other life forms.

name: Shu
summary: The shu are similar to the halflings found in other parts of the Forgotten Realms. However, they differ in their universally slender builds and complete lack of body hair.

name: Siddwynd
summary: The siddwynd (SITH-wind) is the least intelligent of the garradalaighs. It is said to look like a long snake, but it is actually a long, thin lizard.

name: Silat
summary: Silats are a race of female, shapeshifting hags that roam both the wilderness and cities of Zakhara in magical disguise, searching for food.

name: Silatic
summary: Silatics are amorphous blobs, 5-7' in diameter, that eat metal. Continuously shifting and quivering, they use their two pseudopods to test substances for edibility.

name: Silk Wyrm
summary: The silk wyrm is a snake with a hard, chitinous shell that measures over 50' in length.

name: Silt Paraelemental Beast
summary: Paraelemental beasts of silt can only be summoned in places where there are large amounts of silt. If they gain free will, they often travel to the Sea of Silt or other places where they can roam freely in their element forever.

name: Silt Runner
summary: These small lizard-like men are common on Athas. They usually live the life of raiders, although occasionally a lair will be found.

name: Silt Serpent
summary: Silt serpents are simply snake that have adapted to the dusty shoals of the Silt Sea. They use the silt as camouflage and cover as they sneak up on their prey, and it is this tactic that gives them their name.

name: Silver Dog
summary: The few travelers who have glimpsed these beautiful canines say that silver dogs seem more creatures of dream than truth. They appear to be large dogs with long, flowing hair the color of mercury or molten silver.

name: Silver Dragon
climateTerrain: Tropical, sub-tropical, and temperate mountains and clouds
summary: Silver dragons are kind and helpful. They will cheerfully assist good creatures if their need is genuine.

name: Silver Slime
summary: An artificial life form created by the mysterious Arcane, this oozing slime maintains the Hive. Its extraordinary three-phase life cycle serves different functions within the asteroid complex.

name: Simorgyan
summary: Sunken, mysterious Simorgya is far from empty. Its ancient inhabitants who once ruled a vast empire live and seek vengeance against the surface dwellers who defeated them and continue to raid their drowned temples.

name: Simpathetic
summary: Originally from the Seventh Hell, this “bird” now makes its home in a number of grassy plains throughout the Prime Material Plane.

name: Simurgh
summary: The simurgh, sometimes called the king of the birds, is known to aid and protect other lawful good beings. It is a peace-loving and friendly creature, helpful and kind to all good creatures.

name: Singing Tree
summary: The singing tree is an odd plant creature that lures animals to rest nearby, then drains their blood to feed itself.

name: Sink Worm
summary: The sink worm is a huge white worm that travels beneath the sand or silt, leaving a sunken depression in the surface behind it. In spite of this clear warning sign, few prey escape once a sink worm begins hunting them.

name: Siragle
summary: Siragle is a major Abyssal fiend whose form is an unsettling humanoid/reptile blend. He stands 81/2' tall and has the head of a crocodile crowned with sharp black antlers.

name: Siren (Ravenloft)
summary: A Ravenloft siren is a hideous, undead creature with the upper body of a woman and the lower body of a fish.

name: Sirine (Siren)
climateTerrain: Temperate or tropical salt or fresh water, in wilderness areas
frequency: Rare (salt water) or very rare (fresh water)
summary: Sirines are beautiful, human-like females, at home in any aquatic environment. They have human skin tones ranging to a light yellow-green, and their hair can be almost any color, though silver and dark green are the most common.

name: Sirrush
climateTerrain: Subtropical or tropical desert or hills
summary:
The sirrush is a creature with a catlike, scaled torso; forelegs
like those of a scaled lion; hind legs like those of a giant bird or
lizard; a long, prehensile tail; and a snakelike head at the end of
a long neck.

name: Sislan
summary: “Everpresent but invisible, the air around us sustains, but when angered, it can destroy. The air is unpredictable and everchanging, never wholly friend nor foe.

name: Sitak
summary: The sitak is a forest bird of Athas. Its bears a close relation to the parrot and cockatoo (both of which also exist on Athas), evident in its sharp, curved beak, wicked talons, and bright feathers, as well as its gift for mimicry.

name: Sith
summary: Tales of faithful wives who join their husbands at remote homestead, only to die through the neglect of their spouse or because of the harsh environment abound.

name: Sivak Draconian
climateTerrain: Any, but usually tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Mountain and hill
summary: Sivaks are savage, shapechanging draconians that are derived from the eggs of silver dragons. They are among the most powerful draconians, second only to Auraks.

name: Skeletal Bat
summary: These bats are only found in the presence of powerful undead. They are once-dead bats that feed off the auras of other undead.

name: Skeletal Hound
summary: Skeletal hounds are the magically animated skeletons of dogs created as guardians by evil wizards or priests.

name: Skeleton
summary: All skeletons are magically animated undead monsters, created as guardians or warriors by powerful evil wizards and priests.

name: Skeleton Warrior
summary: Formerly powerful fighters, skeleton warriors are undead lords forced into their nightmarish states by powerful wizards or evil demigods who trapped their souls in golden circlets.

name: Skeleton, Archer
summary: Archer skeletons are magically animated humanoid undead monsters created as guardians or warriors by powerful evil wizards and priests. Such creatures are crafted from the bones of dead archers using an animate dead spell.

name: Skeleton, Crystal
summary: Crystal skeletons are human or demi-human skeletons that have been transformed by a series of spells into pale blue ice.

name: Skin Thief
summary: Skin thieves are bizarre beast men who scuttle through the wastelands of Ravenloft in small clans searching for unsuspecting victims to rob. As their name implies, skin thieves kill their victims in order to steal their skins.

name: Skinwing
summary: The skinwing is a reptilian, batlike creature found in warm climates. A skinwing resembles a furless bat with dirty brown scales.

name: Skotos
summary: Skotos are spirits that have broken free of the netherworld and now roam the world of the living as undead. They form hunting packs to better swarm over their prey.

name: Skovtrold
summary: The skovtrolde are neutral-evil wood trolls found in dark forests.

name: Skriaxit
summary: Skriaxits, the blackstorms, the living sandstorms, are the most feared creatures in the deserts of the east.

name: Skrit
summary: Skrits are carnivorous beetles that live in the cool deserts of Taladas. They are hulking creatures, approximately five to six feet in height.

name: Skuhlzecki (Hot-Headed Ice Borer)
climateTerrain: Artic to subarctic plains and hills
summary: A unique race of arctic worm, the skuhlzecki, or hot-headed ice borer, lives only on the cold plains and steppes of Vosgaard. Living within the thick permafrost of northern Cerilia, the ice borer spends its life hunting for food.

name: Skulk
summary: Skulks are an extremely cowardly, evil race of humanoids with the chameleon-like ability to blend in with any background. They survive on the edges of civilization by theft and murder.

name: Skullbird
summary: Skullbirds are large carrion birds of wildspace. A bad reputation follows these birds.

name: Skum
summary: Skum are a race bred by the aboleth from humanoid genetic stock to serve as beasts of burden. Skum do not resemble their ancestors.

name: Skunk
summary: Skunks are forest-dwelling omnivores found in most temperate and subtropical regions. They are easily recognized by the long white stripe running from their faces, down their black-furred backs, to the tips of their tails.

name: Skuz
summary: One of the most powerful and feared forms of undead, skuz haunt still bodies of water and destroy all those foolish enough to fall into their grasp.

name: Sky Scavver
summary: Apart from their size, sky scavvers are identical in structure to the other five known species of scavvers: long, fishlike creatures, dominated by a single huge, glowing human-like eye at the leading edge of the head, with a wide, sweeping mouth full of sharp carnivore's teeth.

name: Skyfish
summary: A skyfish is a special kind of amphibious creature that has the ability to survive both far below and high above the waves of Marnita. These creatures look like silvery sea bass with large batlike wings covered with scales instead of feathers.

name: Skykine
summary: Skykine are huge creatures native to the air world of Edill. They resemble broad-bodied dragons with short, thick necks.

name: Slasrath
summary: **“The gaze of an ultroloth is not one you want to meet twice. As the creature turned his head toward me, I lowered my eyes.

name: Sleek
summary: Sleeks are ermine-like mammals with bright, black eyes. Antennae on their muzzles aid them in gauging both the size and distance of their prey.

name: Slig
summary: Sligs are wide-jawed humanoids of the desert wilderness. Male sligs are tall and muscular, standing seven feet tall and weighing more than 300 pounds.

name: Slinker
summary: Slinkers are small, vaguely bird-like creatures. They stand approximately eight inches high on two hind legs.

name: Slithering Hoard
summary: Slithering hoards are modified cousins of the gelatinous cube that appear as amorphous blobs about twenty feet in diameter with bits of metal (often treasure) coating them.

name: Slithering Tracker
summary: Slithering trackers are transparent, plasma-draining jellies found in many dungeons and other dark places.

name: Slithermorph
summary: A slithermorph is an amphibious predator and carrion-eater. Most of the time, it resembles a black pudding, creeping about in a glistening black, amorphous form.

name: Sloth (Athas)
summary: The Athasian sloth is fast, cunning, and very bloodthirsty. A family of sloths can eat a whole halfling village in one night and is usually not afraid to try.

name: Sluk
summary: Sluk is wildspace seaweed, with the same ship-miring ability as sargasso seaweed in planetary seas. An unintelligent parasite, it feeds on magical energy.

name: Small Cats
summary: Cats of different sizes and colorations are common throughout the world. Some are pets, while many are wild.

name: Smoke Elemental
summary: Smoke elementals are hybrid creatures, a strange combination of the elements of Fire and Earth. These swirling clouds of hot soot, ash, and smoke are conjured from large amounts of nonmagical smoke.

name: Smoke Mephit
summary: Smoke Mephits are crude and lazy. They spend most of their time sitting around invisible, smoking pipeweed, telling bad jokes about their creators, and generally shirking their responsibilities.

name: Snail
summary: Flail snails are silicon-based gastropods distantly related to ordinary garden snails. Their shells average eight feet high at the crown and are masses of neon blues, reds, greens, and yellows.

name: Snake, Flying
summary: Flying snake, also known as “flying fangs”, were once numerous in warmer areas of the Realms, but they are so dangerous that all intelligent races hunt them mercilessly.

name: Snake, Giant Cobra
summary: Giant cobras are dimly intelligent snake with hoods marked by two eyelike patterns on the back. They may live as long as a century and are said to gain wisdom in their old age, giving them semi to low intelligence (2-7).

name: Snake, Mahogany Constrictor
summary: The mahogany constrictor is a reptilian predator that depends on both stealth and venom to bring down its pray. But the mahogany constrictor is both poisonous and magical.

name: Snake, Messenger
summary: For reasons never explained, Zhentish wizards dislike working with most birds. There are times, however, when messages need to be carried, and magic can he undependable and erratic, or is needed for other purposes.

name: Snake, Sewerm
summary: The sewerm is a relatively large water snake found in the sewers of Waterdeep (thus its name) and the fouled, fetid waters of the swamps of the northern Sword Coast (the Mere of Dead Men, the Stump Bog, etc.) Its tan-and-brown scales over a mottled green underbelly grant it great camouflage abilities in the dark sewers, and they can swim at remarkable speeds.

name: Snow Serpent
summary: The snow serpent is actually a legless mammal which lives in the cold northern latitudes of Nehwon.

name: Snow Spider
summary: Snow spiders look like muscular, furry, eight-legged arachnids, but they are warm-blooded mammals who stalk the forests and tundra of the north.

name: Snow Tiger (Great Cat)
summary: The great snow tiger is a carnivorous beast, native to cold temperate mountains and subarctic brush. Snow tigers are vividly portrayed in legends, where they are credited with all manner of cunning, intelligence, and ferocity.

name: Snow Troll
summary: Slightly smaller and broader than its fearsome cousin, the snow troll is still a frightening sight. It closely resembles the common troll, but the snow troll's skin is much paler, and large parts of its body are covered with white fur.

name: So-ut (Rampager)
summary: The so-ut, or rampagers, are fierce creatures that live only for the sake of destruction. They know no fear and hate the things of men, like weapons and buildings.

name: Solar (Aasimon)
summary: Solars are the most powerful aasimon and the greatest celestial stewards. They appear as large humans who have beautiful muscular bodies, white wings, eand brilliant topaz eyes.

name: Solifugid
summary: Solifugids exist on several worlds; those of the Realms (which differ slightly from those known elsewhere) are described here.

name: Sollux
summary: Sollux are tall, statuesque demihumans with crimson skin and bright yellow hair. The irises of their eyes are brilliant white or intense blue; the “whites” of their eyes are glowing yellow, tinged with red.

name: Son of Kyuss
summary: Sons of Kyuss are horrible undead beings that convert living humans and demihumans into cursed undead like themselves. Sons look similar to zombies and are often (75%) mistaken for them when seen from a distance.

name: Sorrow
summary: A Sorrow is the restless spirit of a person who died while performing a task that was personally morally important. Sorrows may appear as individuals or in groups of varying size.

name: Space Drake
summary: The space drake resembles the radiant dragon, but without wings. It has the same glittering pearl-like scales, and the same serpentine body, albeit on a smaller scale.

name: Space Owl
summary: Every spelljamming ship needs a navigator; wildspace is big, and the chance for error is great. Space owls are intelligent owls with a gift for navigation.

name: Space Swine
summary: The space swine are a species of boar, custom-bred by the mercantile dohwar for a variety of uses. They serve primarily as trackers, since they have uncanny senses.

name: Spacesea Giant
summary: Spacesea giants, or rover giants, are an offshoot of the groundling stone giant race that has found its way into arcane space. The ancestors of these giants were brought to space as neogi slaves, but they eventually managed to escape.

name: Spaceworm
summary: These miniscule but feared menaces of space attack spacefaring ships and beings alike, eating furrows in the surfaces of all organic things they encounter. They are particularly fond of eating eyes.

name: Spanner
summary: Spanners, also called living bridges, were originally created to help guard a certain wizard's tower, but have since escaped into the wilderness.

name: Spawn of Nimmur
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical deserts or caves
summary: When a powerful (11 or more Hit Die) Nimmurian manscorpion dies from exposure to sunlight, it has a 1% chance per Hit Die of becoming undead, rising as an avenging spawn of Nimmur when the sun sets.

name: Spectator (Beholder-kin)
summary: Another relative of the beholder, the spectator is a guardian of places and treasures, and capable of limited planar travel. Once it is given a task, the spectator will watch for up to 101 years.

name: Spectral Awnshegh
summary: Summoned by the Cold Rider to serve his dark bidding in undeath, spectral awnsheghlien are the spirits of slain Abominations from the waking world.

name: Spectral Death
summary: Also called soul eaters, spectral deaths are negative energy beings that look like boiling clouds of blackness. A spectral death's vaporous body is always surrounded by a faint radius that glows a sickly black-green.

name: Spectral Harpist
summary: Spectral harpists are intelligent undead who resemble ghosts or wraiths. They appear as translucent, shadowy forms that float or fly about.

name: Spectral Hound
summary: Spectral hounds are creatures from the Astral Plane. On the Prime Material Plane, a spectral hound looks like a ghostly dog, pale and translucent, with eyes that are formless pools of utter blackness.

name: Spectral Minion
summary: Spectral minions are the spirits of humans or demihumans who died before they could fulfill their vows. Even in death, spectral minions are bound to the vows or quests placed upon them while they were alive.

name: Spectral Scion
summary: This spectral scion is most often found in Cerilia or the Shadowlands of the Birhtright setting, although it is not impossible for them to be found elsewhere.

name: Spectral Wizard
summary: Spectral wizards are undead that retain their abilities to cast spells. They are created by a unique spell that functions on human and elf wizards and gnome illusionists, taking hold only on those whose bodies once channeled wizard magic.

name: Spectre
summary: Spectres are powerful undead that haunt the most desolate and deserted of places. They hate all life and light.

name: Spectre (Jezra Wagner, The Ice Queen)
summary: Winters in Barovia are not pleasant things. Icy winds blow down from the peaks of the Balinoks carrying heavy snows and bitter cold.

name: Spell Weaver
summary: Spell weavers are nonhuman spellcasters of great power, originating from an alternate Prime Material Plane. Only vaguely humanoid in appearance, they have a combination of mammalian, reptilian, and insectoid features.

name: Spellhaunt
summary: Who can say what's out there if a cutter's willing to look for it? The planes are infinite, and there's an infinity of possibilities.

name: Spider (Athas)
summary:
**Psionics Summary (Psionicist)**
