Player's Option: #AT1; MTHAC0 16; MAC 5

name: Spider (Krynn)
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/Plain, forest, hill, mountain, and jungle
summary: The whisper spider has a plump abdomen, multiple eyes, and four pairs of segmented legs. Its body is covered with short, black bristles.

name: Spider Cactus
summary: Spider cactus patches look like any patch of harmless cacti until a victim is showered by their needles. The victim is then dragged into the cactus, where the feeding needles make a slow feast of the hapless being.

name: Spider Dragon
summary: Spider dragons are a creation of Jiathuli, Mistress of the Deathdark. She created the spider dragons in envy of Takhisis, the ruler of evil dragons.

name: Spider Horse
summary: The spider horse is prized as a steed by the drow of the Deathdark. Bred long ago by the priestesses of Jiathuli, Princess of the Abyss, the spider horse is a bizarre hybrid of horse and spider.

name: Spider, Asteroid
summary: These ten-legged beasts build webs between asteroid rocks to trap their prey.

name: Spider, Crystal
summary: The crystal spider is a voracious predator that spins a glass web. The web is very sharp and can focus a damaging beam of light at a potential victim.

name: Spider, Monkey
summary: Though an ancient species in the Forgotten Realms, monkey spiders' tiny size and harmlessness have kept them unnoticed until now.

name: Spider-spy
summary: Spider-spies are enchanted spiders of large size, developed by the Herathian mages. The spider-spies are one of the more successful Herathian biological design endeavors.

name: Spiders, Vodoni Space
summary: These large crystal spiders are very rare throughout the universe, as they are known to be both intelligent and shy. They most resemble large glass spiders, with strange, multicolored internal organs.

name: Spiderstone Golem
summary: Spiderstone golems, also known as obsidian golems, are the constructed servants of drow spellcasters.

name: Spinagon (Least Baatezu)
summary: Spinagons, the smallest baatezu, look like gargoyles – small humanoids with wings and a spiked tail. They carry small military forks or other nasty weapons.

name: Spined Toad
summary: Spined toads appear to be a strange mix between a giant toad and a hedgehog. Except for their undersides, their bodies are covered in short, sharp spines.

name: Spinewyrm
summary: The spinewyrm is closely related to the silk wyrm and kills its victims by constriction.

name: Spirit (Mystara)
summary: Spirits are powerful undead beings which inhabit the bodies, or body parts, of others. Creatures or parts of creatures animated by a spirit have a pale, decayed appearance and often emit a sickly green, blue, or purple glow.

name: Spirit Folk
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate forests and jungles
summary: Spirit folk are the descendants of humans and various spirits of nature. All have strong ties to both the natural world and the society of humans.

name: Spirit of the Air
summary: Spirits of the air are minions of powers associated with wind and air - most of these deities are elemental in nature, but any god who can create and control the wind can create and control a spirit of the air.

name: Spirit of the Land
summary: A Spirit of the Land is a powerful being that inhabits the various geological features (mountains, hills, rock formations, hot springs, river beds, winds, skies, etc.) of Athas.

name: Spirit Warrior
summary: The spirit warrior is an enormous undead insect, the primary long-range weapon of elven crack troops during the Unhuman Wars. All Spirit Warriors went into time storage after the end of the Unhuman Wars, and they occasionally emerge in modern times.

name: Spirit, Heroic
summary: The heroic spirit is an undead entity who died while attempting to perform some especially heroic deed or defeat some dastardly villain. It remains in the living world to accomplish its “unfinished business”.

name: Spirit, Nature
summary: Nature spirits are the outward manifestations of plants and otherinanimate objects found in nature. All are associated with a particular object or place from which they derive their lifeforce.

name: Spirit, Psionic
summary: The psionic spirit is an unusual form of ghost with great psionic abilities that it employs instead of the normal magical abilities most often associated with such creatures.

name: Spirit, Stone
summary: Stone spirits are lesser spirits of evil alignment who inhabit stone statues. They can animate their statues at will.

name: Spirit, Wisdom
summary: Of all the creatures that have ever walked on Krynn, one of the wisest was Igrane, father of the Irda, the High Ogres.

name: Spiritjam
summary: A spiritjam is the soul of an evil cleric or wizard who died while spelljamming. The spirit of the cleric or wizard remained behind when the physical body perished.

name: Spitting Crawler
summary: Spitting crawlers are lizards of the Underdark, often used as familiars by subterranean-dwelling wizards (such as the mages of the drow).

name: Spittle Boar
summary: Spittle boars are amiable, piglike creatures from the Beastlands, with bulging pink eyes and dull gray hide. They continuously drool thick, yellow spittle.

name: Sporebat (Bat)
summary: This fungoid predator, sometimes called a flying eye, is a deadly opponent when airborne, but is nearly helpless when on the ground. The creature is about 3 feet long, with a wingspan of more than double that.

name: Spriggan
summary: These ugly, dour cousins of gnomes are able to become giant-sized at will.

name: Squeaker
summary: Squeakers were first encountered a few years ago. It is believed they were created by a wizard's spell gone bad.

name: Squealer
summary: A squealer is a grotesque creature with a piggish dace and leathery skin over which a fine coat of green and brown fur forms variegated patterns. A squealer has two legs and three arms, all ending in claws.

name: Squid, Squark
summary: The squark's head is full of a dozen rows of three-inch-long, razor-sharp teeth that bite for 3d6 points of damage. It can use these to rend a victim to shreds in mere seconds.

name: Ssurran
summary: Ssurrans are nomadic, humanoid reptiles. Some are raiders while others are simple hunters.

name: Stag
summary: Wild stags are the aggressive males of a deer herd.

name: Stalking Catfish
summary: The stalking catfish is amazingly adaptable, being able to spend nearly all its time out of the water, walking about on its broad and muscular fins.

name: Stalking Death
summary: The mere sight of this beast can freeze a man with fear. Its huge mastiff body covered with thick double coated fur is an abomination in its own right.

name: Stalking Horror
summary: The stalking horror, also known as the moonbeast, is one of the most feared creatures on Athas. Few have seen one and survived to describe it.

name: Starfish, Giant - Giant Sunstar
summary: The giant starfish (sunstar) is a cousin of the smaller common sunstars that live in the ocean. It has a central body with 10 or 12 arms radiating from the center.

name: Starfly Plant
summary: This colorful butterfly-shaped plant drifts slowly through wildspace, much to the delight of spelljammer crews – its fruit is delicious!

name: Stargazer
summary: The stargazer is a large, four-legged reptilian asteroid-dweller. Its rocky skin mimics crystalline outcroppings, giving it an AC of -2.

name: Steam Mephit
summary: Both mist and steam mephits originate on the quasielemental Plane of Steam, the only known plane that has spawned two varieties of mephits. Possibly for this reason, the two varieties have developed an intense rivalry bordering on hatred.

name: Steel Dragon
climateTerrain: Temperate cities (rarely temperate hills, plains, and forests.)
summary: Steel dragons love to have human and demihuman companions, and they prefer to live amid the hustle and bustle of great cities. They often pose as sages, scholars, mages, or other intellectuals.

name: Steel Shadow
summary: Although they look rather like giant planarian worms, equally at home on land and under water, they are rarely seen in their true forms. They merge with metal to enter and animate metal items.

name: Steelback Beetle
summary: Steelbacks are huge beetle-like creatures with highly-reflective metallic shells covering their backs. The large shell is an almost perfect hemisphere, supported less than a foot off the ground by 36 short, multi-jointed legs.

name: Stellar Undead
summary: Stellar undead are the corpses of spelljamming sailors returned to a semblance of life. The corpses are animated by raw energy from the Negative Material Plane.

name: Stirge
summary: Stirges are bird-like creatures that drink the blood of their victims for sustenance. They have four small, pincer-like legs that they use to clamp onto the necks of their victims.

name: Stone Giant
summary: Stone giants are lean, but muscular. Their hard, hairless flesh is smooth and gray, making it easy for them to blend in with their mountainous surroundings.

name: Stone Maiden
summary: Stone maidens are exquisitely beautiful damsels that dwell in rock formations, standing stones, and the walls of secluded caverns and caves.

name: Stone Snake
summary: The stone snake is similar to its mundane cousins, except its body is made up of segments of a stony mineral that resembles granite. It is this hard outer body covering that provides the stone snake with its exceptional Armor Class.

name: Stone Termite
summary: Stone termites are a bane to castle-dwellers everywhere, greatly feared for the damage they can do to the mightiest of fortifications. Unlike their mundane, wood-eating counterparts, stone termites subsist solely on rocks and minerals.

name: Stone Troll
summary: Stone Trolls are horrendous creatures, towering over most of their kin. They have sunken eye sockets, massive claws, a fang-filled mouth, and a nasty disposition.

name: Stonecrown Ogre
summary: Stonecrow ogres run to fat, not surprisingly considering how much of their time they spend eating. They are crude but powerful, and take simpe joy in killing and destruction.

name: Storm Giant
summary: Storm giants are gentle and reclusive. They are usually tolerant of others, but can be very dangerous when angry.

name: Strahd Skeleton
summary: Strahd skeletons are magically animated undead monsters, created as guardians or warriors by Count Strahd Von Zarovich, the vampire lord of Barovia.

name: Strahd Zombie
summary: Strahd zombies are a unique form of undead created only by Count Strahd Von Zarovich, the vampire lord of Barovia.

name: Strahd's Skeletal Steed
summary: Strahd's skeletal steeds are magically animated undead horses, created as guardians and warriors by the master vampire Strahd Von Zarovich.

name: Strangler
summary: Stranglers are carnivorous plants native to the disk world of Plata. The plant's central body is short and stocky-roughly spherical and about 3 feet in diameter.

name: Strangleweed
summary: Strangleweed appears as a long, clinging vine, usually growing inside caves. The vine is black and covered with short, fine spines, and the triangular leaves and thorns are usually shiny black.

name: Strigloi
climateTerrain: Areas near cemeteries and burial grounds
summary: There are those who lead lives so horrible that those who knew of their deeds allow them to live on in memory and tales told to frighten children.

name: Stwinger
summary: Stwingers are tiny humanoid creatures with verstigial wings. They are out to have fun.

name: Su-Monkey
climateTerrain: Subtropical to tropical forest or jungle
summary: The su-monkey is a specially bred monkey that the Scarlet Brotherhood has been able to invest with some of the qualities of a su-monster.

name: Su-Monster
summary: Su-monsters look like big gray monkeys, 4 to 5 feet tall. They have large bones and muscular limbs, but they always appear a bit underfed, because their ribs and vertebrae show prominently.

name: Subterranean Pudding
summary: Subterranean puddings are viscous, slimy creatures that resemble massive lumps more than living things. A subterranean pudding is, in fact, a colony of hundreds of living organisms in a single pudding.

name: Succubus (Lesser Tanar'ri)
summary: Beautiful and seductive, the succubi are the temptresses of mortals. Whereas the glabrezu tempt men of power, the succubi choose men of passion and energy.

name: Succulus
summary: The succulus, also known as the red steel cruncher, closely resembles a wild boar in appearance. The succulus is similar to a rust creatures, except that it feeds on red steel, cinnabryl, and steel seed.

name: Suel Lich
summary: These powerful wizards endure the centuries by transferring their life forces from one human host to the next.

name: Suisseen
summary: On the Elemental Plane of Water swim the suisseen, creatures that're little more than thin, transparent membranes filled with water.

name: Sull
summary: Sull, also known as floaters, are living flying saucers, predators who may also serve as aerial mounts.

name: Sunfly
summary: Sunflies are tiny creatures native to the planes of good. They're occasionally used as messengers or couriers by the local archons, aasimon, or petitioners.

name: Surtaki
summary: The origin of these ravenous beasts is unknown; as usual the mad wizard's experiment is suspected, although they may be the spawn of some twisted, inimical power.

name: Survivor
summary: Survivors are high-level, intelligent humans, demihumans, or humanoids who have been trapped in a state of suspended animation and drifting in the phlogiston for many years – often centuries, sometimes even longer.

name: Sussurus
summary: Sussuri are distant cousins to the creatures known as shambling mounds. They appear as headless humanoid piles of rotting bamboo, moving about on all four limbs.

name: Suwyze
summary: The suwyze seems to be composed entirely of feathery antennae, wispy tendrils, and long feelers – a huge mass of sensory organs.

name: Suzara the Scold
summary: Suzara the Scold was once Suzara Obarskyr, wife to Ondeth Obarskyr (founder of Cormyr). Never fond of life in the wilderness, Suzara became a ghazneth more than 1,300 years ago after abandoning her husband and eldest son in the city named for her (Suzail) to return to a less toilsome life in Impiltur.

name: Svirfneblin (Deep Gnome)
summary: Far beneath the surface of the earth dwell the svirfnebli—the deep gnomes-a race related to the the gnomes of the bright world.

name: Swamp Giant
hitDice:
Adult & Shaman: 15+5
Juvenile: -2 HD
Infant: -5 HD
summary: Swamp giants are believed to have evolved ages ago from bosk giants. These smaller, stockier giants are more intelligent than the nearby bosk and have learned the rudiments of civilization.

name: Swampmare
summary: Swampmares are large, water-loving creatures related to tapirs. The gurrash of the Bayou use them as war mounts, beasts of burden, and occasionally as food.

name: Swanmay
summary: These aquatic birds tend to inhabit areas frequented by similar waterfowl. Such areas include rivers, ponds, lakes, and marshes.

name: Swanmay
summary: Swanmays are human females who can assume swan form. In human form, swanmays are indistinguishable from other people.

name: Swimming Swami
summary: These dark skinned humans, the swimming swamis, are very polite and are very willing to help passersby.

name: Sword Grass
climateTerrain: Shaded areas of marshes and swamps
summary: Sword grass grows in clumps of 1-6 green plants, each plant appearing to be 1-8 huge blades of grass (1-6' tall) growing up from a central spot on the ground.

name: Sword Spirit
summary: Sword spirits are a form of undead found on the ironclad plains of Acheron, and on rare occasions on other great battlefields. A sword spirit is normally invisible and intangible, having no true physical existence.

name: Syllix
summary: The syllix is a highly developed invertebrate, resembling a cross between a worm and a salamander. The syllix's body is segmented, tapering to a pointed tail and a worm-like head with a pair of wide, unblinking eyes.

name: Sylph (Elemental, Air Kin)
summary: Sylphs are beautiful, humanoid women with wings like dragonflies. Their wings are 4–5 feet long and translucent, clear, or spotted with iridescent color.

name: Symbiotic Jelly
summary: Symbiotic jelly is a distant cousin of the gelatinous cube. It occupies a very special ecological niche, and thus has a specific but rather unusual mode of existence.

name: T'Chowb
summary: The t'chowb is a particularly deadly little creature that delights in draining intelligence from those smarter than itself.

name: T'ien Lung (Celestial Dragon)
summary: A t'ien lung's scales are dull gold at birth, but brighten to a brilliant yellow when it reaches the young adult age; orange and light green varieties have also been seen.

name: T'liz
hitDice: As in life +4 hp per HD, minimum 13 HD
summary: T'lizes are undead defilers whose spirits have outlived their bodies. They are extremely powerful undead who seek magical knowledge and power above all else and exist as such to continue their study of magic.

name: T'uen-rin
summary: T'uen-rin are a powerful race of good servants that dwell in the peaceful skies and plains of Arcadia. They're related to the ki-rin of the Prime Material Plane, but they're even more intelligent, capable, and noble than their “lesser” kin.

name: Tabaxi
summary: Tabaxi have spotted coats ranging in color from light yellow to brownish red. These graceful feline humanoids are tall and slender, with retractable claws, and eyes of green or yellow.

name: Tabi
summary: The tabi are small, winged creatures about the size of house-cats. They are inveterate gossips.

name: Taer
summary: Taer are a race of shaggy humanoids that live in cold mountain regions. Taer look like a cross between cave men and apes.

name: Tako
summary: The tako are a race of intelligent octopi who can move onto land and use weapons and other tools.

name: Talking Bird
summary: The talking bird is large-billed and looks something like a toucan crossed with a parrot.

name: Tam'Hi
summary: According to legend, tam’hi are the descendants of humans and various nature spirits. All have strong ties to both the natural world and the tribes of the jungle.

name: Tanuki
summary: Although he bears a semblance to both the badger and raccoon family, the tanuki is actually closer to a dog.

name: Tarek
summary: Tareks are big, musclebound, and hairless bipeds that inhabit the hilly and mountainous areas of Athas. They have square, big-boned heads with sloping foreheads and massive brow ridges.

name: Tari
summary: The tari are commonly referred to as ratmen by the other denizens of the Tyr region. They are small, furry humanoid scavengers, capable of thriving on food and water too polluted for humans to ingest.

name: Tarrasque
summary: The legendary tarrasque, for there is fortunately only one known to exist, is the most dreaded monster native to the Prime Material plane. The creature is a scaly biped with two horns on its head, a lashing tail, and a reflective carapace.

name: Tarsardar
summary: More commonly known as “staff spirits” or “sword spirits” due to the favorite types of enchanted items they like to inhabit, tarsardar are translucent, amorphous flying wraithlike beings that tend to appear tattered and “flowing” in form, keeping to a vaguely upright humanoid stance with a head and shoulders, but letting all else change and shift (one bard described them aptly as “ghostly glowing wisps”).

name: Tasked Artist Genie
summary: Tasked artist genies include both incredibly skilled craftsmen and aesthetically brilliant artists in fields widely accepted as high art. Both groups are capable of producing masterworks in their chosen speciality in a very short period of time.

name: Tasked Slayer Genie
summary: The tasked slayer genie's only purpose is to commit murder as often as possible – by stealth as long as possible or through berserker rages when discovered.

name: Tasked Warmonger Genie
summary: Warmonger genies are strategists and advisers to generals, laying plans for warfare among the genies' emirs and caliphs. They are always found leading soldiers and mercenaries, and where there is no war for them to fight, they start one.

name: Tasked Winemaker Genie
climateTerrain: Temperate or subtropical villages and hills
summary: Winemaker tasked genies are creatures of the grape, dedicated to nurturing the vines and extracting the finest possible vintages.

name: Tasloi
summary: Tasloi are long-legged, flat-headed humanoids. They walk in a crouching posture, touching their knuckles to the ground from time to time.

name: Tatalla
summary: The tatalla, “the eye”, is a malevolent little creature used as a spy or as a stealthy assassin. It is skinny, almost emaciated, about two feet tall, and basically humanoid.

name: Tayling
climateTerrain: Tropical, subtropical, and temperate/ Plain, mountain, and hill
summary: Sligs are distant cousins of goblins and hobgoblins; though somewhat larger, they are just as ferocious.

name: Tayling
summary: Inhabiting an isolated jungle island in the middle of the Courrain Ocean, the 'taylings' are a race of intelligent humanoids. Every birth results in twins, one bestial (taylang) and the other demihuman (tayling).

name: Telvar
summary: Telvar are aerial barbarians who live in mountainous regions far from civilized lands. They live in large clans and avoid contact with other races whenever possible.

name: Tembo
summary: The tembo is a despicable, furless, tawny-colored beast covered with loose folds of scaly hide. Varying between three and six feet in length, they usually stand about as high as a man's thigh.

name: Tempest
summary: The tempest is a living storm. It appears as a dark storm cloud of comparatively small size.

name: Temple Critter
summary: These 1-foot-tall constructs resemble gargoyles. They were created by priests of the Savage Coast to serve as spies, servants, and watchdogs in their temples.

name: Temporal Dog
summary: Temporal dogs are a highly evolved form of blink dogs that make their home on the Demiplane of Time.

name: Temporal Glider
summary: Gliders are large, kitelike creatures that drift along in the empty spaces of Demiplane of Time or close to the surface of a timestream.

name: Temporal Stalker
summary: Temporal stalkers are the undead of the pseudo-reality of the Demiplane of Time, and a large number of them used to be chronomancers.

name: Tengu
summary: The tengu are a race of birdlike humanoid creatures, found in uninhabited mountain areas not far from settled lands. They are extremely secretive and capricious.

name: Tentamort
summary: Tentamorts are dungeon predators distantly related to sea squids. Their head/body is a flesh sphere two feet in diameter, covered by a chitinous shell.

name: Terithran
summary: Making their lairs within tombs of solid ether, the ugly, hairless humanoids known as terithran sleep peacefully until disturbed. Only the presence of wizardly magic in their minds, the bane of all existence – causes them to stir.

name: Terlen
summary: Some bashers think that the Lower Planes're nothing but wastelands of burning rock, searing desert, or poisonous bogs. They're wrong.

name: Tether Beast
summary: The tether beast is often referred to as the dragon of the Demiplane of Time, but in fact, it more closely resembles a behir. It is long and snake-like, with four pairs of legs unevenly spaced along its body.

name: Thaalud (Tomb Tapper)
summary: Tomb Tappers, also known as Thaalud, appear as tall, naked, sexless, and hairless humanoids with very hard, smooth, blue-gray skin, claws that can dig through solid rock, and great toothed mouths in their bellies.

name: Thanoi
summary: Thanoi, also known as walrus men, are a bizarre blend of the human and walrus races. In spite of their great bulk, they can maneuver surprisingly well; their clawed feet enable them to maintain a good pace over ice or snow.

name: Thassaloss
summary: The thassaloss is a four-armed, golemlike automaton made of bone by priests of luz. The greater and lesser forms have a major difference, that of sentience (possessed only by the greater form).

name: The Abomination of Diirinka
summary: The Abomination is an otherworldly creature, loathsome to behold. It has an oblong body and stony flesh.

name: The Beholder Mage
summary: Shunned by other beholders, this is a beholder which has purposely blinded its central eye, so that it might cast spells. It does so by channeling spell energy through an eyestalk, replacing the normal effect with that of a spell of its choice.

name: The Blood Riders (Blood Warrior)
summary: The Blood Warriors are a type of undead soldier created by Kazgaroth. The Beast used his corrupting mass charm ability to transform a troop of normal living beings into his fanatically loyal, undead servants.

name: The Bulette-Mutation
summary: The monster described in this module is identical to the standard bulette and is derived from the original creature by magical and biological experimentation by the wizard Shivnar.

name: The Calnar Horse
summary: The rise of the Calnar can be attributed to many things. One of the most significant was this powerful animal, domesticated and bred to serve the needs of the Khalkist dwarves.

name: The Dispossessed
summary: The dispossessed are spirits of possession victims in the waking world. When their bodies are taken over by evil forces, their souls become trapped in the Shadow World.

name: The Eye
summary: The Eye is one of the chief lieutenants of the Cult of Vecna. Although only one has ever been seen, it is impossible to be certain that there is only one of these creatures.

name: The Ghost Dancer, The
summary: The Ghost Dancer is perhaps the most tragic member of the Nightmare Court. As her name implies, she is an incorporeal creature who now searches the nightmares of the living in an effort to understand her own death.

name: The Hand
summary: The Hand is the second of the cult of Vecna's two lieutenants, the other being the Eye. Like the Eye, the Hand is a created being, a human modified by powerful spells to become what it is today.

name: The Meharmaine
summary: The meharmaine are el-Sirad's not-so-secret police. They have never been known to exist in Khinasi; by the time el-Sirad dispelled the magical barrier around Bicheda and Ghourín, the meharmaine were patrolling the provinces in full force.

name: The Monkey King
summary: Exiled from the Beastlands for his constant chaotic trickery, the Monkey King goes by many names-Hanuman, Bacchus, Agent of the Celestial Bureacracy-but he prefers to be called "Monkey King."

name: The Queen of Chaos
summary: The Queen of Chaos is a native of Limbo who rules the Steaming Fen.

name: The Questing Beast
summary: A powerful sorceress created the Questing Beast in vengeance for the destruction of her lover, a giant who was preying upon Pellinore's lands.

name: The Rainbow Serpent
summary: The Rainbow Serpent is perhaps the most enigmatic member of the Nightmare Court simply because the creature wears a nonhumanoid form. It is a reclusive entity who sows the seeds of mistrust and suspicion among the dreamscapes it controls.

name: The Sluagh
summary: The Sluagh (SLOO-ah), or the Host of the Unforgiven Dead, are the spirits of Cerilians who have died with unspeakable crimes on their consciences.

name: The Viscount of Minauros
summary: Minauros the Serpent dwells in the Sinking City, his bulk writhing and spasming through the fetid water of his layer. He's indirect and venomous, his schemes convoluted and twisted.

name: The White Boar
summary: The white boar was specially created by the Celtic deities to house the spirit of a godlike avatar sent to destroy Shivnar and his monstrous creation, the bulette-mutation.

name: The White Hart
summary: The White Hart is a large albino buck with fifteen point antlers. Knights and their ladies sometimes glimpse it bounding through the forests of Britain, but commoners never see it unless they have proven themselves extraordinarily brave.

name: The White Stag
summary: The White Stag of Labelas Enoreth is the special servant of the elven god of longevity. Physically, it is a huge, snow white animal, with massive muscles and red, glowing eyes.

name: The Wild Hunt
summary: The Wild Hunt is a fearsome party of unseelie faeries, undead, shadow steeds, and cwn annwn that stampedes through forests in a never-ending hunt for elves.

name: Theiwar (Dwarf)
summary: Theiwar are an aggressive and degenerate race of mountain dwarves.

name: Thessalgorgon
summary: The thessalgorgon is a hybrid of a thessalhydra and a gorgon. It has the scaled, lizardlike body of the thessalhydra, eight snakelike heads, and a bull's head in the middle of the snake heads.

name: Thessalhydra
summary: The thessalhydra resembles an eight-headed hydra. It has a large, reptilian torso and tail measuring 30 feet long (8 feet tall at the shoulder).

name: Thessalmera
summary: The thessalmera is a hybrid of thessalhydra and chimera.

name: Thessaltrice
summary: The thessaltrice is a hybrid of a thessalhydra and a cockatrice. The eight fringe heads of the thessaltrice resemble the head and neck of a cockatrice.

name: Thomil (Rock Spirit)
summary: Thomil are spirit creatures that inhabit and guard rocky and mountainous places in Rashemen. Rocks inhabited by thomil radiate magic but are otherwise indistinguishable from other rocks until the thomil becomes active.

name: Thoqqua
summary: Chant has it that the thoqqua – also known as a rockworm or a fireworm – is a creature native to the Paraelemental Plane of Magma.

name: Thought Eater
summary: Thought eaters are natives of the Border Ethereal, and they only survive in ethereal form. They appear as sickly gray skeletal bodies with oversized platypus heads.

name: Thoul
summary: Thouls are magical crosses between ghouls, hobgoblins, and trolls. In spite of their ghoulish blood, they are living creatures, not undead.

name: Thousandtooth
summary: The thousandtooth is a monstrosity made by mutating a medusa. It looks like an oversized human head with large sharp teeth and solid gray eyes.

name: Thrax
summary: A Thrax is a dreadful creature that exists by draining the water from its victims. The thrax is very intelligent and is an implacable foe.

name: Thrax (Palik)
summary: Several years ago, the Mists of Ravenloft reached out to the strange and alien land of Athas. Moving across burning sands that stretched endlessly beneath a smoldering crimson Sun, the Dark Powers settled over the city-state of Kalidnay.

name: Thri-kreen
climateTerrain: Any land (Temperate or tropical arid land)
summary:
The figures given above are for mature adult thri-kreen. Others have the following abilities, based on their age (they age one age category per year until they reach mature adult):
