name: Thunder Child
summary: Thunder children, also known as storm children, night rattlers, and lightning kin, are mischievous, malicious creatures that com out to “play” during violent thunderstorms, especially at night. This play is quite harmful to other creatures.

name: Thunderhead
summary: Thunderheads are reptilian carnivores related to both dragons and wyverns. They are constantly on the wing and are usually encountered during thunderstorms.

name: Thylacine
summary: The thylacine, also known as the jumping tiger or mantiger, is a fearless predator that possesses illusionary powers.

name: Tickler
summary: This bizarre creature appears as a tiny ball of gray flesh from which projects a pair of featherlike white wings. It is under 2” long and can fly rapidly.

name: Tiefling
summary: Tieflings are the offspring of the planes, as varied as the places they call home.

name: Time Dimensional
summary: There are three different varieties of time dimensionals: the common, the noble, and the royal. Often misnamed as time elementals, time dimensionals are intelligences composed entidy from the essence of time.

name: Tinker Gnome (Minoi)
summary: Tinker gnomes are constantly designing, building, and testing devices for a variety of applications, but their innate incompetence is such that anything their technology can do, magic can usually do more quickly and efficiently.

name: Tinkerer (Giant Bubble)
summary: Tinkerers are ball-shaped, comical-looking creatures named for the aims they all seem to follow: to acquire, improve upon, and modify all equipment (including magical items) they can get their hands on.

name: Tirichik
summary: Vicious, stealthy, and with an insatiable appetite for human flesh, the tirichik is one of the most feared predators in the Great Glacier.

name: Titan
summary: Titans are gargantuan, almost godlike men and woman. They, quite simply, look like 25' tall people of great physical strength and beauty.

name: Tlokasazotz (Olman Bat-Vampire)
summary: The tlokasazotz is a unique being - Zotlatlan, king of the Olman nation of Telaneteculi. His normal form is an 8' tall bat-like humanoid with large wings and huge talons on his arms.

name: Tohr-kreen I
summary: Tohr-kreen are larger, cultured versions of thri-kreen. They are more civilized than their smaller cousins, and not nearly as aggressive.

name: Tohr-kreen II
frequency: Common in the North, very rare elsewhere
summary: Tohr-kreen are large, intelligent insects, very similar to thri-kreen. Tohr-kreen build permanent settlements in the lands far to the north of the Tablelands, home to Tyr and the other humanoid city-states.

name: Tohr-kreen III
summary: These tohr-kreen are large, intelligent insects similar to thri-kreen. Like other tohr-kreen, t'keech and tondi are found in permanent settlements far north of the Tyr region.

name: Tomb Warden
summary: Tomb wardens are related to stone golems. Dwarf priests construct them to serve as tireless guardians for areas they cannot otherwise protect.

name: Topaz Dragon
summary: Topaz dragons are unfriendly and selfish. Though not malevolent, they are seldom pleasant to deal with because of their erratic behavior.

name: Topi
climateTerrain: Tropical or subtropical jungles, ruins, subterranean
summary: Topis are tiny undead humanoid creatures similar to zombies. Before these creatures are animated, however, the corpses are shrunk until they are only 2 feet tall.

name: Tortle
summary: Tortles are land-dwelling, humanoid tortoises. They walk upright with a ponderous, rolling gait.

name: Totem Spirit
summary: Each type of animal has a spirit that stands as an archetype for the species.

name: Translator
summary: Messengers of the very gods themselves, translators are humanoid beings that travel the planes at tremendous speeds, relaying messages of real importance.

name: Treant
summary: Treants are strangely related to both humans and trees, combining features of both species. Peaceful by nature, treants can cause great damage when roused to anger.

name: Treant (Athas)
summary: Athasian treants are magical creatures, a mystic blending of the characteristics of a tree of life and a water spirit of the land. They are virtually immortal, and they act as incarnate guardians of the wilderness for which they were created.

name: Treant, Evil
summary: The peaceful race of treants, found on many worlds and in many lands, is also represented in Ravenloft. Sadly, the dark waters and corrupting evil of the land has twisted them into evil and foul things.

name: Treant, Greater
summary: Greater treants are solitary beings found deep within forests far away from civilization. Identical to treants in most respects, greater treants are larger and more powerful than their lesser cousins.

name: Treant, Undead
summary: When an evil treant sees that its many years are soon to come to an end, it seldom accepts this fate quietly. For most, this means a final, wild orgy of violence and death.

name: Tren
summary: Tren are a crossbreed of troglodytes with the largest, strongest, vilest members of the lizard man race.

name: Tressym
summary: Tressym are beautiful, fluffy, winged cats, closely related to the small, feral cats native to the woodlands of the Heartlands of the Realms – the cats domesticated by many in the Dales, Sembia, Cormyr, the Moonsea cities, and the Sword Coast.

name: Tribute Gatherer
climateTerrain: The Abyss (Umberlee's Lair); Ocean (Prime Material Plane)
summary: Tribute gatherers resemble large gray octopi at first glance. They have two 6' long arms ending in hands with sharp claws as well as two 12' tentacles, much like those of an octopus.

name: Triel - The Slug Archduke of Maladomini
summary: Triel the Fallen was once an archon, or so the chant goes, who was expelled from the lofty heights of Mount Celestia for excessive vanity and the contemplation of eternal perfection taken to extremes.

name: Trilloch
summary: The trilloch is an extraordinarily uncommon creature that originally hails from the Negative Energy Plane but is encountered only as it wanders other planes.

name: Trin
summary: Trin, also called thri-trin, are large, intelligent insects similar to thri-kreen, but slightly smaller. They have two arms and four legs instead of four arms and two legs, and their larger mandibles suggest the brutish and primitive.

name: Triton
summary: Tritons are rumored to be creatures from the elemental plane of Water that have been placed on the Prime Material plane for some purpose unknown to man.

name: Trobriand's Automaton
summary: In aspiring to make reliable and powerful artificial guardians, the mage Trobriand created a number of different prototypes and models over a number of years, all of which he abandoned with the creation of his scaladar.

name: Troglodyte
summary: Troglodytes are a warlike race of carnivorous reptilian humanoids that dwell in natural subterranean caverns and in the cracks and crevices of mountains.

name: Troll
summary: Trolls are horrid carnivores found in all climes, from arctic wastelands to tropical jungles. Most creatures avoid these beasts, since trolls know no fear and attack unceasingly when hungry.

name: Troll Mutate
summary: Troll mutates are the result of generations of exposure to corrupting alien energies, such as those found near a gate to the Far Realm. The energy is not only corrupting, but debilitating; these trolls have but half the Hit Dice of the common troll.

name: Troll, Legacy
summary: Legacy trolls are aquatic trolls altered over the generations by the vermeil muck lining the floor near their homes. These trolls have a variety of Legacies.

name: Trollhound
summary: A trollhound looks like a large, ugly worg or dire wolf with black pits for eyes. Most trollhounds stand between 4' and 6' at the shoulder and bulge with thick muscles and tendons.

name: Trosip
summary: Trosips look like dark gray dust bunnies. They blend in very well with ordinary cave, dungeon, or household dust.

name: Tsnng
summary: Even most primes know that gems and jewels contain magical essences at their very core. That's just a fact.

name: Tso
summary: The tso are a race of slavers, smugglers, and cross-traders who roam the lawful planes – at least until they reach Arcadia or Mount Celestia, where they're not at all welcome.

name: Tualleiaght
summary: The tualleiaght (to-ALL-ee-ate) is a snake-shaped creature with a thick body and a dozen tiny clawed feet along its underside. Its head is large and vaguely human, making some scholars think it is related to nagas.

name: Tul'k
summary: The tul'k is a bony creature that predominantly inhabits the mountains of Athas, but it has been seen in other terrain.

name: Tulani (Greater Eladrin)
summary: The greatest of the eladrins are the tulani, or faerie lords. Their courts are scattered throughout Olympus, never staying in the same place more than one night.

name: Tun Mi Lung (Typhoon Dragon)
summary: Tun mi lung, also known as typhoon dragons, have been charged by the Celestial Emperor to dispense destructive hurricanes and typhoons, a task they greatly enjoy.

name: Tundra Lizard
summary: Tundra lizards arc warm-blooded creatures that roam the cold regions of the north. To survive the bitter chill, tundra lizards are covered in thick plates of leathery skin and have a special heat-draining ability.

name: Tungsten Dragon, Ferrous
summary: Tungsten dragons are a no-nonsense species dedicated to the preservation and expansion of the forces of good. Unfortunately, tungsten dragons usually limit this preservation and expansion to their own domains.

name: Tunnelmouth Dweller
summary: The tunnelmouth dweller is a horrifying predator of dungeon and cavern alike. This creature has a mouth as wide as half the length of its body, ten feet in diameter, the typical width uf a dungeon tunnel The entire animal is a rich deep brown.

name: Turtledove
summary: Turtledoves are huge flying turtles with white feathered wings.

name: Tuyewera
summary: The tuyewera is a horrible type of undead monster created by evil clerics in remote jungle villages. The cleric takes the corpse of a man slain by death magic spells and ritually removes the legs at the knees.

name: Tween
summary: A tween is a parasitic creature from the Ethereal Plane. On its home plane it appears as a short, squat, ugly humanoid form with stubby arms and legs, and no neck.

name: Twill (Pocket Rat)
summary: The rock gnome pocket rat is not actually a rat, or even a rodent. It is a small burrowing marsupial that was bred as a pet by rock gnomes.

name: Tyin
summary: The tyin is a grotesque creature that may be related to the disir. The tyin is found only on Ansalon, while the disir lives exclusively on the continent of Taladas.

name: Tylor
summary: Tylors are huge land dragons with no wings. They are usually the products of evil dragons mating with hatori.

name: Tymher-haid
summary: When powerful evil people or creatures are slain, there is a chance that they will return to plague the living as undead, such as wights, spectres, and ghosts.

name: Tyminid
summary: Tyminids are intelligent and very cunning wolverine-like creatures that live in the remote mountains of the Arm of the Immortals. The tyminid is a heavyset beast with short, thick legs; long, curved claws; and a short, bushy tail.

name: Tyranthraxus
summary: Tyranthraxus is proficient with any number of weapons; DMs should detail appropriate weapons from their game worlds. It can be safely assumed that Tyranthraxus is proficient with at least one bladed weapon, one blunt weapon, one bow, and one hurled weapon.

name: Tyrg
summary: The 'tyrg' is a cross between a dog (in watchfulness) and a tiger (in stalking ability).

name: Ulitharid (Noble Illithid)
summary: Ulitharids, or Noble Illithid, are the elite of mind flayers, favored by their god the elder brain and free to exercise their will upon lower illithids and all other humanoids that fall under their power.

name: Umber Hulk
summary: Umber hulks are powerful subterranean predators whose ironlike claws allow them to burrow through solid stone in search of prey.

name: Umbra
summary: The umbra are undead shadow elves that dwell in the domain of Keening. Their devotion to Tristessa was so great in life that they continue to serve her long after death.

name: Umpleby
summary: The umpleby is an eight-foot-tall, 400 pound walking mound of wild, straggly brown hair. Lips and eyes can be discerned on its face, but every other part of its body is covered with fur.

name: Undead Beholder (Death Tyrant)
summary: Death tyrants are rotting, mold-encrusted beholders. They may be shriveled, wounds exposing their internal, spherical networks of circular ribs, among the remnants of their exoskeletal plates.

name: Undead Cloaker
summary: The undead cloaker is a foul and dangerous creature that is believed to be the earthly remains of a resplendent cloaker that has had its life drained away by the living dead. The creature actually imbues its host with the power to drain life energy.

name: Undead Dragon Slayer
summary: An undead dragon slayer is a horrifying creature returned from death to destroy dragons. The undead dragon slayer has a skeletal visage, rotted flesh, and dead, hollow eyes.

name: Undead Dwarf
summary: Undead dwarves are created by residual essence on the part of dwarves who are concerned, just before they die, that their final resting places will in some way be disturbed.

name: Undead Lake Monster
summary: The undead lake monster is a rare sight. It is an ancient, gargantuan, undead water serpent with grayish-green skin and a huge mouth lined with needle-sharp teeth.

name: Ungulosin
summary: A protective spirit of the water, the ungulosin is a native of the Elemental Plane of Water.

name: Unicorn
summary: Unicorns dwell only in temperate woodlands, away from human habitation.

name: Unicorn, Shadow
summary: The shadow unicorn is a terrifying creature of pure evil that roams the wilds of Darkon and Falkovnia, intent only on glorying in the fear and pain of those it encounters.

name: Unicow
summary: The unicow lives in grassy plains and shuns contact with humans and humanoids. Like the unicorn, it can be tamed by a maiden pure of heart, though she must be of neutral alignment and probably not very bright.

name: Unisus (Unicorn)
summary: Unisi are unicorns with pegasi wings, the result of crossbreeding between the two species. A single such creature is called a unisus.

name: Unseelie Faerie (Cerilia)
summary: Unseelie faeries are a macabre host of evil and undead beings, the hideous counterpart of the Seelie Court. The Unseelie Court has its own dark queen and other “nobles” who manipulate the Seeming toward their own sinister ends.

name: Unseelie Faerie (Sprite)
summary: Twisted and evil cousins of the seelie faeries, the unseelie faeries are ugly, dark-skinned creatures. They have tattered insect wings, long thin arms, and broad, large-nosed faces.

name: Unseelie Nymph
summary: These spiteful, evil creatures are fey and twisted relatives of other nymphs. Unseelie nymphs delight in the perversion and corruption of everything that is good and beautiful in the natural world.

name: Ur-Histachii
climateTerrain: Tropical jungles or subterranean areas beneath tropical regions
summary: The necromancers of the Cult of the Dragon's cell in and under the Vilhon Reach's city of Hlondeth have created this undead perversion.

name: Urd
summary: These aggressive, flying humanoids are distantly related to kobolds.

name: Urdunnir (Dwarf)
summary: A long-forgotten offshoot of the dwarves, urdunnir means “Orecutter” in the urdunnir language, which is closely related to dwarvish (a speaker of one language can understand about 75% of the other).

name: Uridezu (Rat-Fiend)(Lesser Tanar'ri)
climateTerrain: The Abyss and Prime Material Plane
summary: Uridezu, called rat-fiends are hulking, man-sized creatures resembling leprous, muscular hunch-backed rodents walking on two short legs. They inhabit the Abyss, where they serve the various tanar'ri.

name: Urkhan Worm
summary: These powerful creatures were first encountered at the same time as the famous explorer discovered the cavern of Thorbardin. Since then they have been harnessed for work in the warrens and mines.

name: Urophion
summary:
**Psionics Summary**
| Level | Dis/Sci/Dev | Attack/Defense | Score | PSPs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | 3/2/8 | EW,II,MB/All | = Int | 1d100+100 |
- Psychokinesis – Sciences: nil; Devotions: control body, levitation. - Psychometabolism – Sciences: nil; Devotion: body equilibrium.

name: Ursoi
summary: Ursoi are a race of bears that have evolved into an intelligent, social species. They live and work together in a tribe, use tools and sometimes weapons, and hunt cooperatively for food.

name: Utahraptor
summary: The utahraptor is a carnivorous dinosaur related to the deinonychus, only it is much larger. The utahraptor is 20' long, stands 15' high, and weighs around 1,500 lbs.

name: Uthraki (Forest Spirit)
summary: Uthraki are malevolent, shapechanging spirits that haunt the dark woods and lonely roads of Rashemen. Uthraki are said to take the form of harmless companions to befriend lone travelers, and then kill and devour them.

name: Utukku
frequency: Common on Carceri, very rare elsewhere
summary: Utukku usually inhabit the planes of Carceri, but on rare occasions they will come to the Prime Material Plane, inhabiting caverns or pits in desolate regions.

name: Vaath
summary: The evil vaaths are known throughout the planes as relentless, vicious killers. These bloodthirsty, intelligent terrors like to inflict pain and misery as well as kill.

name: Vaati (Wind Duke)
summary: The Vaati (VAH tee), or Wind Dukes, are a race of immortals dedicated to Law. Vaati look like statuesque humans.

name: Vacuous
summary: As much as the bean-counters of the Fraternity of Order'd like to keep everything in the multiverse nice and neat, the truth of it's undeniable – the Inner Planes are full of leaks.

name: Vagabond
summary: It is difficult to say what a vagabond really looks like, because they can mimic countless other creatures in form. They are an alien life force of unknown origin.

name: Valpurgeist
summary: The valpurgeist, or hanged man, is an undead creature that is sometimes manifested when an innocent man or woman is wrongly hanged for a crime.

name: Vampire (Western)
summary: Of all the chaotic evil undead creatures that stalk the world, none is more dreadful than the vampire. Moving silently through the night, vampires prey upon the living without mercy or compassion.

name: Vampire Cactus (Carnivorous Plant)
summary: Vampire cacti are plants of the deep desert that supplement their water supply by draining liquids from animals that come within range.

name: Vampire, Dwarf
summary: Dwarves are a long lived race with an intense cultural hatred of the undead and their evil work. They regard death as the just rewards of a warrior and the undead would cheat a hero of his glorious end.

name: Vampire, Elf
summary: The elvish vampire is a tragic creature indeed, for when someone from a race that so loves life and goodness turns to evil and death, the world has lost much.

name: Vampire, Gnome
summary: While the race of gnomes is little understood by many surface dwellers, the deadly breed of vampire tat these creatures spawn are even more alien.

name: Vampire, Halfling
summary: Few races enjoy life and the basic comforts of a quiet, peaceful existence more than the halflings. Thus, when one of these fine creatures is driven into a life of evil by the preying of some sinister vampire, the world suffers a great loss.

name: Vampire, Illithid
summary: Vampire illithids are the result of evil experiments that were meant to be terminated.

name: Vampire, Kender
summary: Kender vampires retain the same general physical properties that they did in life. Thus, they stand somewhat under four feet in height and are very slightly built.

name: Vampiric Mist
summary: MC5 Monstrous Compendium Greyhawk Adventures Appendix (2107)

name: Vampyre
summary: The vampyre is a foul creature that, like the much feared nosferatu, exists on the blood of its victims. Unlike the nosferatu or its vampiric cousins, however, the vampyre is not undead.

name: Vampyre (Vladimir Ludzig)
summary: Nature takes great care to insure that there is always a balance of predators and prey. In the oceans, there is the ever-present shark, constantly seeking to satisfy its hunger.

name: Vaporighu
summary: Vaporighu are evil creatures of the underworld that lurk in the foul furnaces of Gehenna. They prey on unwary travelers, lesser fiends, and the occasional petitioner or larva.

name: Varanid
summary: The natives of certain tropical islands live in fear of the reptilian warriors who strike in the darkness to take their children and plunder their villages. Fast, lithe, agile, and vicious, varanids are a warrior race of bipedal komodo dragons.

name: Vargouille
climateTerrain: Any ruins, burial place, or subterranean
summary: These horrid creatures are products of the Lower Planes.

name: Varkha
summary: Varkhas are a race of short, brutale aquatic lizard men that hunt in the caverns and waters of the Underdark.

name: Varrangoin
summary: Varrangoin, or abyss bats, are creatures native to the Abyss (as their name suggests). They appear as giant bats with the leather of their wings (wingspan is typically twice the body length) rotted and hanging away from their skeletal frames.

name: Varrdig (Elemental Grue)
summary: The varrdig, or fluid brute, is a creature from the plane of elemental Water.

name: Vartha
summary: Vartha means “guardian spirit” It is one of the few undead that are not necessarily malign. A vartha is a guardian spirit in many senses.

name: Vecna the Maimed God, Lord of Cavitius, Demigod (Lich)
summary: The statistics provided reflect the fact that Vecna's powers are being restrained by the mysterious powers that exist within the Demiplane of Dread. He is trapped in a single physical manifestation and cannot take on incorporeal or avatar forms.

name: Velya (Vampire)
summary: Velya are a form of underwater vampire. They were once surface dwellers who became undead through an ancient curse.

name: Venger
summary: A venger is the animated remains of some strong-willed being who suffered a great wrong in life. The wrong must have been committed by an intelligent creature who survives beyond the death of the being who will become the venger.

name: Verbeeg
summary: Known as "human behemoths, these human giants inhabit areas infested with hill giants and ogres.

name: Vermilion Pudding
summary: Vermilion pudding is the name given to an aggregate colony of the flesh-eating vermilia bacteria. The Red Curse has affected these colonies, imbuing them with the ability to act together as one creature.

name: Vestige (Undead Dream)
summary: The Vestige is a creature born from the nightmares of every citizen of the city of Moil as they died in cursed sleep. It appears as a bank of creeping mist.

name: Villichi
summary: Villichi are females born to normal humans. No one can predict when or where a villichi child will be born.

name: Viper Tree
summary: Said to be the bastard young of Nidhogg, the serpent at the root of Yggdrasil, viper trees are white, scaly trees with living snakes' heads as their branches.

name: Visage
summary: What is real? Ask any two berks, especially those from different factions, and a body's likely to get two completely different answers.

name: Visceraith
summary: The visceraith, or bone spirit, exists in a twilight of shadows and whispers. The entity appears as a brain with eyes and a tongue.

name: Viscount Mammon of Minauros Lord of the Third
summary: Mammon is a devil who knows what he wants, and that's power. He rules over the stinking mire of Minauros, but spends most of his time plotting and scheming.

name: Vishap
summary: A vishap is a flightless Zakharan dragon, a crafty and cowardly creature that preys on the weak and flees the strong. They are sly, cunning predators that fight through stealth and deceit.

name: Vizier's Turban
summary: The vizier's turban is a symbiotic creature which attaches itself to a wizard. It provides its partner with greatly enhanced spellcasting potential and magic resistance.

name: Voat
summary: The voat is a nocturnal ratlike creature about the size of a cat that exists throughout the Savage Coast. Voats are aggressive, insatiable scavengers, found wherever food is stored.

name: Vodoni Breeder
summary: Vodoni breeders appear much as normal human beings, except they keep their heads shaved. They wear great flowing silver robes with deep purple satin rivulets stitched throughout.

name: Vodoni Enforcer
summary: Magically-created creations of Vulkaran's breeders, Vodoni enforcers are the half-man, half-wolf beast-warrior who have been infected with a special Vodoni form of lycanthropy.

name: Volt
summary: Volts are curious little creatures, but bad-tempered and dangerous. These spherical animals hunt by sensing the electrical impulses of their prey.

name: Voodan Human (Chicken Bone)
summary: The Voodan are a race of humans who are found only in the misty domains of Ravenloft. Some say they are an offshoot of the Vistani, but there is no real evidence to support this claim.

name: Voor Larva
summary: Voor larvae are 8-foot long skeletal insectoids whose “wings” are bare of any membrane, but instead serve as forward-swept, razor-tipped claws.

name: Vorlog
summary: One of a vampire's most vulnerable moments is when the evil creature is attempting to complete its dark kiss, its bonding with a new vampire companion, creating a vampiric “bride” or “groom”.

name: Vorr
summary: Travelers in the wilder regions of the Outlands and some of the Lower Planes'd be well-advised to be careful of vorrs.

name: Vortex
summary: Those few who have seen them usually think vortexes are miniature whirlwinds, little dust devils about the size of a small jug, but what they see is not the vortex itself. Rather, it's the air wrapped like a second skin around the being within.

name: Vortex Spider
summary: Vortex spiders have the basic shape of the phase spider, from which they evolved, but the similarities between the two species end there.

name: Vreesar (Gelugon Baatezu)
summary: Vreesar has an extremely large, insectoid body, as do all gelugons. He has huge claws on his hands and feet and sports sharp pincers at his mouth.

name: Vrock (True Tanar'ri)
summary: The vrock serve as elite fighting troops in the Blood War. Vrock look like a cross between a large human and a vulture, with strong, sinewy limbs covered with fine gray feathers; long necks and vulture heads; and wicked claws and beak.

name: Vulture
summary: Vultures and their kin are carrion eaters that roam the skies in search of injured or dead creatures to feed upon.

name: Vulturehound
summary: A vulturehound is a bizarre combination of vulture and wild dog, perhaps engendered by some overly-curious Herathian mage. Vulturehounds have long, gray, shaggy hair on their bodies.

name: Vurgens (Fish)
summary: The Vurgens, also known as the giant gulper eel, is a fierce marine predator that roams the depths of the sea. Its body consists of a long, sinuous torso and tail, and an oversized head and detachable jaw.

name: Waff
summary: A waff is a body double whose image depicts a character at the moment of his or her death. The waff may be spotted by the character himself or by an acquaintance.

name: Walkers (Living Machine)
summary: Walkers number among the simplest sheens observed outside a machine cyst. A walker's body is composed mostly of a lumpy metallic obloid.

name: Wall-Walker
summary: Wall-walkers are subterranean hunters that live in the caverns and passages beneath Athas's burning surface.

name: Wallara
summary: The wallaras (sometimes called chameleon men) are the oldest of the Lizard-kin races and are descended from dragons. Once a proud and wise race, the wallaras were reduced to their current primitive state through the action of the araneas.

name: Wang-Liang
summary: Cousins of the common oni and the ogre magi, the wang-liang are a race of exceptionally intelligent and long-lived humanoids who are implacably hostile to humans.

name: War Cat
summary: As the Council of Thirteen rules the rats of Nehwon, so do the War Cats rule the felines. A military aristocracy of all cat races, the War Cats may be summoned to do battle against anyone or anything that threatens felines.

name: War Dog
summary: Generally large mastiffs or wolfhounds, they have keen senses of smell and hearing, making them adept at detecting intruders. Most war dogs are not usually vicious, and will rarely attack without cause.

name: Warden Beast
hitDice: 6 or as animal type's +3 (whichever is higher)
summary: Warden beasts are powerful, spiritual representations of animal groups on the Beastlands. They are the protectors, purveyors, and proliferators of their species, serving as leaders and champions.

name: Wastrel
summary: Wastrels are dangerous birdlike creatures that plague the loneliest and most inhospitable reaches of the planes. They're most often found in desolate woods, dismal swamps, or fetid marshes.

name: Wastrilith (Greater Tanar'ri)
summary: The standoffish wastrilith, or water lords, inhabit watery parts of the Lower Planes (and, rarely, other planes), content in their isolation.

name: Watcher (Abomination)
summary: Watchers are 6-foot-diameter spheres with three central eyes arranged around the circumference of the sphere. These eyes are huge and unlidded.

name: Watchghost
summary: These undead, sometimes called “unsleeping guardians”, appear as graceful, beautiful humans of either sex who drift or walk about silently.

name: Watchspider
summary: Watchspiders are a specially-bred subspecies of huge spiders, raised and trained in the Realms as guardians.

name: Water Cat
summary: Water cats are descended from the familiars of several of the wizards who died at the hands of the necromancer during his overthrow of the guild. Like many other creatures of the sewers, they have been warped by the magical pollution.

name: Water Cobra
summary: If disturbed, it bites with an extremely poisonous and fast-acting venom (saving throw vs. poison at -1 or die in 1d4 rounds).

name: Water Elemental
summary: Water elementals can be conjured in any area containing a large amount of water or watery liquid. At least one thousand cubic feet of liquid is required to create a shell for the water elemental to inhabit.

name: Water Horse
summary: The water-horse is an amphibious monster that looks like a beautiful horse of the finest quality. If it can be caught and tamed, it does indeed make a mount which is equal to any natural steed.

name: Water Leaper
summary: Water leapers, known as llamhigyn y dwr (pronounced “thlamheegin er door”) in their native Wales, look something like a large toad with a fishlike tail instead of back legs and a pair of flying-fish style fin-wings instead of front legs.

name: Water Mephit
summary: These thin, finny humanoids are covered with sea-green scales, and webs of skin connect the spines of their ears, toes, and wings. They have fishy, staring eyes and fish lips.

name: Water Weird (Water Kin)(Elemental)
summary: These unusual creatures are natives of the elemental plane of Water, but they are being encountered more and more on the Prime Material plane. When they are found in this realm, they are violent and hostile, attacking all living things instantly.

name: Watroach
summary: Watroaches (or war beetles) are enormous nomadic insects of the desert tablelands. Each adult is actually a gigantic, mobile hive filled with a multitude of drones.

name: Wavefire
summary: Now here's a stretch – a body needs a wide-open mind to follow along. A few scholars and philosophers think that, long ago, the Inner Planes had a different configuration.

name: Wax Golem (Ravenloft)
summary: Perhaps the most dreadful type of golem, these creatures can be made to exactly resemble a specific person.

name: Weasel
summary: Weasels are abundant throughout the world's temperate forests and in many subterranean settings. There are numerous species, but they are all similar in appearance and habits.

name: Web-Spectre
summary: Some evil wizards of 6th level or higher prepare themselves-or herself before death to become web-spectres.

name: Webbird
climateTerrain: Temperate and subtropical forests and caves
summary: The name “webbird” is actually a misnomer resulting from this creature's feathered appearance and ability to fly. The webbird is actually closer to an arachnid or insect in its biological make-up.

name: Weisshund
summary: These rare creatures are encountered only in temples and shrines of St. Cuthbert.

name: Wemic
summary: Wemics are leonine counterparts to centaurs. A wemic's body consists of a leonine body with a humanoid torso extending from what would be a lion's neck.

name: Werebadger (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werebadgers are dwarves that can transform into giant badgers or dwarf-badger hybrids. In humanoid form, they appear to be normal dwarves with a silver stripe in their hair or beards (not an uncommon trait among dwarves).

name: Werebat (Lycanthrope)
summary: Like the other species of lycanthrope found in Ravenloft, two varieties of werebat exist – natural (or true) and infected. True werebats are those creatures who have been born to werebat parents.

name: Werebear (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werebears are humans who can transform themselves into large brown bears. They are the best known good-aligned lycanthropes.

name: Wereboar (Lycanthrope)
summary: Wereboars are humans who are able to transform themselves into a form combining human and boar features. Their tempers are as ugly as their features.

name: Werecat (Lycanthrope)
summary: Many new types of lycanthropes appeared during the Time of Troubles, including werecats, the antithesis of evil wererats.

name: Werecrocodile (Lycanthrope)
summary: In their human form, werecrocodiles are tall, thin creatures with sharp features, a long nose and chin, and a thin face with a noticeable overbite. In their crocodile form, they are very long, big, and powerful monsters.

name: Weredragon
summary: Weredragons, as many folk tales attest, are beautiful human women transformed into dragons – or, more accurately, a race of dragonkind that can assume female human form whenever they desire.

name: Werefox (Lycanthrope)
summary: A foxwoman is an elven-appearing woman who is able to transform herself into a silver fox form or a silver-furred humanoid (vixen) form with a fox's head. They are extremely self-centered.

name: Werehyena (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werehyenas are humans, usually male, who can transform themselves into hyenalike forms. Their packs roam the plains and deserts of Zakhara looking for prey.

name: Werejackal (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werejackals originated in the ancient land that gave birth to the island domain of Har'Akir. There, they were priests of a strange god called Anubis.

name: Werejaguar (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werejaguars are humans (or demihumans) who can transform into three distinct forms: that of a human, a large jaguar, and a hybrid form that combines the features of both human and jaguar.

name: Werejaguar (Mystara) (Lycanthrope)
summary: Mystarans know werejaguars as the scourge of tropical rain forests: solitary, extremely effective hunters. The werejaguar has three forms: completely human, a human-jaguar hybrid, and a jaguar with glowing red eyes.

name: Werejaguar (Ravenloft)
summary: Werejaguars are lurking in the darkest hearts of jungles, usually living in and around old ruins long ago forgotten by locals. They venture from their secluded homes only to hunt and patrol their wilderness territories.

name: Werelagomorph (Were-hare)
hitDice: 3 (24 hp in were-hare form, 3 hp in hare form)
summary: This creature appears as a hare but changes to its were-form if attacked. In were-form, it can attack with a onehanded weapon for normal damage.

name: Wereleopard (Lycanthrope)
summary: Wereleopards are a race of ferocious hunters. They tend to keep to tilemselves until led by the paka, an intelligent race of humanoid cat people.

name: Werelion (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werelions are humans able to assume lion form. They are efficient, communal predators, dangerous not only because of their individual skill but also because of their ability to stalk their prey as a singleminded group.

name: Werepanther (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werepanthers are a rare variety of lycanthrope found mainly in tropical mountains. The result of ancient juju rituals to marry the power and senses of a wild beast to a man, werepanthers serve their creator, the shaman panther lord.

name: Wererat (Lycanthrope)
summary: Wererats, also called ratmen, are humans who can transform themselves into three forms – human, human-sized ratman, and giant rat. They are sly and evil, and usually inhabit tunnel complexes beneath cities.

name: Wereraven (Lycanthrope)
summary: Wereravens are a race of wise and good-aligned shapechangers who seem to have migrated to Ravenloft from another realm (probably Greyhawk) centuries ago.

name: Wereray (Lycanthrope)
summary: Wererays live in the warm and salty wafers of the Demiplane of Dread. They prey on fishermen and others who wander too close to the surf and sting them with their long, whiplike tails.

name: Wereshark (Lycanthrope)
summary: The wereshark is an avaricious hybrid of man and shark.

name: Werespider (Lycanthrope)
summary: Lycanthropic spiders are extremely rare; the curse of lycanthropy spell only invokes mammalian forms, not insects or arachnids.

name: Wereswine (Lycanthrope)
summary: Existing on the fringes of human settlements, wereswine appear either as huge hogs with tusks or as grossly fat humans.

name: Weretiger (Jahed)
summary: Jahed came into Sri Raji as a young adult. At that time, he was a specimen of physical fitness blessed with strong limbs, keen senses, and a quick mind.

name: Weretiger (Lycanthrope)
summary: Weretigers are humans, usually female, that have the ability to transform into tigerlike forms. They have a strong affinity for all felines.

name: Werewolf (Lycanthrope)
summary: Werewolves are the most feared of the lycanthropes, men who can transform into wolflike beasts. They should not be confused with wolfweres – wolves who turn into men.

name: Wezer
summary: Wezers are enormous flying insects that make underground hives in the desert tablelands. Though of animal intelligence, they are highly social creatures, structured into several distinct classes by both social function and physical characteristics.

name: Whale, Astral
summary: Sometimes there's things that a body just can't explain. Astral whales are one.

name: Whipsting
summary: The whipsting is a vicious predator found on rocky ledges, in caverns, and among ruins. The strike of a whipsting makes a loud, whiplike crack audible up to 70 feet away.

name: White
summary: Silt Horror is the name given a group of predators that dwell in the sea of sand. While they vary in size and color, all of them are characterized by a large number of tentacles and an unending hunger.

name: White Dragon
climateTerrain: Arctic plains, hills, mountains, and subterranean
summary: White dragons, the smallest and weakest of the evil dragons, are slow witted but efficient hunters. They are impulsive, vicious, and animalistic, tending to consider only the needs and emotions of the moment and having no foresight or regret.

name: White Fang
summary: These carnivorous snow serpents are distantly related to white dragons, though they have no wings or legs. Their bodies are covered with soft white fur, except for their heads, which are encased in scalelike plates of white ivory.

name: Wichtlin
summary: Wichtlin are elven undead. They are relentless killers and deadly adversaries.

name: Wicked Leprechaun
summary: Wicked leprechauns are probably the result of the same form of evil magics that turned a race of brownies into quicklings. While these creatures were once playful and mischievous, they are now vile, deadly monsters.

name: Wiggle
summary: The hurwaeti are an ancient humanoid race distantly related to both sahuagin and lizard men. In space, they usually function as mercenaries, common crewmen, or occasionally as pirates, traders, or salvagers operating their own ships.

name: Wight
summary: In ages long past, the word “wight” meant simply “man”. As the centuries have passed, though, it has come to be associated only with those undead that typically inhabit barrow mounds and catacombs.

name: Wild Dog
summary: Smaller than wolves, the appearance of the wild dog varies from place to place. Most appear very wolf-like, while others seem to combine the looks of a wolf and a jackal.

name: Wild Dwarf (Jungle Dwarf)
summary: Wild dwarves are a reclusive race of dwarves. Also known as “Jungle Dwarves”, they are found only in remote, hot jungle areas in Chult and the nearby lands to the east.

name: Wild Mul
summary: Muls are a cross-breed of dwarf and human that are raised for the gladiatorial games often played on Athas. While all are born into captivity, some escape and make their homes in the plains and oasis of the Athasian deserts.

name: Will O' Mist
summary: The will o'mist is a variant of the will o'wisp that makes its home only in the misty borders of Ravenloft. While most people have good cause to fear these creatures, the mysterious Vistani seem to have found some way of controlling them.

name: Will O'Dawn
summary: The will o'dawn (or feu follet, as it is also called) is perhaps the most mysterious of all will o'wisp variants, and it is certainly the most helpful.

name: Will O'Deep
summary: The least powerful of all will o'wisp variants, the will o'deep is found only within the most remote tunnels and caverns.

name: Will O'Sea
summary: The will o'sea is a variant of the will o'wisp that makes its home on and around the seas of Ravenloft. Even more dangerous than its better known cousins, the will o'sea lures sailors to watery graves.

name: Will O'Shadow
summary: The will o'shadow is a mesmerizing being that lures unsuspecting folk into entering the Shadow World. It appears in places where the curtain between Cerilia and the Shadow World is thin, and feeds on Cerilian life energy.

name: Will O'Wisp
summary: The will o'wisp is a malevolent entity that makes its home in swamps, bogs, and moors.

name: Wind Walker (Elemental)
summary: Wind walkers are creatures from the Elemental Plane of Air, where they are the servants of the djinn. On the Prime Material Plane, they prefer to live high in the mountains or in great caverns far below the surface.

name: Windghost
summary: Windghosts may be native to another plane. They are flying cones, the large base (their head) foremost.

name: Windigo
summary: A windigo is a vampiric wind spirit that haunts isolated wilderness areas. Cruel hunters by nature, windigos revel in stalking and terrorizing their prey.

name: Winged Serpent
summary: Winged serpents, sometimes called spark snakes, are colorful reptiles that dwell in Zakhara's forests and jungles. Winged serpents come in many colors, ranging from sky blue and emerald green to raspberry red.

name: Winged Snake
summary: Winged serpents, sometimes called spark snakes, are colorful reptiles that dwell in Zakhara's forests and jungles. Winged serpents come in many colors, ranging from sky blue and emerald green to raspberry red.

name: Wingless Wonder
summary: The alkada, or “wingless wonder”, is a comical beast that resembles a walking egg (which it has also been called).

name: Winter-Wight
summary: Winter-wights are undead creatures of tremendous power. They appear as humanoid skeletons shethed in thick casings of clear ice, save for their skulls.

name: Wishing Imp
summary: The wishing imp is an imp that has assumed the form of a small statuette. It grants wishes to its owner, though these are always twisted and perverted to evil in some way.

name: Wizshade
summary: A wizshade (or spellshade) appears as an undulating, rushing snake of force in the air that slows and widens into a swirling, many-colored vortex about 8 feet in diameter.

name: Wolf
summary: The wolf is a very active, cunning carnivore, capable of surviving in nearly every climate. Shrouded in mystery and suspicion, they are viewed as vicious killers that slaughter men and animals alike for the lack of better things to do.

name: Wolf, Stone
summary: As these creatures are animated stone, their appearances can vary widely along a wolf theme. The only similarity between all stone wolves is the use of white-hot fire opals for eyes.

name: Wolf, Vampiric
summary: These foul undead creatures are the result of corrupting ceremonies used on normal wolf pups by evil clerics. Vampiric wolves are uniformly black, with feral, glowing orange eyes.

name: Wolfwere
summary: The wolfwere is an evil and hateful creature that delights in the brutal slaying of humans and demihumans alike.

name: Wolfwere, Greater
summary: Greater wolfweres are a bane of evil to all who live. They are able to assume three shapes at will, taking only a single round to alter forms.

name: Wolverine
summary: Known also as the carcajou, quickhatch, and glutton, this fierce animal has been the scourge of many arctic cultures since the dawn of time.

name: Wolvern
summary: This is an intelligent canine hybrid that prefers to hunt in packs.

name: Wood Giant (Voadkyn)
summary: Wood giants (also known as voadkyn) are one of the smallest of the minor races of giants, looking somewhat like giant-sized wood elves. They are flighty, frivolous, and good friends with wood elves.

name: Wood Man (Forest Spirit)
summary: Of all the nature spirits of Rashemen, the most powerful is the great being known as the wood man.

name: Worm, Lukhorn
summary: The lukhorn is a burrowing, predatory worm that lurks in the mysterious caverns of the underdark. Though the creature is generally gray-skinned in its natural state, the lukhorn can alter its coloration to match almost perfectly the stone around it.

name: Wraith
summary: The wraith is an evil undead spirit of a powerful human that seeks to absorb human life energy.

name: Wraith (Athas)
summary: An Athasian wraith is a noncorporeal undead capable of moving freely between the Gray and the land of the living. It can possess unliving objects of all sorts, ranging from weapons to furniture to corpses, as well as unintelligent creatures such as scorpions, insects, or slimes.

name: Wraith (Greyhawk)
summary: Swordwraiths are the spirits of warriors cut down during battle and kept from the dissolution of death by their indomitable wills.

name: Wraith, Desert
summary: Creatures killed by skriaxits are animated three days later as desert wraiths, malevolent spirits of the sands.

name: Wraith-King
summary: Wraith-kings were once powerful individuals who so feared death that they made unholy bargains with an evil god. Each individual believed he was gaining immortality, but was instead turned into an undead monster.

name: Wraith-Spider
summary: Wraith-spiders appear as vaguely formed dark spider shapes whose eight legs trail off into dark mist. They have no physical substance, being more shadow and mist than spider.

name: Wraithworm
summary: The wraithworm's a magical snake commonly found in arid regions such as deserts, rocky wastes, or barren badlands. It's especially common in the layer of Minethys on Carceri, and the white wastes of Pelion on Arborea.

name: Wryback
summary: Wrybacks are malicious little humanoid creatures that live by scavenging and stealing. They are named for their twisted, rubbery bodies and limbs.

name: Wurmling
summary: Wurmlings are large, intelligent worms, often found at the helm of evil brotherhoods (such as assassins' guilds) and crime syndicates. They rule through a combination of physical presence, intellect, cunning, intimidation, and blackmail.

name: Wyndlass
summary: The wyndlass is a tentacled horror that lurks in desolate swamps and gloomy forests. A powerful predator, it has been known to devour several whole horses at a time in its quest to satisfy its awesome hunger.

name: Wynzet
summary: Wynzets are large, furry creatures commonly found in Robrenn forests. They tend to have the form of either gray squirrels or rabbits, but other forms have been found.

name: Wyrd
summary: Wyrds are undead creatures with strong connections to the Positive Energy Plane. They are created when an evil spirit inhabits the dead body of an elf.

name: Wyste
summary: The wyste (pronounced, wist) is an alien creature much like a giant worm that inhabits fetid pools of slime. The typical specimen is 2 feet in diameter and about 25 feet long.

name: Wyvern
summary: A distant cousin to the dragon, the wyvern is a huge flying lizard with a poisonous stinger in its tail.

name: Wyvern Drake
summary: The wyvern drake is, as its name implies, a cross between a dragon and a wyvern. It is 45 feet long (half of that is tail), with a 60-foot wingspan and a yard-long stinger at the end of its tail.

name: Xag-Ya/Xeg-Yi
summary: Ah, life – there's no spot in the multiverse where it hasn't managed to take hold. Perhaps, in a tome dedicated to the creatures of the inhospitable Inner Planes, such a concept should be a theme, or even the theme.

name: Xanthon the Baneful
summary: A slender shadowy figure that can easily be mistaken for a man—at least until his clothes rot and reveal the tiny wings sprouting between his shoulder blades — Xanthon the Baneful is the Scourge of Swarms, the youngest of the ghazneths.

name: Xantravar (Stinging Horror)
summary: The xantravar, or stinging horror, is a silent, deadly predator that inhabits swamps, salt marshes, and remote seacoasts with tidal caverns.

name: Xaver
summary: A xaver looks exactly like a sword, with a hard, silvery body and six faceted green eyes that resemble gems around the hilt of a blade. Xavers are intelligent creatures that scuttle about on tiny, retractible, wormlike legs.

name: Xerichou
summary: Xerichous are flying, vicious predators. Xerichous begin their life as relatively small, armored, wormlike creatures.

name: Xill
summary: The vaguely reptilian xill are natives of the Ethereal Plane.

name: Xixchil
summary: Xixchil (ZIX-chil) are praying mantis-like “mantoids” who are accomplished craftsmen.

name: Xorn
summary: The xorn are natives to the elemental plane of Earth.

name: Xvart
summary: Xvarts are a cruel, cowardly race of humanoids which live in hilly, cavernous regions. They occupy a place in humanoid society somewhere between goblins and kobolds.

name: Yaggol
summary: The yaggol are a degenerate sub-race of the evil and terrifying mind flayers Degenerate, in this case, does not mean more debased or decadent (mind flayers are already decadent in the extreme).

name: Yagnoloth (Lesser Yugoloth)
summary: Yagnoloths are nobles of the yugoloth society, despised lords of fiefs and all who enter these fiefs. They are large, horrible humanoid creatures with two unequal arms, one man-sized and the other giant-sized.

name: Yak-Man (Yikaria)
summary: Yak-men live in the highest mountains, comfortable among the foreboding heights and deep, hidden valleys of the most inaccessible ranges. Here, they maintain their petty empires, ruling all other life forms within their borders.

name: Yellow Dragon
summary: Although the existence of yellow dragons has long been predicted by sages (based on theories of primary colors), the first specimen was spotted only five or so years ago.

name: Yellow Musk Creeper
summary: The yellow musk creeper is a plant that attacks humanoids, draining Intelligence and turning them into yellow musk zombies.

name: Yeshom
summary: Yeshoms are the undead remnants of aranean mages who sought power, got it, and paid too high a price. In its normal form, the yeshom resembles a large puddle of oily, black tar.

name: Yeth Hound
summary: These fearsome flying hounds, magical creatures of the night, hunt humans, demihumans, and faerie folk.

name: Yeti
summary: Sometimes confused with the abominable snowman, the yeti is a distant cousin to the great carnivorous apes of warmer climates.

name: Yitsan
summary: The yitsan is also known as “treasure bane” and “intruder within”. Unwary sailors bring the eggs aboard ship in newfound treasure hoards.

name: Yochlol (Lesser Tanar'ri)
summary: Lolth, the Queen of Spiders, is one of many powers that call the Abyss home. Her infinte maze of black webs fills an entire layer.

name: Yowler
summary: Yowlers look like huge, well-muscled hounds. Their short fur is as dull and black as chimney soot.

name: Yphoz
summary: Yphoz appear in a variety of shapes and sizes. Old adult yphoz may reach a length of 2'.

name: Yrasda
summary: Around the time of the Cataclysm, certain irda underwent a transformation, becoming closely linked with the sea.

name: Yu Lung (Carp Dragon)
summary: Yu lung, also known as carp dragons, live in all types of fresh water rivers and lakes.

name: Yuan-ti
summary: Descendants of humans whose blood has been fouled, yuan-ti have varying degrees of snakelike body parts. They are highly intelligent and evil, always plotting to advance their causes.

name: Yugoloth, Greater, Baernaloth
summary: Long, gangly limbs covered by purulent gray flesh; an over-sized, horned head with an obscene mouth comprising nothing but teeth and tongue; distant, glazed yellow eyes dripping fluid far more vile than tears – all these things are a baernaloth, yet it is more.

name: Yugoloth, Greater, Ultroloth
summary: Ultroloths are the strange, enigmatic rulers of the yugoloths. These creatures hold sway over their underlings by force of will and a reputation for cruelty.

name: Yugoloth, Guardian, Least, Yagdoo
summary: Yugoloths are creatures summoned by evil wizards or priests to guard something of importance. Yugoloth guardians always defend their subjects with great ferocity and cunning.

name: Yuki-on-na
summary: The yuki-on-na is a beautiful but deadly humanoid creature who is native to the coldest regions of Kara-Tur.

name: Zakhar Dwarf
summary: Zakhar are a mysterious race of mountain dwarves that has withdrawn from contact with all other dwarven races.

name: Zakharan kraken
summary: Zakharan Kraken are an albino race of air- and water-breathing squid-like creatures that dwell in the dark depths of the ocean.

name: Zaratan
summary: The zaratan is an enormous, passive turtle found in the warm currents of Zakhara's seas, in the Al-Qadim campaign setting. Thankfully, the zaratan spends most of its existence in a profoundly deep slumber.

name: Zard
frequency: Uncommon in wildspace, rare in phlogiston
summary: Zard are reptiles, averaging one to two feet in length. They have eight legs, with a set of tiny, grasping claws at the end of each.

name: Zat
summary: Zats are huge, metallic creatures built like delta-winged planes. Their bodies are cylindrical and about 100' long, while their knife-edge metal wings span about 150'.

name: Zebracorn (Unicorn)
summary: Zebracorns are tropical unicorns with the black striping of zebras, though they are sleeker and not as stocky. They usually have doe-brown eyes.

name: Zebranaur (Centaur-kin)
summary: Zebranaurs have the upper body of a human and the lower body of a zebra. A zebranaur's upper body is normally brown, without the characteristic black-on-white stripes that cover its lower body.

name: Zhackal
summary: Zhackals are small pack animals that travel about feeding off of the emotions of those about to die. The pack gathers and feeds on the dying victim's emotions, using psionics to get the victim to give up his hold on life.

name: Zhakar Lizards
summary: Zhakar lizards are lean, powerful creatures with muscular hind legs, dexterous front legs, and clawed feet that can grasp any extruding piece of rock, enabling them to climb vertical cliffs as easily as they cross a flat floor.

name: Zhentarim Spirit
summary: A Zhentarim spirit is the essence of a Zhentarim wizard who met with a horrible death at the hands of his or her enemies or treacherous comrades.

name: Zhentish Sewer Rat
summary: The sewers of Zhentil Keep are the breeding ground of all sorts of horrors. There is perhaps no other single place in all the Realms where so much evil magical fallout is to be found.

name: Zik-trin'ak
summary: The zik-trin'ak is built for combat; the claws are longer end sharper than those of a normal kreen, and the exoskeleton is ornamented with spikes, knobs, and other protrusions.

name: Zin
summary: The zin are spirit snakes that dwell at the bottom of rivers and lakes. They are shapeshifting, bardic pranksters, delighting in spreading merriment, song, and mischief among the surface dwellers that travel near or across their domains.

name: Zodar
summary: Zodar are an incredibly powerful race of bipeds. They are all identical, standing exactly six feet tall.

name: Zombie Fog
summary: The zombie fog is an evil creature that feeds on the psychic energies emitted by living creatures at the moment of their deaths.

name: Zombie Lord
summary: The zombie lord is a living creature that has taken on the foul powers and abilities of the undead. They are formed on rare occasions as the result of a raise dead spell cast while in the demiplane of Ravenloft.

name: Zombie Plant
summary: The zombie plant is a semi-intelligent shrub that produces highly nutritious berries. Anyone who partakes of the berries has a chance to become a slave of the zombie plant, existing only to serve and protect it.

name: Zombie Wolf
summary: Zombie wolves are not created by a wizard or a priest, but are a creation of the domain of Forlorn itself. Because a zombie wolf looks exactly as it did in death, these creatures often have gaping wounds and sometimes are even missing a limb.

name: Zombie, Desert
summary: Desert zombies are animated corpses controlled by their creator, the evil Greater Mummy (Senmet).

name: Zombie, Lightning
summary: Lightning zombies are undead creatures created when the bodies of dead humans, demihumans, or humanoids are bathed in exceptionally strong magical auras.

name: Zombie, Salt
summary: The salt zombie is an undead creature born of hate (and possibly a subtle magic of the Great Ivory Plain).

name: Zombie, Sea
summary: Sea zombies, also known as drowned ones, are the animated corpses of humans who died at sea. Although similar to land-dwelling zombies, they are free-willed and are rumored to be animated by the very forces that hold Ravenloft together.

name: Zombie, Thinking
summary: A thinking zombie is a creature who has died and its spirit cannot rest until it has completed a task. The body remains animate and the zombie is semi-free willed, bound only by its dedication to completing its assigned duties.

name: Zorbo
summary: More than one traveler has been lured to his death by mistaking this creature at a distance as a cuddly, black-and-white koala bear. Such a mistake becomes painfully obvious when the mature attacks.

name: Zoveri
summary: Zoveri are inhabitants of Lunia, the first layer of the Seven Heavens. They are beneficiaries of all who go there and are completely friendly.

name: Zurchin
summary: The zurchin, commonly called “star urchin” or “space porcupine”, is a spherical mollusk with myriad radial spines. It moves slowly, using a muscular belly-foot for propulsion.

name: Zygom
summary: Zygoms are small, individual fungoid growths that consist of a short, thin stem with an ovoid cap. One or two dozen such growths are joined by a rhizome structure to form a singular communal creature, a zygom.

name: Zygraat
summary: More commonly known as spider hawks, zygraats are an unusual cross between a bird and a spider. Unlike true birds, this creature is able to entrap its prey through its web and poisonous bite.
